Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.

AI.tldr: 提出MP-MNCA框架：以形态学先验的掩码邻居交叉注意力实现快速收敛的空间域识别，收敛更快且聚类质量与最强基线相当。
AI.motivation: 现有空间转录组空间域方法通常在训练末期单一检查点比较，掩盖了收敛效率差异，无法反映方法在训练过程中的表现差异。
AI.method: MP-MNCA为形态学先验掩码邻居交叉注意力框架：保留全部3000维高变基因表示，选择性在空间邻居间路由分子信息，将组织学相似度作为连续注意力先验，并采用自监督掩码邻居对比目标进行训练。
AI.result: 在12个人类DLPFC切片上，结合收敛轨迹与逐轮空间域可视化与基线对比：MP-MNCA以显著更少训练轮次形成连贯空间域结构；平均峰值refined ARI为0.546（最强基线STAIG为0.549），平均refined NMI最高达0.657（基线0.640）；12个切片中ARI有7个、NMI有11个优于STAIG。
AI.conclusion: MP-MNCA在不牺牲空间域质量的前提下实现了更快收敛，表明收敛效率应作为空间域方法的评价维度，形态学先验与邻居交叉注意力是有效设计。

title: Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenRevisit，将智能体的动作选择扩展为"续作状态+动作"联合选择，并设计NACA信用分配方法，在多个组合生成基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的迭代生成与编辑方法通常将续作状态固定为最新图像，但迭代编辑并非单调改进，智能体可能在已退化的图像上继续精修，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 提出GenRevisit框架，让智能体利用交互历史不仅调整编辑指令，还可选择待编辑的图像候选，联合决定"从何处续作"与"如何精修"；训练采用SFT加智能体强化学习，并提出归一化动作信用分配（NACA），将GRPO中的正向优势按各动作对降低剩余目标的贡献重新分配。
AI.result: 在GenEval2上，使用Qwen-Image-2512和Z-Image-Turbo分别取得GM分数84.3和74.4，较同生成器最强基线分别提升12.7和10.9分；在GenEval、GenEval++和GenEval2上均达到基线中的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将续作状态纳入智能体决策空间并配合细粒度信用分配，可有效缓解迭代编辑的非单调退化问题，显著提升复杂组合式文本到图像生成性能。

title: Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
summary: Visual grounding is a central challenge for GUI agents, requiring an instruction to be mapped to a target within a crowded screenshot. Coordinate generation with single-point supervision reduces a spatially extended target to one position, despite the presence of many valid click locations. Region-based patch scoring alleviates this ambiguity, but its spatial decisions remain tied to visual-token footprints that may span the target, neighboring controls, and background. To address these limitations, we propose Seg2Click, which reformulates GUI grounding as executable-region prediction: identifying where a click can validly execute the given instruction. Using bounding-box supervision, Seg2Click predicts an executable-region mask and computes the final click point through a deterministic rule. This formulation captures the spatial extent of valid click locations and enables finer localization beyond the visual-token grid, making it well suited to small, densely arranged controls without requiring a verifier or zoom-in pass. Experiments across five backbone configurations from two model families demonstrate the effectiveness of Seg2Click. Seg2Click-9B achieves 92.06\%, 94.10\%, and 55.22\% on ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively, while matched-backbone comparisons show improvements over both coordinate generation and patch-based grounding. Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Seg2Click，将 GUI 视觉定位重构为"可执行区域预测"：用边界框监督预测可点击区域掩码，再通过确定性规则计算最终点击点，在 ScreenSpot 等基准上超越坐标生成与 patch 评分方法。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体的视觉定位需在密集截图中把指令映射到目标。现有方法存在两类局限：(1) 单点监督的坐标生成把空间上延展的目标压缩为单一位置，忽略了多个有效点击位置；(2) 基于区域/patch 评分的方案虽缓解歧义，但其空间决策受限于视觉 token 覆盖范围，可能跨越目标、邻近控件与背景，导致定位粗糙。
AI.method: 将 GUI 定位重新表述为"可执行区域预测"：借助边界框监督，模型预测一个可执行区域掩码（executable-region mask），刻画有效点击位置的空间范围；随后用确定性规则从掩码计算最终点击点。该方法无需 verifier 或 zoom-in 二次处理，可实现超越视觉 token 网格的细粒度定位。
AI.result: 在来自两个模型族的五种骨干配置上进行实验：Seg2Click-9B 在 ScreenSpot、ScreenSpot-v2、ScreenSpot-Pro 上分别达到 92.06%、94.10%、55.22%；同骨干对比显示其优于坐标生成与基于 patch 的定位方法。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行区域预测替代单点坐标生成与 patch 评分，能保留有效点击的空间延展、突破 token 网格限制，尤其适合小型密集控件；在无需 verifier 或放大流程的前提下取得领先性能，代码将开源。

title: Avoiding What Your Teacher Already Knows: Entity Familiarity for Deep-Search Distillation
summary: Deep-search agents are commonly trained by distilling tool-use trajectories from stronger teacher models. However, structurally complex questions may remain relatively easy for teachers familiar with key entities in the underlying entity graph, resulting in lower search demand and weaker supervision. We refer to this teacher-specific variation in question difficulty as teacher-relative difficulty and investigate entity familiarity as an early predictor. We first introduce Evidence-Verified Entity Familiarity (EVF), which estimates familiarity by verifying a teacher-generated factual brief against online evidence. Across multiple teachers, EVF is significantly correlated with teacher-relative difficulty with AUCs of 0.60--0.70. However, its high cost makes it impractical for constructing entity graphs at scale. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Reported Entity Familiarity (SEF), a lightweight gating signal that directly asks a teacher whether it is familiar with an entity before admitting that entity into the graph. Across multiple teachers, trajectories from SEF-gated synthesis exhibit greater observed search demand and yield higher downstream student accuracy than those from ungated synthesis. Because familiarity is teacher specific, we further study cross-teacher reuse. We screen graphs collected for other teachers using Kimi-K3's SEF judgments and use the retained graphs to produce 5,411 additional trajectories. Combined with 2,200 trajectories from newly constructed, SEF-gated graphs, these data improve Qwen3.8-27B's accuracy from 44.10% to 66.41% on a BrowseComp subset, and achieving state-of-the-art performance among models of comparable size on BrowseComp, SEAL-0, HLE-text, and xbench. Overall, SEF provides a low-cost way to synthesize more informative supervision for deep-search distillation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出以"教师相对难度"刻画教师模型对复杂问题的搜索需求差异，并用轻量级"自报告实体熟悉度"（SEF）门控信号筛选实体图，从而合成更具信息量的搜索轨迹用于深度搜索智能体的蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 深度搜索智能体通常通过从更强教师模型蒸馏工具使用轨迹来训练。但若教师模型对实体图中的关键实体已熟悉，结构复杂的问题对其反而较易，导致搜索需求偏低、监督信号偏弱。因此需要量化并控制这种"教师相对难度"。
AI.method: 先提出证据验证的实体熟悉度（EVF），通过将教师生成的事实简报与在线证据比对来估计熟悉度；为降低成本，进一步提出自报告实体熟悉度（SEF），让教师在实体进入图谱前直接判断是否熟悉该实体，作为轻量级门控信号；并研究熟悉度的跨教师复用，用 Kimi-K3 的 SEF 判断筛选为其他教师收集的图谱。
AI.result: EVF 与教师相对难度显著相关，AUC 为 0.60–0.70；SEF 门控合成的轨迹具有更高的观测搜索需求，下游学生准确率更高。跨教师复用保留的图谱产生 5,411 条额外轨迹，加上新建 SEF 门控图谱的 2,200 条，使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 BrowseComp 子集上从 44.10% 提升至 66.41%，并在 BrowseComp、SEAL-0、HLE-text 和 xbench 上达到同规模模型的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: SEF 提供了一种低成本方式，为深度搜索蒸馏合成更具信息量的监督信号，并支持跨教师复用实体图。

title: MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow
summary: Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

AI.tldr: MFlowHOI 提出一种高效的单步全身人-物交互生成框架，通过 Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE 构建结构化隐空间，并用 ST-DiT 在一次 MeanFlow 评估中生成完整交互，兼顾运动质量与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 全身人-物交互生成需协调身体与手指运动、物体轨迹及随时间变化的接触，现有方法多依赖迭代扩散或测试时优化，推理成本高；下游应用亟需高效的单步直接生成，但各交互部件在结构与尺度上差异显著，直接一步生成极具挑战。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE，将身体、手、物体与接触信号组织为结构化隐空间，并共享解码器以保持全局协调；2) 采用 ST-DiT 在该隐空间中建模时间与跨部件依赖，通过单次 MeanFlow 评估生成完整交互；3) 利用预测的物体局部接触对应关系进行几何精修，并实现保持交互的迁移至不同体型的光真实感 3D Gaussian 化身。
AI.result: 实验表明，MFlowHOI 在运动质量与文本对齐方面优于现有基础生成器，同时大幅降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: MFlowHOI 验证了单步全身 HOI 生成的可行性，在提升生成质量与文本一致性的同时显著降低推理开销，并支持向不同体型光真实感化身的交互保持迁移。

title: EgoWholeView: Camera-Only Head-Mounted Capture of Body and Bimanual Hand Motion for Embodied Demonstrations
summary: Head-mounted body and bimanual motion capture supports self-avatars, teleoperation, and embodied demonstrations. However, a single egocentric camera is vulnerable to a limited field of view, scale ambiguity, and hand-object occlusion. We present EgoWholeView, a wearable capture system of six synchronized wide-angle RGB cameras with a role-specialized pipeline. The outward views localize the rig in a world frame, while an overlapping downward pair independently predicts SMPL-X body and MANO hand parameters. Both predictors are adapted to egocentric fisheye data. To combine the two, reliability cues measured from the predictions themselves weight the fusion of body and hand joint rotations, while shape is aggregated across views and frames. The pair's baseline fixes metric scale, and triangulation recovers root translation. Relative to monocular prediction, fusion reduces PA-MPJPE by 3.7% for the body and 11.2% for the hands, and temporal refinement lowers angular-acceleration magnitude by 32.2% and 31.0%, respectively. On our six-camera recording, the pipeline produces body and hand states in a shared world frame using benchmark-fitted gates without retuning, and temporal refinement lowers hand acceleration magnitude by 41.08%. Using only RGB cameras and no third-person view, EgoWholeView offers a low-cost, portable route to egocentric interaction data.

AI.tldr: EgoWholeView 是一种由六个同步广角 RGB 相机构成的头戴式捕捉系统，通过角色分工流水线实现头部佩戴者的全身与双手动捕，在无需第三人称视角的情况下输出共享世界坐标系下的身体和手部状态。
AI.motivation: 头戴式身体与双手动捕可支撑自化身、遥操作与具身示范等应用，但单一自中心相机受限于有限视场、尺度模糊以及手-物体遮挡，难以稳定估计身体与手部姿态。
AI.method: 系统采用六路同步广角 RGB 相机并设计角色专用流水线：外向视角用于在世界坐标系中定位装置，重叠的向下相机对独立预测 SMPL-X 身体参数与 MANO 手部参数，两个预测器均适配自中心鱼眼数据；融合时利用预测自身导出的可靠性线索对体-手关节旋转进行加权，形状则跨视角与跨帧聚合；相机对的基线提供度量尺度，三角测量恢复根节点平移；并引入时序优化。
AI.result: 相比单目预测，融合使身体 PA-MPJPE 降低 3.7%、手部降低 11.2%；时序优化分别使身体和手部的角加速度幅值降低 32.2% 与 31.0%。在六相机录制中，流水线使用基准拟合的门控参数且无需重新调参即可得到共享世界坐标系下的身体与手部状态，时序优化使手部加速度幅值降低 41.08%。
AI.conclusion: EgoWholeView 仅依赖 RGB 相机且无需第三人称视角，为自中心交互数据采集提供了一条低成本、可便携的路径。

title: Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 32 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/imaboybut/TGQ-MambaSR
summary: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-Group Quantization（TGQ）框架，用于 Mamba 超分模型的低比特训练后量化，通过预测式分组裁剪与频域保持精修实现精度与速度双提升。
AI.motivation: Mamba 类超分模型虽高效，但其选择性扫描算子是输入依赖的状态空间操作，导致不同空间 token 的激活范围差异显著，传统逐层统一裁剪范围难以匹配所有 token，低比特 PTQ 效果受限。
AI.method: 静态近似一个硬件不友好的"扫描后分组 oracle"：将偏好裁剪范围相近的 token 归为同组；用轻量预测器从量化扫描路径之前的 pre-scan 特征推断分组，避免运行时 post-scan 分组。校准阶段对表征舍入—裁剪行为的 post-scan 激活描述子做聚类生成伪标签，推理时冻结预测器查表选择离线校准好的分组裁剪边界。另引入频域保持精修（FPR）目标，对齐全精度教师与量化学生的傅里叶幅值与相位以保留高频结构。
AI.result: 在多种 PTQ 协议、比特宽度、骨干与任务上均优于既有 Mamba 与 SR PTQ 基线；可迁移到 Transformer SR 与 Vision Mamba 分类，可与基于旋转的量化组合，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上相较 FP16 取得 2.23 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测式 token 分组裁剪结合频域精修，实现了 Mamba 超分模型硬件友好的低比特静态量化，兼顾精度保持与推理效率，并具备良好的通用性与兼容性。

title: Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. Code and saved results included as ancillary material and at https://github.com/aliceyh7/ttt-error-correction
summary: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 across the models. On 100,303 tokens from War and Peace, the same intervention with local per-token norm matching raises perplexity by 2.8-2.9% on TTT-Linear-760M and 1.3B, whereas freezing all fast-weight updates raises it by factors of 4.2-4.5. Separate synthetic tests illustrate the dependence of plain delta-rule overwriting on step size. The results distinguish a prediction-derived update from its behavioral value and show why implementation analysis and live interventions are both needed to assess test-time memory.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析测试时训练（TTT）层中预测驱动更新的结构与经验作用，揭示点积目标下预测误差残差的缺失、LayerNorm平方误差目标的内梯度抵消现象，并通过移除预测贡献的干预实验量化其对困惑度的影响。
AI.motivation: 梯度更新本身无法说明记忆如何修正已有联想。作者希望厘清基于梯度的预测驱动更新在TTT记忆中的结构含义，并区分"更新来源"与"行为价值"，以评估测试时记忆机制的真实作用。
AI.method: 对已发布的TTT实现进行结构与实证分析：1）对点积目标刻画预测误差残差的缺失，建立内循环上升与下降在重参数化后等价的条件；2）对TTT-Linear和TTT-MLP使用的LayerNorm平方误差目标推导内梯度，识别在零epsilon极限下于发布初始化处抵消的预测驱动分量；3）在三个训练好的检查点上测量完整归一化预测的贡献，通过移除该贡献并保留LayerNorm雅可比进行干预；4）在《战争与和平》100,303个token上做局部逐token范数匹配的干预实验；5）合成测试考察普通delta规则覆写对步长的依赖。
AI.result: 移除预测贡献（保留LayerNorm雅可比）使平均梯度范数比降至0.25-0.32；在War and Peace 100,303 token上，同样的局部逐token范数匹配干预使TTT-Linear-760M和1.3B困惑度上升2.8-2.9%，而冻结所有fast-weight更新使困惑度上升4.2-4.5倍。合成实验显示普通delta规则覆写依赖步长。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了预测驱动更新的来源与其行为价值，表明评估测试时记忆既需要实现层面的分析，也需要实时的干预实验。

title: Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.

AI.tldr: 提出 Graph3R，用共享几何表示统一视图图初始化与前馈重建，实现非精选图像集合中不相交场景的端到端重建。
AI.motivation: 非精选图像集合常包含来自不相交场景的视图，联合重建会破坏相机位姿与几何。现有流程将视图关联与最终重建分阶段处理，视图图初始化与重建推理解耦，导致误差传播与效率低下。
AI.method: 基于 π³ 的多视图特征，用轻量验证头预测成对共视性，构建视图图并将输入视图划分为场景组；对每组在解码相机位姿和稠密几何前对共享特征进行掩码，复用多视图特征使单次主干前向即可分别重建不相交场景。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，100% 精度下的平均最大召回率较基线最高提升 8.99 个百分点，同时改善混合场景输入的建图质量；在多会话建图任务中提升跨会话定位，位姿估计精度具竞争力，重建查询组时相比基线约 35.9× 加速。
AI.conclusion: 将学习式视图关联与几何推理集成，向非精选图像集合的端到端重建迈出一步。

title: Deep Speech Representations Track Word Timing along a Low-Dimensional Circular Trajectory
summary: Speech timing is fundamental for speech models to recognize words accurately, but how word-timing information is represented in speech models remains underexplored. We study this question using the framework of representational geometry, which investigates whether and how concepts are represented in low-dimensional subspaces of the representation space. Prior work in cognitive neuroscience has shown that when HuBERT feature sequences are averaged across words of the same duration, they form near-circular trajectories from word onset to word offset in a two-dimensional "temporal subspace." Here we show that this circular structure of word timing is a general property of deep speech representations, by demonstrating its emergence in nine additional speech models covering both supervised and self-supervised. We then move beyond averaged word segments and show that in HuBERT, the circular trajectories are consistent enough at the level of individual words to perform word segmentation. Our approach, Rotary Segmentation (RoSeg), achieves 64.3% boundary F-score on Librispeech by detecting word boundaries when cycles complete in the temporal subspace. Although supervision is needed to identify a good subspace, nevertheless this result demonstrates much stronger implicit word knowledge in HuBERT than has previously been shown.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现语音模型深层表示中普遍存在表征词时间信息的"时间子空间"圆周结构，并据此提出Rotary Segmentation (RoSeg)，仅通过检测该子空间中的周期完成即可实现词分割。
AI.motivation: 语音时序是准确识别词的基础，但语音模型如何表征词级时间信息尚不清楚。先前认知神经科学研究发现，HuBERT特征序列在按相同词长度平均后会形成二维"时间子空间"中的近圆轨迹，作者希望验证这一现象是否为深层语音表示的普遍性质，并探索其实际应用价值。
AI.method: 采用表征几何框架，在包括监督与自监督在内的九种额外语音模型上检验词时间圆周结构的出现。随后跳出平均词段，直接在HuBERT个体词级别检验圆轨迹的一致性，提出Rotary Segmentation (RoSeg)方法，通过检测时间子空间中周期完成的位置来识别词边界。
AI.result: 圆周结构被证实为深层语音表示的普遍性质，在九种额外模型中均出现。在HuBERT上，个体词级别的圆轨迹足够一致，可用于词分割。RoSeg在Librispeech上取得64.3%的边界F-score。虽然识别良好子空间仍需监督，但结果表明HuBERT蕴含的隐式词知识比以往所展示的更强。
AI.conclusion: 词时间的圆周结构是深层语音表示的通用特性，个体词级别的圆轨迹一致性足以支持词分割任务。该发现揭示了HuBERT中远超以往的隐式词知识，为无监督/弱监督语音分割提供了新视角，但良好子空间的识别仍依赖监督信号。

title: FlowAvatar: Real-Time Full-Body Avatars from Sparse Egocentric Inputs on Consumer XR Devices
comment: Accepted to IEEE ISMAR 2026 (Conference Track). 10 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/SPICExLAB/FlowAvatar
summary: Prior avatar embodiment research has studied tracking completeness (how faithfully the body, hands, and face are sensed and reproduced) and personalized appearance in isolation, each requiring specialized lab equipment. How these factors interact on consumer hardware remains an open question, because no existing system unifies body pose, face, hands, and personalized appearance on a standalone headset. We present FlowAvatar, a system enabling real-time personalized look-alike avatars with full-body pose, hand articulation, facial expression, and eye gaze tracking from sparse egocentric inputs on consumer XR devices (Meta Quest Pro). Our pose model achieves competitive spatial accuracy and state-of-the-art temporal consistency on the AMASS benchmark against prior works with comprehensive spatial and temporal losses validated through architecture and loss ablations, while running in real-time. Two user studies (N=12, N=10) provide converging evidence that tracking completeness and personalized appearance serve complementary roles: tracking completeness broadly improves perceived motion quality, while only their combination achieves positive total embodiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FlowAvatar，在消费级 XR 头显（Meta Quest Pro）上仅用稀疏自中心输入实现实时个性化"长得像自己"的化身，涵盖全身姿态、手部关节、面部表情与眼动追踪；并在两项用户研究中证明追踪完整性与个性化外观具有互补作用。
AI.motivation: 既有化身具身研究通常将"追踪完整性"（身体、手、脸的感知与还原保真度）与"个性化外观"分开研究，且各自依赖专门的实验室设备。二者在消费级硬件上如何交互尚不明确，原因在于此前没有系统能在独立头显上统一身体姿态、面部、手部与个性化外观。
AI.method: 提出 FlowAvatar 系统：在 Meta Quest Pro 等消费级 XR 设备上，从稀疏自中心（egocentric）输入实时驱动带有全身姿态、手部关节、面部表情与眼动追踪的个性化、形似用户的化身。姿态模型采用综合的空间与时间损失，并通过架构消融与损失消融进行验证。
AI.result: 姿态模型在 AMASS 基准上取得有竞争力的空间精度与当前最优（state-of-the-art）的时间一致性，且可实时运行；两项用户研究（N=12、N=10）结果一致地表明：追踪完整性与个性化外观作用互补——追踪完整性整体提升感知到的运动质量，而只有二者结合才能获得正向的整体具身感。
AI.conclusion: 追踪完整性与个性化外观并非各自独立的增益项，而是互补因素：仅靠追踪完整性只能改善运动质量感知，必须与个性化外观结合才能达成正向的整体具身感，这为消费级 XR 化身系统的设计提供了依据。

title: DepthTile: Depth-Guided Existing-Image Self-Tiling with Input-Side Tileability Assessment
summary: Existing-image self-tiling aims to transform a given image into a seamlessly repeatable tile while preserving its original semantics and local details. This task requires weak editing to retain the source but leave periodic seams, whereas strong editing improves tileability at the large risk of content drift.Existing diffusion-based tiling pipelines alleviate boundary discontinuities, yet lack awareness of which regions are geometrically important to preserve. In this work, we propose DepthTile, a depth-guided self-tiling method whose generation module requires no retraining of the diffusion backbone. It converts monocular depth into a spatial preservation prior and integrates it into the timestep-dependent masking mechanism of Tiled Diffusion. DepthTile converts depth into a spatial editability map and fuses it with the differential diffusion mask. This strengthens source preservation in near-field regions indicated by the monocular depth prior while retaining editing flexibility near compatible background boundaries. To access when self-tiling is feasible, we introduce the Self-Tiling Ability Score (STAS), a lightweight input-side predictor based on RGB, gradient, depth, and depth-gradient cues. On a 335-image benchmark, relative to the default Tiled Diffusion pipeline, DepthTile reduces MAE, LPIPS, and Tiling Score by 12.8%, 26.7%, and 8.4%, respectively. STAS reliably enables difficulty-aware analysis and further supports compatibility-aware pairwise image tiling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DepthTile，一种深度引导的自拼接方法，利用单目深度构建空间保留先验并融入 Tiled Diffusion 的时间步相关掩码机制，无需重训练扩散主干；同时提出自拼接能力评分 STAS，用于预测输入可拼接性。在 335 张图像基准上，DepthTile 相较默认 Tiled Diffusion 在 MAE、LPIPS 和 Tiling Score 上分别降低 12.8%、26.7% 和 8.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有图像自拼接任务面临编辑强度两难：弱编辑可保留源内容但残留周期性接缝，强编辑虽提升可拼接性却易导致内容漂移。现有基于扩散的拼接流程虽能缓解边界不连续，但缺乏对“哪些区域在几何上重要、需被保留”的感知能力，因此需要引入空间先验来指导编辑保留与灵活性的分配。
AI.method: DepthTile 将单目深度转化为空间保留先验，具体做法是把深度转换为空间可编辑性图（spatial editability map），并与 Tiled Diffusion 中差分扩散掩码（differential diffusion mask）融合，从而在近场区域增强源内容保留、在兼容背景边界附近保持编辑灵活性。生成模块无需重训练扩散主干。此外提出 Self-Tiling Ability Score（STAS），一种基于 RGB、梯度、深度和深度梯度线索的轻量级输入端预测器，用于判断自拼接可行性。
AI.result: 在包含 335 张图像的基准上，相较默认 Tiled Diffusion 流程，DepthTile 使 MAE、LPIPS 和 Tiling Score 分别降低 12.8%、26.7% 和 8.4%。STAS 能够可靠地支持难度感知分析，并进一步支撑兼容性感知的成对图像拼接。
AI.conclusion: DepthTile 通过深度引导的空间保留先验与差分掩码融合，在无需重训练扩散模型的前提下有效提升自拼接质量，兼顾内容保留与可拼接性；STAS 为输入侧可拼接性评估提供了轻量方案，并拓展至成对图像拼接场景。

title: agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents
comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, registrations, and logs: https://github.com/yzhao062/agent-risk
summary: Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

AI.tldr: 提出"agent风险回放"框架：在部署前仅凭既有日志与保存状态，对运行中智能体的部分变更（如更严安全门、换模型）进行风险分析，并证明精确回放所需的日志记录条件、可用保存状态类别、重跑次数上界与可容忍的行为漂移。
AI.motivation: 组织在部署的AI智能体上做变更（如加严安全门或更换模型）时必须先审批，但只能从已有日志出发。经典风险分析假设数据完整、系统不变，无法处理"部分记录+部分变更"的情形，因此需要一个能基于历史日志推断变更后行为的方法。
AI.method: 将经典风险分析推广到部分记录与运行系统的局部变更：agent-risk回放已记录episode，假设其他条件不变且智能体不预知变更。日志可确定"照常行动"的episode，声明的停止值可确定"已停止"的episode，其余episode需日志支持、从保存状态重跑，或给出界。证明精确回放所需的日志字段条件及哪些保存状态可服务一类门（gate family）；对独立episode推导决策所需重跑次数上界与相对真实行为的可容忍漂移。在bash沙箱中做实证。
AI.result: 在bash沙箱中，仅凭7,200条episode的日志无法对两个重试门中的任何一个做出决策，因为该日志从未显示智能体在被拒后仍行动的轨迹。仅从保存状态重跑各门被阻断的episode，在仅为它们事后定尺寸的实时测试一半的智能体调用量下就可复现两个真实决策。在缺乏逐步伤害信息时，停止门的已认证伤害上限可抬高至2.5倍，因为日志无法显示停止前是否已发生伤害。
AI.conclusion: 变更审批需要事先设计的证据，包括适当的日志字段、保存的状态以及有针对性的重跑，而非事后拼凑；单纯依赖已有日志往往不足以对安全门的变更做出可靠决策。

title: RelLedger: Relational Information Governance for LLM Agent Organizations
summary: In LLM agent organizations, shared records determine which facts are available for later decisions. A sender consults interaction histories before deciding whether to report an event. A delivery gap across histories does not show whose relationship drove the choice or whether the resulting record matters downstream. We introduce RelLedger to audit these links. It holds the event, evidence, risk, and message fixed while crossing the sender's histories with the event target and an unrelated actor. Role reassignment and history rewrites locate the controlling cue. Message and cost interventions show when the effect appears. An attribution ledger maps each claim to its required response cells and separates missing interventions from sampling uncertainty. Recipient replay follows delivered information into downstream decisions. Executable workflows for a simulated one-person company extend the audit to retrieved histories, tool calls, and shared ledger updates. Across GPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Qwen, the audit reveals model-specific control paths and smaller relation gaps under explicit loss rules. Claude sends the same factual notice 62.22 percentage points more often with conflict histories than with friendly histories. In executable workflows, strained histories reduce recipient review rates by 45.83 points relative to warm histories for Claude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RelLedger，一个审计 LLM 智能体组织中共享记录与历史交互如何影响信息报告与下游决策的方法框架，通过固定事件、证据、风险与消息内容，交叉操纵发送者历史与事件目标，定位驱动信息共享的控制线索，并跨 GPT、Gemini、Claude、DeepSeek、Qwen 验证其模型特异性控制路径。
AI.motivation: 在 LLM 智能体组织中，共享记录决定后续决策可用的事实。发送者在决定是否报告事件前会查阅交互历史，但历史间的交付差异无法揭示究竟是谁的关系驱动了选择，也无法说明生成的记录是否对下游产生影响。因此需要一种能审计这些关联环节的机制。
AI.method: 提出 RelLedger 审计框架：固定事件、证据、风险与消息，将发送者历史与事件目标及无关参与者交叉；通过角色重分配与历史改写定位控制线索；通过消息与成本干预确定效应出现时机；构建归因账本将每项主张映射到所需响应单元，并区分缺失干预与采样不确定性；通过接收方重放追踪已交付信息对下游决策的影响；并以模拟单人公司的可执行工作流将审计扩展到检索历史、工具调用与共享账本更新。
AI.result: 在 GPT、Gemini、Claude、DeepSeek、Qwen 上，审计揭示了模型特异性控制路径，且在明确损失规则下关系差距更小。Claude 在存在冲突历史时发送同一事实通知的频率比友好历史高 62.22 个百分点；在可执行工作流中，紧张历史使 Claude 的接收方审查率相比温和历史下降 45.83 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RelLedger 能够将 LLM 智能体组织中的历史关系、信息报告与下游决策之间的因果链条进行归因审计，揭示模型特异的控制路径，并定量刻画关系历史对信息共享与审查行为的显著影响。

title: ProGAN-Based Synthetic Image Generation for Industrial Visual Inspection of Metallic Parts
summary: Automated visual inspection is essential for efficient repair and recycling of metallic components. AI-based defect detection is a strong fit. However, it is often constrained by scarce, low-diversity training data. To address this gap, we study Generative AI-driven synthetic image generation using Progressive Growing GANs (ProGAN). We implement a ProGAN pipeline with Wasserstein loss and gradient penalty and evaluate key hyperparameters on two public datasets, MVTec AD (metal nut) and MPDD (tube). As a result, training remained stable and the model yielded realistic images. These images can augment training data, improve robustness, and reduce the cost of collecting rare defects.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究用ProGAN合成金属缺陷图像以缓解训练数据稀缺问题，在MVTec AD（metal nut）与MPDD（tube）数据集上验证了训练稳定性与图像真实性，可用于数据增强。
AI.motivation: 金属部件修复与回收中的自动视觉检测依赖AI缺陷检测，但真实缺陷样本稀缺、多样性低，导致模型训练受限，采集稀有缺陷成本高。
AI.method: 构建基于Progressive Growing GAN的生成流程，引入Wasserstein损失与梯度惩罚（WGAN-GP），并在两个公开数据集MVTec AD（metal nut）和MPDD（tube）上评估关键超参数。
AI.result: 训练过程保持稳定，模型能够生成逼真的缺陷图像。
AI.conclusion: 合成图像可作为训练数据增强手段，提升检测鲁棒性并降低稀有缺陷样本采集成本。

title: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
summary: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架REVEAL，通过协议逆向工程思想，从文本化的前沿模型轨迹中提取"Agentic Latents"（锚定状态与反馈-响应循环的动态画像），在冻结的目标模型上产生局部激活控制方向，从而将前沿模型经验迁移到小型开源智能体。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体能完成复杂交互任务，但推理成本高昂，促使人们将其经验迁移给更小的开源智能体。现有蒸馏与隐空间通信方法通常需要训练目标模型或访问源模型内部结构，存在依赖与限制。因此作者希望研究：仅凭文本形式的前沿模型轨迹，能否为冻结的智能体提供可复用的本地控制信号。
AI.method: 受协议逆向工程启发，提出Agentic Latents，由锚定状态与在目标模型中回放所引发的反馈-响应循环动态画像构成。REVEAL框架无需训练：利用这些画像与轨迹结果，在同一任务的源模型成功与失败rollout中匹配并筛选局部事件；对比其响应-转移差异，得到目标模型专属的引导方向（steering direction），并在每次响应前施加该方向。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1与人机协作工具版Humanity's Last Exam的基准内评测中，相比未修改的智能体，在三个目标模型上均取得更高准确率。表征分析与行为案例研究支持将前沿模型经验作为局部激活控制进行复用。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖文本化轨迹即可在冻结目标模型上实现前沿经验的免训练迁移，验证了将前沿模型经验重新用作局部激活控制的可行性，为低成本智能体能力提升提供了新思路。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-grained Urban Scene Reconstruction via Semantic-guided Density Control and Loss Design
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has been becoming a promising 3D reconstruction technique because of its advantage of high-fidelity rendering effect with high efficiency. However, it still suffers from coarse density control and semantically blind loss functions when reconstructing the fine-grained structures in complex urban scenes. Thus, this study proposes SG-GS, a semantic-guided 3DGS method for fine-grained structure reconstruction. It takes the semantic segmentation deduced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as a constraint and systematically integrates it into both Gaussian density control and loss function design. On the one hand, a semantic-constrained adaptive density control mechanism is constructed, which dynamically allocates gradient thresholds to different semantic regions of the scene and introduces an additional boundary-enhanced densification strategy, so that new Gaussians are directed to structurally critical regions. On the other hand, a multi-feature guided loss function is designed, and fine-grained supervision signals are gradually introduced through a phased progressive training strategy, alleviating the artifacts caused by the lack of semantic constraints in the basic loss. Experiments on three datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves reconstruction accuracy. Compared with the original 3DGS, the PSNR increases by approximately 2.7% to 5.2%, while artifacts on linear structures and boundary blurring are effectively mitigated. The method can serve the fine-grained 3D reconstruction of urban scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-GS，一种语义引导的3D高斯泼溅方法，通过将SAM语义分割融入密度控制与损失函数设计，提升复杂城市场景细粒度结构重建精度。
AI.motivation: 原始3DGS在重建复杂城市场景细粒度结构时存在密度控制粗糙、损失函数语义盲的问题，导致线性结构伪影与边界模糊。
AI.method: 以SAM语义分割为约束，系统融入高斯密度控制与损失函数：1）语义约束自适应密度控制，为不同语义区域动态分配梯度阈值，并引入边界增强致密化策略，引导新高斯指向结构关键区域；2）多特征引导损失函数，配合分阶段渐进训练策略逐步引入细粒度监督信号。
AI.result: 三个数据集上重建精度一致提升，相比原始3DGS，PSNR提升约2.7%–5.2%，线性结构伪影与边界模糊得到有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: SG-GS可有效服务城市场景的细粒度三维重建。

title: ClothAtlas: Joint Garment Identification and State Estimation under Self-Occlusion
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/
summary: Garment manipulation requires inferring both garment identity and complete configuration from partial, self-occluded observations. This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: completing a partial observation requires a garment-specific deformation prior, while identifying the garment requires a configuration that explains the observation. We introduce ClothAtlas, which jointly identifies garments and estimates their complete configurations from partial point clouds and a library of canonical meshes. A shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model samples configurations for each candidate mesh and ranks candidates by observation fit. The model accommodates different mesh shapes, vertex counts, and connectivities, allowing new garments to be added from canonical meshes alone without retraining. On held-out DexGarmentLab garments, ClothAtlas ranks the correct mesh first among 221 candidates for all 22 test garments from a single flat observation. From a single self-occluded observation, it identifies 15/22 garments, compared with 8/22 for a deterministic graph estimator. Persistent vertex identities support grasp-target localization on real garments, reducing mean error from 15.4 to 6.4 cm overall and from 17.0 to 8.3 cm on occluded targets compared with dense descriptor matching. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

AI.tldr: ClothAtlas 提出用共享图条件流匹配模型，从局部点云与规范网格库中联合识别衣物并估计其完整构型。
AI.motivation: 衣物操作需要同时推断衣物身份与完整构型，但部分自遮挡观测导致"鸡生蛋"困境：补全观测需要衣物特定形变先验，识别衣物又需要能解释观测的构型。需要一种能联合解决两者且可泛化到新衣物的方法。
AI.method: 共享的图条件流匹配（graph-conditioned flow-matching）模型，为每个候选网格采样构型，并按观测拟合度对候选排序；模型支持不同网格形状、顶点数与连接关系，新增衣物仅需规范网格而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在 DexGarmentLab 留出衣物上，单张展开观测下 22 件测试衣物全部正确网格排名第一（221 个候选中）；单次自遮挡观测下识别 15/22，确定性图估计器为 8/22。持久顶点身份支持真实衣物的抓取目标定位，平均误差由 15.4 降至 6.4 cm，遮挡目标由 17.0 降至 8.3 cm。
AI.conclusion: 联合识别与构型估计的生成式框架可有效解决部分观测下的衣物识别问题，并提升下游抓取定位精度，且具备对新网格的免重训练扩展能力。

title: Learning Temporal Evidence Selection for Video Anomaly Understanding
summary: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) aims to generate language-level interpretations of anomalous events in long videos, requiring visual evidence that supports explanation beyond anomaly detection alone. Existing VAU pipelines commonly rely on anomaly-centric or predefined temporal sampling strategies, which efficiently emphasize suspicious moments but overlook contextual cues, object interactions, and temporally distributed evidence needed for reasoning. Motivated by recent progress in learnable temporal selection for long-video question answering, we revisit VAU temporal sampling as a downstream-aligned evidence selection problem. We introduce the semantic-conditioned Temporal Sampling Q-Former that learns to select temporal visual evidence through the VAU generation objective. Since generic VAU prompts provide weak video-specific guidance, we condition the sampler on CLIP-embedded object tags automatically extracted from the input video. These tags are used only for temporal evidence selection and are not appended to the LLM generation prompt, separating sampler conditioning from prompt augmentation. The proposed sampler operates in visual-token space, computes soft temporal selection weights from frame-level representations, and merges duplicated selections before response generation. Experiments on HIVAU-70K show that our model achieves the best performance among the compared fine-tuned models, while ablations demonstrate that learnable temporal sampling improves over fixed anomaly-focused sampling and that CLIP-embedded object-tag conditioning further improves over generic-prompt conditioning. Our results suggest that temporal sampling in VAU should be aligned with explanation-oriented evidence utility rather than anomaly saliency alone.

AI.tldr: 本文将视频异常理解（VAU）中的时序采样重构为与下游生成任务对齐的证据选择问题，提出语义条件化的 Temporal Sampling Q-Former，通过 VAU 生成目标学习选择时序视觉证据，并以自动提取的 CLIP 物体标签作为采样器条件，在 HIVAU-70K 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VAU 流程多依赖以异常为中心或预定义的时序采样策略，虽能高效聚焦可疑片段，但忽略了上下文线索、物体交互以及推理所需的时间分布式证据。作者受长视频问答中可学习时序选择进展的启发，重新审视 VAU 时序采样，将其视为与下游任务对齐的证据选择问题。
AI.method: 提出语义条件化的 Temporal Sampling Q-Former，通过 VAU 生成目标学习选择时序视觉证据。由于通用 VAU 提示对具体视频指导较弱，采样器以自动从输入视频中提取的 CLIP 嵌入物体标签为条件；这些标签仅用于时序证据选择，不附加到 LLM 生成提示中，从而将采样器条件化与提示增强分离。采样器在视觉 token 空间运行，基于帧级表示计算软时序选择权重，并在响应生成前合并重复选择。
AI.result: 在 HIVAU-70K 上，模型在比较的微调模型中取得最佳性能。消融实验表明：可学习时序采样优于固定的以异常为中心的采样；CLIP 嵌入物体标签条件化进一步优于通用提示条件化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，VAU 中的时序采样应与面向解释的证据效用对齐，而非仅依据异常显著性。

title: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
summary: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR)框架，通过Stride-RoPE对齐不同采样率的潜帧到共享物理时间坐标，并结合多步长视频采样，实现可控时间率的交互式世界模型推演，解决时间率耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频交互式世界模型在固定时间率下训练和推演，导致两个问题：(1) 运行时生成吞吐与学习时间率不匹配时，生成世界会非预期地变慢或变快；(2) 单一时间率造成时间粒度与物理时长之间的固有权衡——高率捕捉更细动作但在固定上下文窗口下覆盖时长更短。作者将此称为"时间率耦合"（temporal-rate coupling）。
AI.method: 核心是Stride-RoPE，将不同时间率采样的潜帧对齐到共享物理时间坐标，实现一致的多率推演、未见率泛化和不丢弃历史的在线率切换；同时RAR采用多步长视频采样，联合学习细粒度动力学和长时程演化。
AI.result: 在动作控制和相机控制环境中，RAR实现了时间一致的多率推演和在线率切换，保持高率生成质量，并在相同训练预算下扩展物理时长。RAR还可迁移至预训练世界模型并保持感知质量。
AI.conclusion: RAR有效缓解时间率耦合，使交互式世界模型能够以可控时间率推演，兼顾时间粒度与物理时长，并具备在线率切换能力和预训练模型迁移性。

title: ATTCK-R: Knowledge-Aware Long-Horizon Jailbreaking for Protected LLMs
summary: As large language models are deployed behind increasingly sophisticated safety mechanisms, evaluating their robustness under realistic adversarial conditions becomes increasingly difficult and critical. Existing jailbreaking evaluations often rely on static prompts, limited interaction horizons, or lightly protected systems, failing to reflect protected deployment settings with prompt-based safety protections. We show that the introduction of a prompt-based safety protection reduces the average attack success rate of a strong multi-turn baseline from 0.896 to 0.608 (32.1\% relative), demonstrating that unprotected evaluations substantially overestimate real-world vulnerabilities. We propose Adaptive Traceback and Tactic Curation for Knowledge-based Red-teaming (ATTCK-R), a planning-driven multi-turn red teaming framework designed for protected black-box systems. ATTCK-R models jailbreaking as a long-horizon trajectory optimization problem using a structured belief state, introduces optimization-based tactic curation to abstract reusable strategies from prior successes and failures, and employs informed traceback to resume attacks from strategically meaningful states rather than restarting. Evaluated across 9 widely used LLMs configured with a single prompt-based safety protection layer, ATTCK-R consistently outperforms strong recent multi-turn jailbreaking frameworks. Ablation results confirm that long-horizon planning and tactic curation improve attack effectiveness, while adaptive traceback improves efficiency through structured recovery from conversational failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出带提示词安全防护的真实部署场景会显著降低多轮越狱攻击成功率，并提出规划驱动的多轮红队框架ATTCK-R，在9个LLM上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱评估多依赖静态提示、有限交互轮次或防护薄弱的系统，无法反映带有提示词安全防护的真实部署环境，导致对实际脆弱性的高估（强多轮基线攻击成功率从0.896降至0.608）。
AI.method: 提出ATTCK-R框架，将越狱建模为长时程轨迹优化问题，使用结构化信念状态；引入基于优化的策略策展，从历史成功与失败中抽象可复用策略；并采用知情回溯，从策略上有意义的状态恢复攻击而非重启。
AI.result: 在9个配置单层提示词安全防护的流行LLM上，ATTCK-R持续优于近期强多轮越狱框架；消融实验确认长时程规划与策略策展提升攻击有效性，自适应回溯通过结构化恢复提升效率。
AI.conclusion: 提示词级防护会显著削弱多轮越狱效果，说明无防护评估会高估真实风险；面向受防护黑盒系统的规划驱动、长时程红队框架能更真实有效地评估鲁棒性。

title: Strong yet Controllable LLM Abstention without Learning to Abstain
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reduce hallucination by abstaining from questions they would likely get wrong. Abstention can be implemented outside the model (selective answering) using a confidence threshold that controls the answer rate (coverage), or learned inside it (abstention training), which can perform better but fixes coverage once trained. To compare the two, we match their coverage and decompose risk (error rate) into answering ability and distinguishing ability, i.e., how well the model answers and how accurately it abstains, respectively. The decomposition shows that abstention training performs better mainly by answering better: with strong confidence estimators, the two have nearly equal distinguishing ability. This motivates Train for Accuracy, then Post-hoc Select (TAPS), a modular approach that keeps coverage controllable, needs only standard post-training and an off-the-shelf confidence estimator, and benefits from advances in either component. Across three LLMs and three factual QA benchmarks, TAPS with a probing-based confidence estimator attains 1.5--9.4 percentage points lower mean risk than three representative abstention training methods at matched coverage. Within TAPS, accuracy training often weakens the model's own confidence signals, yet refitting the estimator largely preserves distinguishing ability. Together, these results establish TAPS as a strong yet controllable baseline and raise the bar for future abstention training: sacrificing control over coverage should yield gains beyond what can be achieved by optimizing answering and abstaining separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文对比了"选择性回答"与"弃权训练"两种减少幻觉的弃权方式，提出将风险分解为回答能力与区分能力，并据此提出模块化方法 TAPS（先训练准确性，再做事后选择），在保持覆盖率可控的同时取得更低的平均风险。
AI.motivation: LLM 可通过弃权（abstention）来减少幻觉，即对可能答错的问题拒绝回答。弃权有两种实现：模型外的选择性回答（用置信度阈值控制覆盖率）和模型内的弃权训练（表现更好但训练后覆盖率固定）。二者孰优孰劣、优势来源不清，需要拆解比较。
AI.method: 匹配两种方法的覆盖率，并将风险（错误率）分解为"回答能力"（答得有多好）与"区分能力"（弃权判断有多准）。基于分解结果提出 TAPS：先进行准确率训练，再用现成的置信度估计器做事后选择，使覆盖率保持可控。
AI.result: 在 3 个 LLM 和 3 个事实型 QA 基准上，采用基于探针（probing）置信度估计器的 TAPS，在匹配覆盖率下比三种代表性弃权训练方法的平均风险低 1.5–9.4 个百分点。TAPS 内部准确率训练常削弱模型自身置信信号，但重新拟合估计器可基本保住区分能力。
AI.conclusion: TAPS 是一个强且可控的基线，为未来弃权训练设定了更高标准：放弃对覆盖率的控制，应带来超出"分别优化回答与弃权"所能达到的收益。

title: Building age estimation based on widely available multi-source1 geospatial data
summary: Building age is fundamental for urban infrastructure safety, operation, and planning, as it directly affects structural safety, and sustainable development. Existing methods mostly rely on detailed building information such as street view, function, or materials, which are harder to obtain than geospatial data like satellite imagery and Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, existing methods based on those geospatial data mainly rely on optical imagery and local texture features, limiting their ability to capture structural information and distinguish buildings from different periods. Moreover, the inherent temporal ordering among building age categories is often overlooked. To address these limitations, we propose the first deep-learning framework for multi-building age estimation using widely available multi-source geospatial data, including remote sensing data and their derived products, as well as building footprint information that estimates age at both pixel and instance levels within a unified pipeline. Specifically, a large pretrained backbone with fine-tuning adapters extracts representative features, and raster-derived and property-derived fusion modules support pixel-wise and instance-wise predictions. Pixel-level estimation employs a pyramid decoder with Cosine-guided Mixture-of-Experts (CMoE) to fuse multi-source raster data across scales, capturing fine-grained building age differences, while instance-level prediction uses attention pooling and Property-Conditional Adaptive Instance Normalization (PCAdaIN) to extract instance-level representations and integrate property attributes. A Temporal Ordinal Constraint Loss (TOCL) enforces the sequential ordering of predicted ages. We also construct a building age benchmark for Hong Kong to enable comprehensive evaluation. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/littlebeen/RS-buildingAge.git.

AI.tldr: 该文提出首个基于多源地理空间数据的深度学习多建筑年代估计框架，可在统一流程中实现像素级与实例级预测，并构建了香港建筑年代基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 建筑年代对城市基础设施安全、运营与规划至关重要。现有方法多依赖街景、功能或材料等较难获取的详细建筑信息；而基于卫星影像、DSM等地理空间数据的方法主要依赖光学影像和局部纹理特征，难以捕捉结构信息、区分不同时期建筑，且常忽略建筑年代类别固有的时序先后关系。
AI.method: 提出统一的多建筑年代估计深度学习框架，利用遥感数据及其衍生产品和建筑轮廓信息：使用大型预训练骨干网络加微调适配器提取特征；栅格派生与属性派生融合模块分别支持像素级与实例级预测。像素级采用金字塔解码器与余弦引导混合专家（CMoE）跨尺度融合多源栅格数据；实例级采用注意力池化与属性条件自适应实例归一化（PCAdaIN）提取实例表示并整合属性；引入时序序数约束损失（TOCL）保证预测年代的顺序性。同时构建香港建筑年代基准数据集。
AI.result: 构建了香港建筑年代基准数据集以支持全面评估；在像素级和实例级均可进行年代估计，框架有效融合多源栅格与属性信息，并通过TOCL约束年代顺序。源代码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现基于广泛可得的多源地理空间数据的多建筑年代估计，统一像素级与实例级预测流程，缓解了现有方法对难获取信息的依赖、结构信息捕捉不足及忽略时序顺序等问题。

title: Anomaly-Guided Observation and Two-Level Semantic Feedback for Training-Free Video Anomaly Analysis
summary: Training-free language-based video anomaly detection (VAD) uses frozen vision--language models (VLMs) and large language models (LLMs) to localize abnormal events without task-specific model-weight optimization. Existing approaches increasingly exploit broader temporal and semantic context, yet generic context does not necessarily foreground abnormal events or specify how video-level semantics should modify local anomaly scores. We introduce a training-free semantic feedback framework that uses VAD-guided active observation for video anomaly understanding (VAU) and returns the resulting anomaly-focused description to refine temporal detection. Starting from an upstream anomaly-score curve, we adapt reasoning-based iterative frame selection: high-score regions seed the observations, and anomaly scores together with VLM relevance assessments guide subsequent temporal exploration. A frozen video-language model generates a single open-ended anomaly description from the selected frames. The description is returned through two complementary feedback levels: video-level feedback determines whether the score distribution should be suppressed, preserved, or sharpened, with selective visual rechecking, while local feedback retrieves event-related windows and promotes scores only after target-local visual verification. All model weights remain frozen, and feedback is applied once without regenerating the description. On the HIVAU video-summary evaluations of UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, VAD-guided observation improves GPT-rated reasonability, detail, and consistency over the matched CLIP-guided variant. For VAD, semantic feedback improves the re-evaluated upstream detector from 84.36% to 86.25% AUC on UCF-Crime and from 68.07% to 72.58% AP on XD-Violence, where the final AUC is 91.74%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练语义反馈框架：VAD引导主动观测生成视频异常描述，再将描述回馈以精炼时序检测。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练VAD方法虽利用更广的时序与语义上下文，但通用上下文未必能凸显异常事件，也未明确视频级语义应如何修正局部异常分数，缺乏有效的反馈机制。
AI.method: 基于上游异常分数曲线，采用推理式迭代帧选择：高分区域作为观测种子，结合异常分数与VLM相关性评估引导时序探索；冻结视频语言模型由选中帧生成单条开放式异常描述；描述经两级反馈回传——视频级反馈判定分数分布应抑制、保留或锐化并做选择性视觉复核，局部反馈检索事件相关窗口，仅经目标局部视觉验证后提升分数。全程权重冻结，反馈仅执行一次。
AI.result: 在UCF-Crime与XD-Violence的HIVAU视频摘要评测中，VAD引导观测相比匹配的CLIP引导变体在GPT评定的合理性、细节与一致性上更优；VAD方面，语义反馈使重评上游检测器在UCF-Crime上AUC由84.36%提升至86.25%，XD-Violence上AP由68.07%提升至72.58%（最终AUC达91.74%）。
AI.conclusion: 语义反馈可在不训练任何模型权重的前提下有效精炼时序异常检测，并提升异常理解的描述质量，实现了检测与理解的双向增益。

title: Explicitly Aligned Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction from Variable-Length Screening Histories
summary: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is essential for improved risk stratification and personalized screening. It can benefit from both temporal breast tissue changes across longitudinal examinations and complementary anatomical information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views. Leveraging longitudinal information requires identifying corresponding tissue regions across examinations, yet most approaches rely on implicit feature alignment without explicitly enforcing spatial consistency. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of explicit temporal alignment; however, existing methods model each view independently, preventing them from exploiting complementary CC and MLO information. Furthermore, explicit approaches have been limited to a single prior examination. To fill these gaps, we propose (github.com/sot176/FlexLMV-Net), a breast-wise longitudinal multi-view framework that jointly models CC and MLO views across screening examinations while accommodating a variable number of prior examinations. FlexLMV-Net explicitly aligns longitudinal feature maps and integrates complementary views through cross-view temporal fusion and a dual-stream attention block. Evaluated on EMBED and CSAW-CC, FlexLMV-Net consistently outperforms existing approaches across breast density, cancer subtypes, and demographic subgroups, highlighting the benefits of explicit longitudinal alignment, multi-view modeling, and flexible use of available screening history. We further introduce (github.com/sot176/BCRBench), an open-source benchmark that unifies state-of-the-art single- and multi-timepoint breast cancer risk prediction models under standardized preprocessing, training, inference, and evaluation protocols, enabling fair and reproducible comparison of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexLMV-Net乳房级纵向多视角框架，显式对齐纵向特征并融合CC/MLO视角，支持可变数量的既往检查，在EMBED和CSAW-CC上优于现有方法，并发布BCRBench基准。
AI.motivation: 准确的风险预测依赖纵向检查中乳腺组织的时间变化以及CC和MLO视角的互补解剖信息。现有方法存在三点不足：纵向对齐多为隐式特征对齐，缺乏显式空间一致性约束；已有的显式对齐方法对每个视角独立建模，无法利用CC与MLO的互补信息；显式方法仅局限于单次既往检查。
AI.method: 提出FlexLMV-Net，一种乳房级纵向多视角框架，跨筛查检查联合建模CC与MLO视角，并适应可变数量的既往检查。方法显式对齐纵向特征图，通过跨视角时间融合与双流注意力模块整合互补视角信息。
AI.result: 在EMBED和CSAW-CC数据集上，FlexLMV-Net在乳腺密度、癌症亚型及人口统计学亚组上均持续优于现有方法，验证了显式纵向对齐、多视角建模及灵活使用筛查历史的价值。同时发布开源基准BCRBench，统一了最先进的单时间点与多时间点风险预测模型在预处理、训练、推理和评估上的协议。
AI.conclusion: FlexLMV-Net通过显式纵向对齐与多视角融合提升了乳腺癌风险预测性能，并具备对可变筛查历史的灵活性；BCRBench为现有方法提供了公平、可复现的比较平台。

title: BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.

AI.tldr: BAT3R是一个免训练的贝叶斯自适应框架，通过状态创新门控（SIG）和贝叶斯引导自适应状态更新（BASU）缓解流式三维重建在长序列中的误差累积，在多个基准上超越现有在线方法。
AI.motivation: 前馈Transformer在3D视觉中进展显著，但二次复杂度使其难以处理长视频序列。流式三维重建虽以恒定内存顺序处理帧，但现有递归架构未考虑观测的内在可靠性和历史状态的累积置信度，导致长序列中逐步退化与严重误差累积。
AI.method: 提出免训练（training-free）的贝叶斯自适应框架BAT3R，包含两个协同模块：1）状态创新门控（SIG），作为分布正则化器，将状态演化锚定到其几何初始化，抑制长时推理中的表征漂移；2）贝叶斯引导自适应状态更新（BASU），在卡尔曼滤波框架下将状态更新重构为递归贝叶斯推断，通过信息论增益建模观测的时间可靠性、通过交叉注意力图建模空间相关性，实现非对称时空状态融合——已充分固化的历史区域免受冗余更新，而真正新出现的场景内容被积极纳入。
AI.result: 在7-Scenes、TUM、ScanNet、KITTI等标准基准的广泛实验中，BAT3R持续优于最先进的在线三维重建方法，在长序列和复杂场景上提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将流式三维重建的状态更新建模为贝叶斯递归推断，并引入几何锚定的门控机制，可有效缓解长序列下的误差累积，且无需额外训练即获得优于SOTA在线方法的性能，尤其适用于长序列与复杂场景。

title: WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention
summary: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. WorldRoPE integrates the rotary operator over this distribution in closed form, combining rotations at the projected primitive centers according to their mixture weights with covariance-dependent attenuation. This makes attention less sensitive to uncertain key locations in the query view, without rasterizing or warping token features. The formulation reduces to deterministic RoPE when the support collapses to a point. Across layers, the predicted geometry guides cross-view attention, while the updated features refine the geometry used at the next layer. Experiments on novel view synthesis, depth estimation, and 3D geometry reconstruction demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRoPE for multi-view Transformers.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldRoPE，一种面向多视角注意力机制的概率化世界坐标系旋转位置编码，将patch token反投影为世界坐标系下的体高斯体素，并对投影分布做闭式旋转积分。
AI.motivation: 多视角场景下patch坐标在各图像中独立定义，同一3D点在不同视角坐标不一致，难以建立跨视角对应关系；而RoPE在多视角注意力中缺乏世界坐标一致性。
AI.method: 每层将每个patch token反投影为共享世界坐标系中的一组体高斯基元，表示多种可能深度假设、深度不确定性及patch视锥的空间范围；将key支撑投影到query视角得到该key出现位置的概率分布；对该分布闭式积分旋转算子，按混合权重对投影基元中心的旋转加权，并施加协方差相关的衰减；当分布退化为一点时退化为确定性RoPE；跨层间几何指导注意力、更新特征再细化下一层几何。
AI.result: 在新视角合成、深度估计与3D几何重建任务上验证了WorldRoPE对多视角Transformer的有效性。
AI.conclusion: WorldRoPE通过世界中心概率化RoPE实现跨视角对应，降低对query视图中不确定key位置的敏感性，且无需栅格化或扭曲token特征，可自然退化为标准RoPE。

title: SyncReward: Human-Aligned Synchronization Reward for Audio-Visual Generation
summary: Recent years have witnessed rapid progress in joint audio--visual generation. However, audio--visual synchronization remains a challenge, as generated speech and sound often temporally misalign with visual events. A key bottleneck is the lack of human-annotated data, reliable evaluation benchmarks, and synchronization-aware evaluation models for generated audio--visual outputs. To address these limitations, we conduct a comprehensive study spanning data, benchmarking, and reward modeling. We first introduce SyncReward-Data-80K, a dataset containing 80K professional synchronization ratings for clips from eight audio--visual generators. A taxonomy-guided construction pipeline covers four sound-event families: Speech, Onset, Instrument, and Ambient. We further construct \textbf{SyncReward-Bench}, a held-out benchmark of 1K clips, each independently rated by multiple professionals. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate specialized synchronization metrics and omni-modal models, revealing their substantial misalignment with human judgments. Finally, we develop SyncReward, a reward model that combines semantic--temporal contrastive pretraining on real clips with human supervision on generated clips. As an evaluation metric, SyncReward achieves the strongest agreement with human ratings among the evaluated methods. As a reward, it improves synchronization through inference-time best-of-$N$ selection and reinforcement learning based post-training. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and code at https://github.com/WeChatCV/SyncReward.

AI.tldr: 本文针对音视频生成中同步性难以评估的问题，构建了包含8万条专业同步评分的数据集SyncReward-Data-80K和1K片段基准SyncReward-Bench，并提出奖励模型SyncReward，在评估一致性与生成同步性提升上均取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 音视频联合生成发展迅速，但生成的语音和声音常与视觉事件在时间上错位。核心瓶颈在于缺乏人工标注数据、可靠的评测基准以及面向生成音视频输出的同步感知评估模型。
AI.method: 开展涵盖数据、基准与奖励建模的系统性研究：1）构建SyncReward-Data-80K，含8万条专业同步评分，覆盖Speech、Onset、Instrument、Ambient四类声音事件；2）构建由多名专家独立评分的1K片段留出基准SyncReward-Bench；3）提出SyncReward奖励模型，结合真实片段的语义-时序对比预训练与生成片段上的人工监督。
AI.result: 在SyncReward-Bench上系统评估了专用同步指标与全模态模型，发现其与人类判断存在显著偏差；SyncReward作为评估指标在所比较方法中与人类评分一致性最强；作为奖励模型，通过推理时best-of-N选择和基于强化学习的后训练有效提升了同步性。
AI.conclusion: 数据、基准、模型与代码将开源，为音视频同步评估与生成提供统一的数据、评测与奖励建模方案。

title: RIFT: Token Influence Follows the Path of Least Resistance
summary: Which context tokens drive a language model's answer? Graph-based tools such as attention rollout and attention flow answer this from a single forward pass, yet their faithfulness in decoder-only models is rarely tested against interventions. We view the layers of a decoder as a causal network whose conductances are attention weights, and read a token's influence on the answer from the resistance between them. We propose RIFT (Resistance-based Information Flow in Transformers), which scores a token by the series resistance of its path of least resistance to the answer, found exactly by a classic shortest-path dynamic program. On synthetic in-context retrieval tasks and extractive question answering over Wikipedia paragraphs, RIFT predicts the effect of replacing a token with a Spearman correlation of 0.52-0.68; predicting a single replacement, it reaches 77-96% of the agreement between two different random replacements. It needs no gradients and no extra forward passes, scoring every token of a prompt in 0.9-3.4 ms on one CPU thread, whereas the replacement experiment needs a forward pass per token. On 576 held-out prompts from four models of two families (Qwen3 and Llama 3.2), it outperforms token distance, attention rollout and attention flow in every pre-specified comparison, by 0.23 to 0.88 in mean Spearman correlation, and it is the best or tied-best of all attention-based scores we test. Aggregates that add up all routes (attention flow, effective resistance and rollout) instead mostly encode token position: as a simple proposition shows, early tokens have many more parallel routes to the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIFT，将解码器层视为因果网络、注意力权重视为电导，用最小阻力路径的串联电阻度量上下文token对答案的影响力，无需梯度或额外前向传播，即可高保真、快速地识别关键token。
AI.motivation: 注意力rollout、attention flow等图方法仅基于单次前向传播给出token影响力，但在decoder-only模型中其忠实性很少通过干预实验验证；而逐token替换实验虽忠实却需每个token一次前向，代价高昂。
AI.method: 将解码器各层建模为因果网络，注意力权重作为电导，token对答案的影响由其到答案的最小阻力路径串联电阻表示，并用经典最短路径动态规划精确求解；无需梯度、无需额外前向传播，可对提示中每个token打分。
AI.result: 在合成上下文检索与维基百科段落抽取式问答上，RIFT预测token替换效果的Spearman相关为0.52–0.68，单次替换预测达到两次随机替换间一致性的77–96%；单CPU线程0.9–3.4 ms完成全提示打分。在Qwen3与Llama 3.2两族四模型的576条留出提示上，所有预设比较中均优于token距离、attention rollout与attention flow，平均Spearman相关提升0.23–0.88，且为所测注意力分数中最佳或并列最佳。加和所有路径的聚合方法（attention flow、有效电阻、rollout）主要编码token位置，早期token拥有更多并行路径。
AI.conclusion: 最小阻力路径的串联电阻是衡量token对答案影响力的忠实且高效指标，显著优于基于多路径聚合的注意力方法；后者因并行路径随位置变化而主要反映位置信息，提示此类聚合指标存在系统性偏差。

title: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

AI.tldr: LoongSage 是一个面向智能体任务的、核心仅约 14K 行代码的智能体原生全异步强化学习框架，基于 Megatron 与 SGLang，通过 AgentFlow 统一执行范式、滑窗策略、TransferMesh 拓扑感知同步和 Teacher Manager 等设计，在四组训练中实现奖励稳步提升并保持训练-推理差距可控与硬件利用率。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型能力前沿从静态推理转向需要外部工具调用、多轮交互和长时程决策的智能体任务，现有主流强化学习框架日益臃肿，带来采用、使用与调试的高昂开销，亟需更轻量、原生支持智能体范式的 RL 框架。
AI.method: 提出 LoongSage：智能体原生全异步 RL 框架，核心约 14K 行代码；基于 Megatron 做分布式训练、SGLang 做高吞吐推理；将编排集中于单一 controller 进程，所有 GPU 常驻组件封装为 Ray actor；引入 AgentFlow 统一执行范式以编排白盒与黑盒智能体；异步执行上采用滑窗策略限制轨迹陈旧度，并用 TransferMesh 拓扑感知同步机制在每步后按各接收方最快传输路径路由权重；另含内存高效的 Teacher Manager，将教师模型扩展与 GPU 显存解耦，原生支持多教师在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在四组完整训练（涵盖复杂强化学习与多教师蒸馏）中，任务奖励稳步提升，训练-推理差距持续可控；全异步流水线消除了同步空闲气泡，维持了硬件利用率。
AI.conclusion: LoongSage 以轻量内核与全异步设计有效降低智能体 RL 框架的采用与调试开销，兼顾训练稳定性与硬件效率，并原生支持多教师在线策略蒸馏，为智能体 RL 后训练提供了可扩展的实践方案。

title: Self-Distillation with Verbal Regularization
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a large language model using supervision from a teacher instantiated from the same model as the student. The teacher is conditioned on privileged information (PI), such as verified solutions. The student, which does not observe PI, learns from the teacher's next-token distributions along its own sampled responses. However, PI can bias supervision toward shortcut reasoning with limited verification or reconsideration, accompanied by a sharp drop in the entropy of the output distribution. To address this challenge, we introduce self-distillation with verbal regularization (VRSD), which uses system prompts to regulate how the teacher uses PI, thereby encouraging rethinking and exploration to counteract premature commitment. Theoretically, we model prompting as attenuating the influence of PI on the teacher distribution and derive conditions for entropy preservation. Across three models and four tasks, VRSD improves Pass@1 over OPSD in 11 of 12 model-task settings, by 3.9 percentage points on average, while generally maintaining higher token entropy.

AI.tldr: 提出 VRSD，用系统提示词调节教师对特权信息的使用，缓解 on-policy 自蒸馏中的捷径推理与熵坍缩问题，在 12 个模型-任务设置中 11 个优于 OPSD，Pass@1 平均提升 3.9 个百分点。
AI.motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）中，教师模型由学生自身实例化并额外接收特权信息（如已验证解答）。但特权信息会使监督偏向捷径推理，缺乏验证与再思考，同时导致输出分布熵急剧下降，损害学生模型的学习效果。
AI.method: 提出带言语正则的自蒸馏（VRSD）：利用系统提示词约束教师使用特权信息的方式，鼓励重思考与探索，抑制过早收敛。理论上将提示建模为对教师分布中特权信息影响的衰减，并推导熵保持的条件。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型、4 个任务共 12 个模型-任务设置中，VRSD 有 11 个设置的 Pass@1 优于 OPSD，平均提升 3.9 个百分点，且整体上保持更高的 token 熵。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统提示词对特权信息的使用进行言语正则，可有效缓解自蒸馏中的捷径推理与熵坍缩，在保持探索性的同时提升下游任务性能，为特权信息蒸馏提供了简单且有效的改进方案。

title: VideoSlate: Stateful Commit Control for Temporally Grounded Agentic Video Reasoning
summary: Agentic video reasoning systems gather and assess video evidence across stages, selecting relevant spans as visual evidence for answering questions. New candidates and observations prompt reassessment of the current span, but revisions can correct localization errors or discard useful evidence already present in the adopted span. Systems therefore need to connect evidence organization across stages with temporal state control, allowing accumulated information to jointly inform revision assessment while explicit adoption decisions govern how assessment outcomes affect downstream visual evidence. We introduce VideoSlate, a stateful commit-control framework built around shared evidence. A typed evidence blackboard links candidate spans, provenance, construction, and verifier observations, enabling an incumbent-relative certifier to assess revision support from the candidate, current span, and related proposals. Based on certification, the controller authorizes a revision or retains the current span, separating evidence accumulation from state updates and recording each decision and its evidence on the blackboard. Extensive evaluations across video grounding and grounded question-answering benchmarks show that VideoSlate can improve temporal localization through selective revision.

AI.tldr: VideoSlate：面向智能体视频推理的状态化提交控制框架，通过共享证据黑板与在任相对认证器实现选择性时序修订。
AI.motivation: 智能体视频推理需跨阶段收集与评估视频证据，并选取相关时间片段作为回答问题的视觉证据。新候选与观测会促使系统重新评估当前片段，但修订既可能纠正定位错误，也可能丢弃已采纳片段中已有的有用证据。因此系统需将跨阶段的证据组织与时序状态控制相连接，使累积信息共同支持修订评估，同时以显式的采纳决策决定评估结果如何影响下游视觉证据。
AI.method: 提出 VideoSlate，一个以共享证据为核心的状态化提交控制框架。其构建类型化证据黑板，统一链接候选片段、来源出处、构建过程与验证器观测；在此基础上引入“在任相对认证器”（incumbent-relative certifier），综合候选片段、当前片段及相关提案来评估修订支持度。基于认证结果，控制器授权修订或保留当前片段，从而将证据累积与状态更新解耦，并在黑板上记录每次决策及其依据证据。
AI.result: 在视频定位与基于视频的问答等多类基准上进行了广泛评估，结果表明 VideoSlate 能通过选择性修订提升时序定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 将证据组织与时序状态控制结合、并以显式提交决策管理状态更新，可有效支持智能体视频推理中的证据复用与错误纠正，选择性修订带来时序定位增益。

title: HexaBee-4B: Six-Language Translation with Multilingual Answering and Bidirectional Supervision
summary: Multilingual translation requires a model to preserve meaning while producing text in a requested language. We present HexaBee-4B, a translator adapted from Gemma 3 4B IT through three stages: Wikipedia continued pretraining, joint multilingual answering and answer-text translation, and bidirectional translation specialization. The intermediate stage connects two tasks through shared multilingual answers: answering a question in the requested language and translating an answer into that language. It comprises 19.46 million answering records, including 5.76 million cross-language question-answer pairs, and 10.70 million answer-text translations. The final stage uses 658,274 forward and reverse synthetic translation examples. On 36,572 synthetic test examples spanning all 30 directions among Arabic, Chinese, English, Hebrew, Persian, and Spanish, HexaBee-4B achieves direction-macro chrF++ of 73.75, compared with 57.11 for Gemma 3 4B IT and 66.83 for Gemma 3 12B IT. BLEU, TER, COMET, and a matched model-judged subset support the same overall ranking. These results demonstrate improved translation across the six-language set, with chrF++ gains in every evaluated direction over both baselines.

AI.tldr: HexaBee-4B 是基于 Gemma 3 4B IT 的多语言翻译模型，经三阶段训练后在六种语言 30 个翻译方向上取得 73.75 的方向宏平均 chrF++，显著优于 Gemma 3 4B IT（57.11）与 12B IT（66.83）。
AI.motivation: 多语言翻译要求模型在生成目标语言文本的同时保持语义。论文旨在提升多语言翻译性能，尤其通过任务共享增强跨语言能力。
AI.method: 将 Gemma 3 4B IT 经三阶段适配：(1) 维基百科继续预训练；(2) 联合多语言问答与答案文本翻译（通过共享多语言答案连接两任务），含 1946 万条问答记录，其中 576 万条跨语言问答对、1070 万条答案文本翻译；(3) 双向翻译专门化，使用 658,274 条正向与反向合成翻译样例。
AI.result: 在覆盖阿拉伯语、中文、英语、希伯来语、波斯语、西班牙语之间全部 30 个方向的 36,572 条合成测试样例上，方向宏平均 chrF++ 达 73.75，相比 Gemma 3 4B IT 的 57.11 与 Gemma 3 12B IT 的 66.83 更高。BLEU、TER、COMET 及匹配的模型评判子集均支持相同排名。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该模型在六种语言集合上翻译能力提升，且在所有评估方向上相对两个基线均取得 chrF++ 增益。

title: From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Speech-driven visual grounding in remote sensing (RSVG) removes the typing bottleneck of text-based interaction and is intended to preserve prosodic intent, enabling hands-free target acquisition in time-critical missions. The direct-audio paradigm, mapping raw speech straight to a bounding box and bypassing automatic speech recognition (ASR), was recently adopted by RSTalker, but what such grounders actually learn about language remains unmeasured. SemEcho grafts a frozen Whisper speech pathway onto a VLTVG grounding host so that speech and text share one decoder, making the paired text, free by construction since speech corpora in this task are synthesized from DIOR-RSVG expressions, a training-time teacher and a fair, same-host text upper bound. On this instrument we dissect three semantic injection channels (feature-mimicry distillation, word-level CTC supervision, and two-stage ASR pretraining) with linear semantic probes, and release Audio-DIOR-R (80,973 training clips; 10 timbres x K=3; Qwen3-TTS synthesis with online sox noise lambda in [0, 0.4]) and Audio-DIOR-Comp, a re-split holding out 17 attribute-category combinations under a 2x2 acoustic-semantic protocol. Our anatomy yields four findings. (i) Whether direct alignment beats a domain-trained ASR cascade is decided by recognizer quality: against a weak in-domain cascade (CTC 0.53) direct wins by 9.0 Acc@0.5 points with transcription errors concentrated on spatial-relation words, but a strong in-domain cascade (CTC 0.029) reaches the text upper bound (80.8 vs. 81.0) and beats even the strongest direct model by 8.8 points; the anti-ASR premise holds only against weak recognizers.

AI.tldr: 该文构建 SemEcho 探针框架，将冻结 Whisper 语音通路嫁接到 VLTVG 定位骨干上，使语音与文本共享同一解码器，并以成对文本作为训练期教师与同骨干文本上界，系统剖析三种语义注入通道（特征模仿蒸馏、词级 CTC 监督、两阶段 ASR 预训练），同时发布 Audio-DIOR-R 与 Audio-DIOR-Comp 两个数据集。
AI.motivation: 语音驱动的遥感视觉定位（RSVG）可消除文本交互的键入瓶颈并保留韵律意图，适用于免手操作、时间敏感的任务。近期 RSTalker 采用绕过 ASR 的直接音频范式，直接将原始语音映射为边界框，但这类定位器究竟学到了多少语言信息尚缺乏定量测量，因此需要一个可控、可分解的评测工具来审计其语义获取能力。
AI.method: 提出 SemEcho：将冻结的 Whisper 语音路径嫁接到 VLTVG 定位宿主上，语音与文本共享同一解码器；由于该任务语音语料由 DIOR-RSVG 表达式合成，配对文本天然可得，故可作为训练期教师与公平的同宿主文本上界。在此工具上用线性语义探针分解三种语义注入通道：特征模仿蒸馏、词级 CTC 监督、两阶段 ASR 预训练。数据方面发布 Audio-DIOR-R（80,973 条训练片段；10 种音色 × K=3；Qwen3-TTS 合成，在线 sox 噪声 λ∈[0, 0.4]）与 Audio-DIOR-Comp（在 2×2 声学—语义协议下留出 17 个属性—类别组合的重划分）。
AI.result: 解剖得到四项发现，其一为：直接对齐能否胜过域内训练的 ASR 级联，取决于识别器质量。对弱域内级联（CTC 0.53），直接范式以 9.0 个 Acc@0.5 点胜出，且转录错误集中于空间关系词；而强域内级联（CTC 0.029）可达到文本上界（80.8 vs. 81.0），并比最强的直接模型高出 8.8 个点。
AI.conclusion: "反 ASR"的前提仅在面对弱识别器时成立；当域内识别器足够强时，ASR 级联可逼近甚至超越直接音频范式，说明直接音频定位器的语言学习能力需以识别器质量为参照进行审慎评估。

title: Rule vs.Consequence: Dissociable Internal Representations of Moral Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in morally and legally sensitive contexts, yet little is known about how they internally represent distinctions between moral reasoning styles. We ask whether a model's differential response to rule-framed and consequence-framed moral questions reflects distinct internal structure or merely surface lexical sensitivity. We construct a 2$\times$2 factorial dataset crossing reasoning style (rule-based vs. consequence-based framing) with judgment polarity (permissive vs. prohibitive), drawn from three established moral reasoning benchmarks and evaluated on a cleanroom test set of novel phrasings that includes conflict pairs where the two framings predict opposite labels. Using linear probing and activation steering, we identify two orthogonal directions in the residual stream: Dir-A tracks reasoning style and Dir-B tracks judgment polarity, each near-blind to the other factor (cross-correlation $|r| < 0.04$). This double dissociation replicates across three instruction-tuned models from different developers at comparable proportional depth, and it is not knife-edged in layer: the directions are recoverable and causally effective throughout an extended band of the network. Dir-A can causally change judgments, and in conflicting scenarios, it selectively corrects errors in rule-based judgments without changing consequence-based judgments, suggesting that it does not simply make the model more likely to accept everything. Generalization beyond the training templates is partial: the direction transfers across benchmark sources, but its advantage over lexical baselines on novel phrasings is modest. We therefore frame the result as moral reasoning style sensitivity, a geometrically dissociable and causally effective structure, rather than internalized normative reasoning.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型对规则框架与后果框架道德问题的差异化反应，源于残差流中两条正交的内部方向（分别追踪推理风格与判断极性），构成可跨模型复现的双重分离，但泛化性有限，宜解读为"道德推理风格敏感性"而非内化的规范性推理。
AI.motivation: LLM日益部署于道德与法律敏感场景，但其对道德推理风格差异的内部表征机制尚不清楚。核心问题是：模型对规则框架与后果框架问题的差异化反应，反映的是真实的内部结构，还是仅仅是对表层词汇的敏感？
AI.method: 构建2×2析因数据集，交叉推理风格（规则导向 vs 后果导向框架）与判断极性（许可 vs 禁止），取自三个既有道德推理基准，并在包含冲突对（两种框架预测相反标签）的新颖措辞清洁测试集上评估。采用线性探针与激活引导（activation steering）分析残差流。
AI.result: 在残差流中识别出两条正交方向：Dir-A追踪推理风格，Dir-B追踪判断极性，彼此近乎不受另一因素影响（互相关|r| < 0.04）。该双重分离在三个不同开发者的指令微调模型中于可比的相对深度复现，且在层间非刀锋式——方向在较宽的网络层带内可恢复且具因果效力。Dir-A能因果性改变判断，在冲突场景中选择性纠正规则式判断的错误而不改变后果式判断。跨模板泛化仅部分成立：方向可跨基准迁移，但在新颖措辞上相对词汇基线的优势有限。
AI.conclusion: 该结果应被界定为"道德推理风格敏感性"——一种几何上可分离且具因果效力的结构，而非内化的规范性推理。研究为理解LLM道德相关行为提供了机制性视角，同时提示其与真正的规范性推理存在差距。

title: PersonaFactor: Preference Factors with Dynamic Selection for LLM Personalization
summary: Although users may express different personalization needs across tasks, these task-specific behaviors can reflect shared underlying preference mechanisms. Existing LLM personalization methods often focus on surface-level interactions or undifferentiated histories, overlooking the shared mechanisms underlying these behaviors. We introduce PersonaFactors, a framework that distills reusable and interpretable personalization factors from heterogeneous user interactions. We construct a library of thirteen PersonaFactors by extracting evidence-grounded rationales and clustering recurring patterns across tasks, and develop a dynamic factor-guided generation framework that selects factors relevant to each user's history and current request. Across four personalization benchmarks and four backbone models, Dynamic PersonaFactor achieves the best score on every reported metric. Representation analyses further show that PersonaFactors and user history induce partially overlapping low-dimensional representations, and that their joint use yields complementary shifts. Taken together, these findings suggest that factor-based and history-based personalization can mutually reinforce each other.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PersonaFactors 框架，从异构用户交互中提炼可复用、可解释的个性化因子，并构建动态因子引导生成方法 Dynamic PersonaFactor，在四个个性化基准和四种基座模型上所有报告指标均取得最佳成绩，表明基于因子与基于历史的个性化可相互增强。
AI.motivation: 用户在不同任务中表达的个性化需求虽有差异，但其背后可能共享相同的偏好机制。现有 LLM 个性化方法多关注表层交互或未加区分的完整历史，忽视了这些行为背后的共享机制，因此难以抽取可复用、可解释的个性化信号。
AI.method: 提出 PersonaFactors 框架：通过抽取有证据支撑的理由（evidence-grounded rationales）并聚类跨任务反复出现的模式，构建包含 13 个 PersonaFactors 的因子库；在此基础上开发动态因子引导生成框架，针对每个用户的历史与当前请求选择相关因子进行引导生成。
AI.result: 在四个个性化基准与四种基座模型上，Dynamic PersonaFactor 在所有报告指标上均取得最优成绩。表征分析显示，PersonaFactors 与用户历史诱导出部分重叠的低维表征，二者联合使用时产生互补性偏移。
AI.conclusion: 基于因子与基于历史的个性化方法可以相互增强，共享的个性化因子机制能够从异构交互中被有效提炼并动态利用。

title: Throwing4: Phase-Aware Pose Modeling for Throw-Distance Prediction in Elite Athletics
comment: Accepted for publication in Sports Engineering
summary: Elite athletics throwing provides a structured biomechanical action sequence together with an objective continuous outcome, namely throw distance, making it a suitable setting for performance-oriented sports analytics.
