In this work, we investigate whether explicit phase alignment of pose dynamics improves throw-distance prediction under realistic broadcast conditions. To support this study, we curate Throwing4, a dataset of 500 elite throwing clips spanning javelin, discus, hammer, and shot put, with corresponding two-dimensional pose sequences, frame-level phase annotations, and official distance labels. We formulate throw-distance prediction from broadcast-derived pose as a regression problem and compare full-sequence modeling against a phase-conditioned approach that partitions each attempt into four technique stages and fuses phase-specific motion representations. Experiments across multiple graph-based pose encoders show a consistent reduction in prediction error when phase structure is incorporated, indicating that phase-aligned modeling provides a more stable representation than treating the entire motion as an unstructured sequence. These findings suggest that explicit biomechanical phase information is a useful inductive prior for pose-based performance modeling in elite athletics throwing. Beyond score prediction, the dataset and protocol provide a basis for future work on fine-grained technique analysis, interpretable sports analytics, and robust modeling from broadcast video.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了包含500个精英投掷视频剪辑的数据集Throwing4，将投掷距离预测建模为回归问题，并引入四阶段相位对齐的姿势动态建模方法。实验表明，显式相位结构能持续降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 精英投掷项目具备结构化的生物力学动作序列和客观连续的投掷距离结果，是性能导向体育分析的理想场景。作者希望探究在真实转播条件下，显式的相位对齐姿势动态是否能提升投掷距离预测的准确性。
AI.method: 收集Throwing4数据集，涵盖标枪、铁饼、链球和铅球共500个精英投掷视频，包含二维姿势序列、逐帧相位标注及官方距离标签。将基于转播姿势的投掷距离预测定义为回归问题，对比全序列建模与相位条件化方法——后者将每次投掷划分为四个技术阶段并融合各阶段特定的动作表示，在多种基于图的姿势编码器上进行实验。
AI.result: 在多种基于图的姿势编码器上，引入相位结构后预测误差均呈现一致性下降，表明相位对齐建模比将整个动作视为无结构序列能提供更稳定的表示。
AI.conclusion: 显式生物力学相位信息是姿势驱动性能建模的有效归纳偏置，可应用于精英投掷项目。除成绩预测外，该数据集与协议为细粒度技术分析、可解释体育分析及基于转播视频的鲁棒建模奠定基础。

title: RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
summary: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出RetroPlanner，通过同时比较多条路线并以多种实用性目标引导搜索，提升多步逆合成规划的路线质量与备选路线数量。
AI.motivation: 现有多步逆合成规划往往以“找到可购买起始原料的路线”为终点，但路线还需真实可行。LLM规划器将过程建模为AND-OR图上的序贯决策，但通常每轮只扩展单个分子，且仅优化可解性，未在消耗搜索预算前对多条路线在决定实用性的多目标上进行比较。
AI.method: RetroPlanner为基于LLM的规划器，联合比较多条路线，以可合成性（反应合理性、往返一致性、起始原料价格）为指标引导搜索。训练其基于化学证据推理：目标分子的结构进展、键变化与反应类别、候选路线的分歧点，以及多目标下的排序。
AI.result: 在多步逆合成基准上，RetroPlanner相较先前LLM规划器恢复更多备选路线，同时提升合成路线质量并保持较高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过多路线联合比较与多目标导向的LLM搜索，可在不牺牲成功率的前提下提升逆合成路线的实用性与多样性。

title: Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization
summary: Repetitive structures can give an incorrect pose candidate more inlier support than an accurate one, causing visual localization to select it. History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR) uses coarse position forecasts from up to five past localization outputs to distinguish well-separated current-query candidates. The best-fitting forecast proposes an alternative; HPR accepts it only if every well-fitting forecast is much closer to it than to the localizer's pose. HPR needs no odometry and returns the selected candidate unchanged, using prediction for selection rather than pose refinement. With one development-set threshold, HPR improves recall within 5 meters and 10 degrees in all 12 main configurations of Hierarchical Localization (HLoc), MASt3R-based pose generation, and JIST-based retrieval, losing successes on fewer than 0.4 percent of queries. On NAVER Gangnam B1, HPR corrects 97 HLoc failures and loses six successes; gains persist within 0.25 meters and 2 degrees on all three HLoc test sets. Median HPR runtime on HLoc candidates is below one millisecond, excluding pose generation. Recovery weakens under less frequent localization.

AI.tldr: HPR利用过去最多五次定位输出的粗略位置预测来区分当前查询的候选位姿，仅当所有拟合良好的预测都更接近某个替代候选时才接受它，无需里程计且不改变候选位姿，在12种主要配置中提升5米/10度召回率，NAVER Gangnam B1上修正97个HLoc失败仅损失6个成功，中位运行时间低于1毫秒。
AI.motivation: 重复结构会使错误的位姿候选获得比准确候选更多的内点支持，导致视觉定位选择错误候选。现有方法难以区分彼此分离的当前查询候选。
AI.method: History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR)使用过去最多五次定位输出的粗略位置预测来区分良好分离的当前查询候选。最佳拟合预测提出一个替代候选；仅当每个拟合良好的预测都更接近该替代候选而非定位器给出的位姿时，HPR才接受它。HPR无需里程计，返回所选候选不变，将预测用于选择而非位姿精化。
AI.result: 在HLoc、基于MASt3R的位姿生成和基于JIST的检索的全部12种主要配置中，使用单个开发集阈值，HPR提升了5米和10度内的召回率，仅在不到0.4%的查询上损失成功。在NAVER Gangnam B1上，HPR修正97个HLoc失败并损失6个成功；增益在三个HLoc测试集上均在0.25米和2度内持续。HLoc候选上的HPR中位运行时间低于1毫秒（不含位姿生成）。定位频率降低时恢复能力减弱。
AI.conclusion: HPR是一种无需里程计、计算开销低的历史引导位姿重选方法，能有效缓解重复结构导致的错误候选选择问题，在多种配置下稳定提升定位召回率且成功损失极小，但其有效性依赖较频繁的定位。

title: Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps
summary: Remote identity verification assumes that a camera stream shows a live person, yet public real-time face-swap tools can replace that person before the stream reaches the verifier. Passive deepfake detectors generalize poorly to new generators, while interactive challenges are often selected without evidence of which gestures expose current attacks. We evaluate randomized gesture challenges in 108 live sessions with six subjects, 24 impersonated identities, and two face-swap tools, DeepFaceLive and FaceFusion, injected through a virtual camera. The static calibration segment reaches a session-level AUC of 0.878 with a frozen UCF spatial detector, while the mean across the active-gesture windows reaches 0.988. Pose and combined gestures have the highest point estimates, whereas expressions show no clear improvement. Hand occlusion against FaceFusion, configured with an occlusion mask, scores below the static baseline. The end-to-end time required to satisfy the validator also distinguishes attacks from genuine sessions, achieving a session-level AUC of 0.732, although this signal includes synthesis and transport delays. These results show that challenge sets should be tested against current attack configurations and that response time can provide an additional, deployment-specific signal.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过108场真实会话实验，评估随机手势挑战对实时换脸攻击的检测效果，发现主动手势窗口的平均AUC（0.988）显著高于静态校准段（0.878），且满足验证器所需端到端时间本身可作为辅助判别信号。
AI.motivation: 远程身份验证默认摄像头流中为真实活体，但公开的实时换脸工具能在视频到达验证方之前替换人物。被动深度伪造检测器对新生成器泛化能力差，而交互式挑战又往往缺乏"哪些手势能暴露当前攻击"的证据，因此需要针对当前攻击配置系统地评测挑战手势的有效性。
AI.method: 在108场真实会话中开展随机手势挑战实验，涉及6名受试者、24个被冒充身份，并通过虚拟摄像头注入DeepFaceLive和FaceFusion两种换脸工具。采用冻结的UCF空间检测器，分别在静态校准段与主动手势窗口上计算会话级AUC，并比较不同手势类别（姿态、组合、表情、手部遮挡等）以及端到端验证时间的判别能力。
AI.result: 静态校准段达到会话级AUC 0.878；主动手势窗口平均值达0.988。姿态与组合手势点估计最高，表情未显示明显提升；针对配置了遮挡掩码的FaceFusion，手部遮挡得分低于静态基线。满足验证器所需的端到端时间也能区分攻击与真实会话，会话级AUC为0.732，但该信号包含合成与传输延迟。
AI.conclusion: 挑战手势集必须针对当前攻击配置进行实测验证，不能想当然地选取；主动手势窗口相比静态片段能显著提升检测性能，响应时间可作为部署场景相关的补充信号。

title: Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CFG采样与ω次幂条件分布的不一致问题，提出重要性加权条件流匹配（IW-CFM）显式学习该幂次目标分布。
AI.motivation: 分类器无引导（CFG，引导尺度γ）通常以ω次幂条件分布（设ω=γ）作为动机，但CFG一般不精确地从该分布采样。作者希望探究能否显式地学习这一幂次目标分布。
AI.method: IW-CFM利用冻结的条件与无条件流模型得到的密度比对条件流匹配样本重新加权。在使用精确归一化权重时，目标函数与幂次目标分布上的流匹配梯度一致；实践中采用自归一化估计与正则化经验近似以适应高维数据。此外进行CLIP分析考察真实ImageNet上幂次密度的排序。
AI.result: 在合成分布上，IW-CFM恢复了可解析的幂次目标，而数值匹配的CFG（γ=ω）表现出可见偏差。在ImageNet上，轻量摊销校正器相比固定引导与匹配引导的CFG，与相应的加权和过滤参考分布对齐更好。CLIP分析显示特定提示对比存在整体位移，同时各类别响应异质，甚至出现非单调轨迹。
AI.conclusion: IW-CFM为研究并近似模型定义的幂次条件分布提供了可行途径，揭示了CFG与幂次目标之间的系统性差异。

title: Federated Coreset Subsampling for Distributed Memory Banks
summary: In real-world scenarios, industrial processes can span multiple factories and goods are often produced at multiple sites, leading to a shared yet non-identical distribution of data across locations. To address this, we propose two federated approaches for i) combining existing coresets (Double Subsampling) and ii) creating new coresets (Federated Subsampling) in a distributed anomaly detection setting. In particular, we adapt the memory bank based PatchCore algorithm to a federated setting, resulting in increased cold-start performance, resilience to domain- and sensor-shift, and resilience to unreliable actor participation, a common problem in classical, network based federated learning strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出两种联邦式核心集方法（Double Subsampling 与 Federated Subsampling），将基于记忆库的 PatchCore 算法适配到联邦异常检测场景。
AI.motivation: 工业过程常跨多个工厂、商品在多站点生产，数据在各地点间呈共享但非完全一致的分布（non-IID），需要联邦式异常检测方案。
AI.method: 两种联邦化核心集构建途径：i）Double Subsampling——对已有核心集进行整合；ii）Federated Subsampling——在分布式环境下新建核心集。并将基于记忆库（memory bank）的 PatchCore 算法适配为联邦版本。
AI.result: 提升了冷启动（cold-start）性能，增强了对域偏移与传感器偏移（domain-/sensor-shift）的鲁棒性，以及对不可靠参与者参与（unreliable actor participation）的鲁棒性——这是传统基于网络的联邦学习策略中的常见问题。
AI.conclusion: 联邦核心集方法与联邦化 PatchCore 可有效应对跨站点非一致分布，在异常检测中兼顾冷启动性能与对偏移及不可靠参与的鲁棒性。

title: CultureBot: A Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Exploration of Cultural Heritage Data
summary: Digital cultural heritage collections encode rich relations among objects, places, periods, providers, images, and source institutions, yet users typically access them through keyword search and faceted browsing. We present CULTUREBOT, an interactive framework for natural-language exploration of cultural heritage collections that combines knowledge-graph-guided retrieval, lexical-semantic retrieval, and source-linked generation. CULTUREBOT maps user queries to structured catalogue relations, enriches retrieved records with textual evidence, and generates answers that link back to the underlying repository records. We instantiate the framework on 81,852 SearchCulture records and release an online demonstration. In an expert evaluation involving six cultural-heritage specialists, 55 persona-grounded queries, and 250 evaluations, the graph-guided system was rated significantly higher than two general-purpose assistants and a non-graph ablation, with the largest gains in evidence grounding, diversity, reasoning, and completeness. These results support graph-guided retrieval as a practical way to expose the relational structure of cultural collections through conversational access while preserving links to catalogue evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CULTUREBOT框架，通过知识图谱引导检索、词汇-语义检索与来源链接生成，实现文化遗产馆藏的自然语言交互式探索，并在专家评估中显著优于通用助手与非图谱消融版本。
AI.motivation: 数字文化遗产馆藏蕴含对象、地点、时期、提供者、图像与来源机构之间的丰富关系，但用户通常只能通过关键词搜索和分面浏览进行访问，难以充分利用其中的结构化关联信息。
AI.method: CULTUREBOT结合知识图谱引导检索、词汇-语义检索与来源链接生成：将用户查询映射为结构化编目关系，用文本证据丰富检索记录，并生成可回溯至底层仓储记录的答案。框架在81,852条SearchCulture记录上实例化，并发布在线演示。
AI.result: 在由6位文化遗产专家、55条基于角色设定的查询和250次评估构成的专家评测中，图谱引导系统在两个通用助手和一个非图谱消融版本之上获得显著更高的评分，在证据支撑、多样性、推理与完整性方面增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，图谱引导检索是一种实用方式，可通过对话式访问揭示文化馆藏的关系结构，同时保留与编目证据的链接。

title: ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation
summary: Medication recommendation requires jointly considering diagnoses, comorbidities, longitudinal patient history, and treatment interactions. Although recent retrieval-augmented generation approaches using language models have shown promise for clinical recommendation, most existing systems rely on fixed retrieval pipelines that cannot adapt to diverse clinical retrieval scenarios and may introduce noisy or irrelevant evidence. We propose ARMED, an adaptive clinical RAG framework that dynamically expands retrieval according to retrieval sufficiency and current-admission relevance. ARMED first observes the initial retrieval outcome and selectively performs supplementary or fallback multi-query retrieval when additional evidence is needed. The framework also incorporates a relevance gate that activates only clinically relevant same-patient history and organizes retrieved evidence into structured query-level clinical evidence. Experiments on MIMIC-IV demonstrate that ARMED consistently outperforms previous static retrieval baselines and improves overall medication recommendation quality. By combining locally runnable small language models with adaptive retrieval, ARMED supports medication recommendation without relying on external language model APIs or task-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应临床RAG框架ARMED,通过动态扩展检索与相关性门控提升用药推荐质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的检索增强生成系统多采用固定检索流程,无法适应多样的临床检索场景,容易引入噪声或不相关证据,而用药推荐需综合诊断、共病、纵向病史与治疗交互信息。
AI.method: ARMED先观察初始检索结果,在证据不足时选择性执行补充或回退式多查询检索;并引入相关性门控,仅激活临床相关的同一患者病史,将检索证据组织为结构化的查询级临床证据。采用可本地运行的小语言模型,无需外部API或任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上的实验表明,ARMED持续优于此前的静态检索基线,并提升了整体用药推荐质量。
AI.conclusion: 结合本地小语言模型与自适应检索,ARMED可在不依赖外部语言模型API和任务特定微调的情况下支持用药推荐。

title: VisExMEM: Visual Evidence-Based Explainable Multimodal Evaluation Metric
summary: Current image-text evaluation often relies on a global score, which gives limited insight into which semantic details are supported by the image. Explainable metrics provide rationales, but the visual evidence supporting those rationales can still be difficult to verify. We introduce VisExMEM, a reference-free evaluator that decomposes captions into atomic claims, localizes visual evidence, verifies each claim, and averages claim-level support into a global score. Explanations use the same evidence and decisions. We train Qwen3.5-based 4B and 9B models on 100K samples with multi-task SFT, counterfactual refinement, and evidence-aware GDPO. Across eight benchmarks, VisExMEM-9B achieves the highest descriptive composite among open-source evaluators in our comparison, exceeding VQAScore by 11.7 points while remaining competitive with GPT-5.6 Sol. We also introduce AGITA-Bench, containing 600 human-annotated image-text pairs and 8.7K atomic claims for global and claim-level evaluation. For untuned Qwen3.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol controls, decomposed prompting raises the same composite by 3.6-5.1 points relative to holistic prompting. Human evaluation shows that VisExMEM explanations outperform prior explainable metrics and approach GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI.tldr: VisExMEM 是一个无参考的图像-文本评估器，通过将描述拆解为原子断言、定位视觉证据并逐条验证，实现可解释的评估，在八个基准上取得开源评估器中最高的描述性综合分。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-文本评估多依赖全局分数，难以说明图像究竟支持哪些语义细节；可解释指标虽提供理由，但其背后的视觉证据仍难以验证。
AI.method: 将描述分解为原子断言，定位对应视觉证据，逐条验证断言，并将断言级支持度平均为全局分数；解释与证据、决策共用同一套依据。基于 Qwen3.5 训练 4B 与 9B 模型，使用 10 万样本，采用多任务 SFT、反事实精炼与证据感知 GDPO。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，VisExMEM-9B 在对比的开源评估器中取得最高描述性综合分，较 VQAScore 高 11.7 分，并与 GPT-5.6 Sol 保持竞争力。新提出的 AGITA-Bench 包含 600 个人工标注图文对与 8.7K 原子断言。对未微调的 Qwen3.5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 对照，分解式提示相比整体式提示将综合分提升 3.6–5.1 分。人工评估显示 VisExMEM 的解释优于以往可解释指标，并接近 GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、证据对齐的分解式评估能同时提升评估性能与可解释性，是图像-文本评估的有效方向。

title: Pixels or Code? Benchmarking Instruction-Guided Visual Artifact Operation
summary: Visual artifacts such as charts, technical diagrams, webpages, and document pages underpin scientific, commercial, and engineering workflows. Editing these artifacts requires direct modification, dependency-aware updates, preservation of unaffected content, and compliance with domain constraints. We define this capability as Visual Artifact Operation (VAO). Prior benchmarks test parts of this problem, including cascading updates in charts. We study direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation across visual domains and pixel, code, and agent paradigms under one image-only protocol. We introduce Visual Artifact Operation Bench (VAO-Bench), comprising 1,573 manually screened tasks across nine artifact categories and three difficulty levels. VAO-Bench uses executable artifacts and deterministic rendering to trace reference transformations and annotate direct edits, dependent updates, and preservation constraints. All systems receive the same source image and instruction; we evaluate pixel-space editors, code-generating multimodal systems, and tool-using agents on direct-edit accuracy, dependency-aware update, content preservation, domain validity, and visual quality. Experiments show that executable-code systems better support dependent updates, while pixel-space editors offer faster execution and strong visual quality. Explicitly stating dependencies improves both paradigms, identifying implicit-update inference as a central bottleneck. VAO-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for dependable visual artifact editing across generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 该文定义"视觉产物操作"(VAO)能力，提出VAO-Bench基准（1573个任务、9类产物、3个难度），在统一图像输入协议下评测像素编辑器、代码生成系统与工具型智能体，发现可执行代码方法更擅长依赖更新，像素方法速度与视觉质量更优，显式声明依赖可提升两者。
AI.motivation: 图表、技术图、网页、文档页等视觉产物是科研、商业与工程流程的基础，编辑它们需要直接修改、依赖感知更新、保留未受影响内容并满足领域约束。已有基准仅覆盖问题的部分（如图表级联更新），缺少跨视觉领域、跨像素/代码/智能体范式、在统一图像输入协议下的系统评测。
AI.method: 提出VAO-Bench：手工筛选1573个任务，覆盖9类产物与3个难度级别；采用可执行产物与确定性渲染追踪参考变换，并标注直接编辑、依赖更新与保留约束。所有系统接收相同源图像与指令，统一评测像素空间编辑器、代码生成多模态系统与工具型智能体，指标包括直接编辑准确率、依赖感知更新、内容保留、领域有效性与视觉质量。
AI.result: 可执行代码系统更利于依赖更新；像素空间编辑器执行更快且视觉质量强。显式声明依赖对两种范式均有提升，表明隐式更新推断是核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VAO-Bench为跨生成范式的可靠视觉产物编辑提供了可复现的基础，并指出隐式依赖推断是未来关键方向。

title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: BeziCast：一种免训练扩散模型加速框架，用低阶Bézier轨迹预测靠近输出的去噪表示，配合Tikhonov稳定拟合与凸包护栏，实现稳定外推并显著加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型（尤其Diffusion Transformers）推理成本高，因为需要反复评估去噪器。特征缓存是部署友好的加速策略，但现有cache-then-forecast方法多依赖Taylor型有限差分外推，在较长缓存间隔下不稳定，且通常预测局部模块输出，误差会沿后续去噪块累积。
AI.method: 提出BeziCast，免训练框架，利用低阶Bézier轨迹预测接近输出的去噪表示。通过Tikhonov稳定化拟合估计Bézier控制点，获得平滑且容量可控的时间参数化，避免显式高阶导数估计，并将轨迹容量与缓存查询密度解耦。为抑制激进外推，推导等价预测权重并引入受凸包启发的护栏，检测高风险预测并将其软性拉向保守的单纯形投影估计。
AI.result: 在先进图像与视频扩散模型上广泛评估，验证有效性。BeziCast对FLUX.1最高加速4.79倍，对HunyuanVideo最高加速4.11倍，同时相比竞争性加速基线显著更好地保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BeziCast通过Bézier轨迹建模、Tikhonov稳定拟合及凸包护栏，实现稳定高效的特征缓存预测，在图像与视频扩散模型上取得大幅加速并保持较优生成质量，是一种免训练的部署友好加速方案。

title: CivWorldBench: Evaluating Language World Models in Structured Multi-Agent Sandbox Worlds
summary: The growing use of language models for forecasting motivates a broader evaluation of their world-model capabilities. Such evaluation must go beyond predictive accuracy to assess hidden-state inference and intervention prediction. Real-world forecasting benchmarks offer limited access to hidden-state ground truth and controlled experiments. We introduce CivWorldBench, a benchmark built on a multi-agent strategy game engine with recorded internal states, controlled observations, and paired intervention rollouts. Its 1,900 decision points from 475 worlds support three task levels: association forecasting, belief inference, and intervention prediction. Reference predictors support attributable evaluation of capability gaps, with an expert harness and empirical ceiling estimates contextualizing scores. Stored trajectories make intermediate predictions verifiable, while agent-play experiments test whether world-model capabilities support decision-making. The main panel comprises eleven frontier language models. Composite benchmark scores correlate with real-world forecasting leaderboards on matched model panels, more closely than with a general-capability index, supporting its use as a proxy for real-world forecasting capability. Strong association forecasts do not consistently extend to belief inference or intervention prediction, and effect magnitudes remain poorly calibrated despite informative direction predictions. Process verification reveals errors missed by final-answer evaluation, and structured reasoning improves intervention prediction for the strongest model in the process study. Agent-play experiments identify useful assisted plans and motivate evaluating decision-relevant capabilities beyond association forecasting. These findings identify hidden-state inference, intermediate-state prediction, and effect calibration as priorities for world-model training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CivWorldBench——基于多智能体策略游戏引擎的世界模型评测基准，含1,900个决策点、三级任务与干预配对实验，用于评估语言模型的隐藏状态推断与干预预测能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益用于预测任务，但现有真实世界预测基准难以获取隐藏状态真值，也无法进行受控实验，因此评测多局限于预测准确率，无法评估世界模型的关键能力（隐藏状态推断、干预预测）。
AI.method: 构建基于多智能体策略游戏引擎的基准，记录内部状态、受控观测与配对干预轨迹；475个世界、1,900个决策点，覆盖三级任务：关联预测、信念推断、干预预测。设置参考预测器以归因能力差距，配专家测试框架与经验上限估计；保存轨迹使中间预测可验证，并开展智能体对局实验；主评测面板包含十一个前沿语言模型。
AI.result: 综合得分与匹配模型面板上的真实世界预测排行榜相关性高于通用能力指数；强关联预测能力无法稳定迁移到信念推断与干预预测；效应量校准较差，尽管方向预测有信息量；过程验证揭示最终答案评估漏掉的错误；结构化推理提升最强模型的干预预测；智能体对局实验识别出有效辅助方案。
AI.conclusion: CivWorldBench可作为真实世界预测能力的代理指标；隐藏状态推断、中间状态预测与效应量校准应成为世界模型训练的重点方向。

title: Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection
summary: Explainable face forgery detection requires not only correct judgments but also forensic evidence supported by the input image. However, training cues are typically derived from the forgery generation pipeline. Since images available to the model are of limited quality and resolution, it is difficult to observe the fine-grained traces these cues refer to. Training methods that further supply such cues as privileged supervision exacerbate the problem, as the student is taught to articulate evidence it cannot perceive. The student consequently resorts to templated or over-generalized expressions, giving rise to the correct-answer, wrong-evidence (CAWE) failure. We propose a dual supportability audit that filters privileged cues before distillation. Each candidate cue must be predictable from the remaining privileged context and causally tied to high-attribution visual regions in the current image. Only cues satisfying both conditions receive substantial distillation weight, preventing unsupported details from leaking into the student. Experiments across eight benchmarks show that our method maintains or improves detection accuracy while significantly raising explanation faithfulness compared to existing paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可解释人脸伪造检测中"答案正确、证据错误"(CAWE)的失效模式，提出双支撑性审计机制，在蒸馏前过滤特权线索，只有既可从剩余特权上下文预测、又与当前图像高归因视觉区域因果相关的线索才获得显著蒸馏权重。
AI.motivation: 可解释人脸伪造检测不仅要求判断正确，还要求提供由输入图像支撑的取证证据。然而训练线索通常源自伪造生成流程，而模型可用图像质量与分辨率有限，难以观察到这些线索所指的细粒度痕迹。进一步将此类线索作为特权监督会加剧问题：学生模型被要求表述其无法感知的证据，从而诉诸模板化或过度泛化的表述，导致"答案正确、证据错误"(CAWE)的失效模式。
AI.method: 提出双支撑性审计(dual supportability audit)，在蒸馏前过滤特权线索。每条候选线索须满足两个条件：(1) 可从剩余特权上下文预测；(2) 与当前图像中的高归因视觉区域存在因果关联。仅同时满足两条件的线索获得显著蒸馏权重，从而阻止无支撑的细节泄漏到学生模型。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上的实验表明，与现有范式相比，该方法在保持或提升检测准确率的同时，显著提高了解释的忠实度(faithfulness)。
AI.conclusion: 通过双支撑性审计对特权线索进行筛选，可在不牺牲检测性能的前提下有效缓解CAWE失效，提升可解释人脸伪造检测的解释忠实度。

title: GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM MM 2026 (34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia)
summary: 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.

AI.tldr: 提出GHOST框架，将连续节点几何与离散边谓词联合建模，通过几何约束引导开放词汇3D场景图的关系预测，在3DSSG上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D场景图生成中，空间谓词预测困难：语言相似度反映的是语义共现而非显式几何关系，导致空间关系预测不准确。
AI.method: GHOST采用几何约束的混合扩散框架，联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词，遵循"几何→约束→谓词"的去噪流程；引入语言驱动的约束归纳，将谓词嵌入映射为可微几何约束，用于布局精化与谓词重加权；并设计几何-拓扑协同去噪器，通过噪声自适应交互与朝向感知建模耦合节点与边推理。
AI.result: 在3DSSG数据集上，闭集与开放词汇设置均达到SOTA；空间谓词任务较RelationField提升超过17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将语言谓词转化为可微几何约束并联合扩散去噪，可有效缓解语义共现偏差，实现几何一致且开放词汇可泛化的3D场景图关系预测。

title: Differential Privacy Protected Preference Alignment on Survey Derived Data
summary: Preference alignment enables language models to better reflect human values, but the preference data contains sensitive information, especially when derived from surveys about political beliefs, social norms, religion, gender attitudes, and cultural values. This paper studies privacy-preserving alignment on questionnaire-derived data from the World Values Survey, where supervision takes the form of ordinal labels rather than standard pairwise rankings. Existing efforts mainly focus on general privacy protections upon model training, while data-specific methods for survey data remain unexplored. We first show the vulnerability of aligned models, then formulate the task as rating prediction and introduce label differential privacy. Building on this formulation, we construct a differential private pipeline utilizing three privacy mechanisms: randomized response, exponential mechanism, and DP-SGD. Experiments show that simple label-level mechanisms outperform gradient-level methods, and proper aggregation function for preprocessing also make large contribution. The new fine-grained private comparison motivates explorations toward language model alignment with formal privacy guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文针对问卷型偏好数据（世界价值观调查）提出隐私保护对齐任务，将其建模为评分预测并引入标签差分隐私，构建结合随机响应、指数机制与DP-SGD的隐私流水线。实验发现标签级机制优于梯度级方法，预处理中的聚合函数贡献显著。
AI.motivation: 偏好对齐使语言模型更贴合人类价值，但偏好数据常含敏感信息，尤其是来自政治信仰、社会规范、宗教、性别态度和文化价值观的调查数据。现有工作主要关注训练阶段的一般隐私保护，缺乏针对问卷数据的数据特定方法，且此类监督为序数标签而非标准成对排序，因此需要专门研究。
AI.method: 首先揭示已对齐模型的脆弱性；随后将任务形式化为评分预测并引入标签差分隐私；在此基础上构建差分隐私流水线，采用三种隐私机制：随机响应、指数机制与DP-SGD。
AI.result: 实验表明，简单的标签级隐私机制优于梯度级方法；预处理中合适的聚合函数也做出重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该细粒度隐私比较为在形式化隐私保证下开展语言模型对齐研究提供了动机与方向。

title: The interpreter as developer: An autoethnographic design study of building a computer-assisted interpreting tool through human-LLM co-creation
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. The CAI tool is openly available at https://github.com/omnigx/whisper_interpreter and archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22255011
summary: Real-time AI captioning now serves audiences at multilingual events, yet computer-assisted interpreting (CAI) tools are still built for interpreters, rarely by them. This article reports an autoethnographic design study in which a professional interpreter with no programming training built a local-first CAI system through expert-led 'vibe coding', co-creating with an LLM architect and a coding agent. Analysis of the complete development dialogues shows how tacit professional knowledge, from segmentation to booth infrastructure, was externalized into design after generic defaults failed in use. In a demanding public scientific event, three mechanisms of in-booth appropriation emerge under a firmly human-led division of labor; telemetry from a first fully instrumented assignment shows a fully local chain sustaining a median translation latency of 0.94 s across 971 utterances. The case is read as lead-user innovation newly enabled by generative AI, with implications for the technological literacy of interpreters and the future of interpreter training.

AI.tldr: 一位无编程背景的职业口译员通过"vibe coding"与LLM架构师、编码代理协作，自建本地优先的CAI系统；完整开发对话显示其隐性专业知识被外化为设计，实测全本地链路在971条语音上实现中位翻译延迟0.94秒。
AI.motivation: 实时AI字幕已服务多语言活动受众，但计算机辅助口译（CAI）工具仍由工程师为口译员设计，鲜有口译员亲自参与构建。作者希望探究口译员自身能否借助生成式AI成为工具的主导设计者，并将其隐性职业知识注入系统设计。
AI.method: 采用自我民族志设计研究（autoethnographic design study）：一名无编程训练的职业口译员在专家引导的"vibe coding"模式下，与LLM架构师和编码代理共同开发本地优先的CAI系统。对完整开发对话进行分析，考察隐性专业知识如何被外化；在一场高要求的公开科学活动中进行实地部署，并首次对全部环节实施埋点遥测，识别口译间内的三种挪用（appropriation）机制。
AI.result: 当通用默认设置在实用中失效时，从分段策略到口译间基础设施的隐性职业知识被逐步外部化并转化为设计决策；在人主导的分工下浮现出三种口译间内挪用机制；首次全埋点任务显示，完全本地化链路在971条语句上维持0.94秒的中位翻译延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该案例可被解读为生成式AI新近赋能的领先用户创新（lead-user innovation），对口译员的技术素养及未来口译培训具有启示意义：口译员有望从工具使用者转变为工具共同设计者。

title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage
summary: Vision-language models answer questions about images they were never shown, a failure called mirage. Such an answer can be correct without being justified by the evidence, and the difference matters wherever a model's output is checked by someone who did not see its input. We locate the failure in the training objective: cross-entropy separates a model that reads the image from one that ignores it by only the conditional mutual information between answer and image, and no training example rewards declining. We formalise support completion, TIDE, which also shows each training question with a blank image, a same-domain wrong image and an out-of-domain image, with targets that decline, and prove that under TIDE every image-blind predictor is suboptimal by at least 1.04 nats per example, that the optimum declines exactly on the counterfactual kinds while keeping its behaviour on valid images, and that for any finite model the error of its answer-or-decline decision, declining on valid input plus answering on invalid input, is bounded below by how well its representation separates valid from invalid evidence. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B under a frozen held-out protocol with two judges, the three-condition predecessor of TIDE reduced the invalid-evidence mirage rate from 0.759 to 0.097 and the blank-image rate from 0.700 to 0.003 at a false-abstention cost of 0.126; label-free grounding raised the rate to 0.859, a likelihood-advantage contrast moved it only to 0.718 because its empty-image term carries no gradient, and grounding applied after support completion re-opened the mirage. The four-condition protocol on three base models, with seeds and component ablations, is in progress and not reported here.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将视觉语言模型"幻影"（对未见图像作答）归因于训练目标缺陷，并给出支持补全训练框架TIDE及其理论保证与初步实证。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型会对从未见过的图像作答（mirage），且答案可能正确却无证据支撑；当输出需由未见输入的第三方核验时，这一区分至关重要。作者将失败定位在训练目标上：交叉熵仅通过答案与图像的条件互信息来区分"读图"与"忽略图"的模型，且没有任何训练样本奖励"拒绝作答"。
AI.method: 形式化"支持补全"目标TIDE：每条训练问题同时配以空白图像、同域错误图像与域外图像，目标为拒绝作答。理论证明：在TIDE下任何图像盲预测器每样本至少次优1.04 nats；最优解恰在反事实类别上拒绝、在有效图像上保持原行为；对任意有限模型，其"作答或拒绝"决策误差（对有效输入拒绝+对无效输入作答）下界由表示对有效/无效证据的可分性决定。实验在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上以冻结留出协议、两名评判者进行。
AI.result: TIDE的三条件前身在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上将无效证据幻影率从0.759降至0.097，空白图像率从0.700降至0.003，误弃答代价为0.126；无标签接地使该率回升至0.859；似然优势对比仅降至0.718，因其空图像项不携带梯度；在支持补全之后施加接地会重新打开幻影。
AI.conclusion: 支持补全TIDE为消除图像盲作答提供了理论保证与初步有效的训练方案，其中"拒绝"目标与反事实图像样本是关键；无标签接地、似然优势对比、事后接地等替代方案效果有限甚至有害。四条件协议在三个基座模型上的种子与组件消融实验仍在进行中，尚未报告。

title: PATMT2: Two-stage domain adaptation for multilingual patent translation
summary: We present PatMT2 (Patent Machine Translation, v2), a two-stage LoRA pipeline that adapts the Hy-MT2-7B dedicated translation model to four-language (Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean) patent translation. On six translation directions, the Stage-2 checkpoint reaches a macro-average BLEU of 43.39 (BF16) to 43.57 (AWQ INT4), improving over the Hy-MT2-7B base by up to +8.8 BLEU and also exceeding Qwen3-32B and several external systems on the same average. We then measure the cost of adaptation: probing 38 languages absent from the fine-tuning data, the model still produces correct, fluent output on 34, while four low-resource languages collapse into distinct, reproducible failure modes. We treat these as diagnostic cases rather than retention rates, and report their mechanisms without attributing them to a single cause. Paired bootstrap tests confirm the translation gains over all baselines (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段LoRA流程PatMT2，将Hy-MT2-7B适配至中英日韩四语专利翻译，六方向宏平均BLEU达43.39（BF16）至43.57（AWQ INT4），优于基座最高+8.8 BLEU并超过Qwen3-32B等系统；同时在38个未见语言上探测适配代价，34个仍输出正确流畅，4个低资源语言出现可复现失败模式，并以配对bootstrap检验确认增益（p<0.001）。
AI.motivation: 专用翻译模型在特定领域（专利）与特定语向上的适配可显著提升质量，但适配可能损害模型原有的多语言泛化能力，需要同时量化"收益"与"代价"，并给出失败模式的机制性诊断而非单一归因。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LoRA微调流水线，将Hy-MT2-7B专用翻译模型适配到中/英/日/韩四语专利翻译任务，覆盖六个翻译方向；在BF16与AWQ INT4两种量化精度下评估；通过配对bootstrap显著性检验与Qwen3-32B及若干外部系统对比；并额外在38个未参与微调的语言上进行探测式评测以考察能力迁移与退化。
AI.result: Stage-2检查点在六个方向上取得宏平均BLEU 43.39（BF16）与43.57（AWQ INT4），较Hy-MT2-7B基座最高提升+8.8 BLEU，并在同一平均值上超过Qwen3-32B及多个外部系统；所有相对基线的翻译增益经配对bootstrap检验显著（p<0.001）。在38个未见语言中，34个仍生成正确且流畅的输出，4个低资源语言出现各自不同且可复现的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段LoRA适配在专利多语翻译上兼具高精度与量化鲁棒性，并带来显著的跨系统优势；适配代价表现为少数低资源语言的定向失效而非普遍退化，这些案例应作为诊断样本报告其机制，而不宜归因于单一原因。

title: Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding. These findings show that high VAD performance should not be interpreted as evidence of abnormal-motion modeling without auditing the reliability of the person-observation pipeline. Our study provides a systematic protocol for evaluating observation-quality shortcuts and for assessing whether motion-based discrimination survives explicit control of detection, pose-estimation, and tracking reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出观测质量感知评估框架，揭示视频异常检测中人本类别的运动判别存在观测质量捷径，并用基数匹配证明匹配后运动特征仍具增量判别力。
AI.motivation: 视频异常检测将偏离正常模式视为异常，但偏离不等于安全关键事件。作者关注人本紧急事件与暴力，质疑基于运动的异常判别是否真正反映任务相关运动信息，还是来自行人检测、姿态估计与跟踪造成的观测质量差异。
AI.method: 提出观测质量感知评估框架，包含质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化与鲁棒性分析；在UCF-Crime人本类别上测量11项质量变量，先对比仅质量特征与多线索运动特征，再用基数匹配将全部质量变量的边际平衡控制在预设阈值内，并在逻辑回归、随机森林与RBF-SVM上进行对比。
AI.result: 原始队列中仅质量特征即可匹配甚至超过多线索运动的判别力，显示明显观测质量捷径；基数匹配后，多线索运动在三种分类器上稳定优于仅质量特征，ROC-AUC提升0.046–0.141；但匹配后非线性仅质量预测仍高于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 高VAD性能不能直接解释为异常运动建模，未审计行人观测流程可靠性前应谨慎解读；本文结果应理解为超出已测边际质量之外的额外判别力，而非无质量依赖或因果运动理解；并提供了评估观测质量捷径、检验运动判别能否在显式控制检测/姿态/跟踪可靠性后存活的系统协议。

title: Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs
summary: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将临床肿瘤学自由文本叙事转换为可查询知识图谱的方法，遵循SNOMED CT扩展语法，定义五类关系及构造规则，并通过确定性实现工具UNIGRAPHE从标注文本构建知识图谱，将5,299条标注重构为2,196个后协调表达式，证明关系结构是实现临床叙事形式化查询的关键。
AI.motivation: 临床肿瘤学文档以自由文本记录关键信息，虽可阅读但难以规模化检索，导致队列识别依赖不完整的诊断编码或人工审阅。现有标准仅对单个术语编码，只能捕获文档提及的内容而非其断言的含义，而语义恰恰存在于术语间的关联方式之中，因此需要一种能将关系结构显式化的方法。
AI.method: 提出从临床叙事中导出可查询知识图谱的方法，符合跨多本体的SNOMED CT扩展语法。方法规定实体如何标注与关联，定义五类关系类别，每类绑定一条构造规则，将实体与关系组装为后协调表达式。通过确定性实现工具UNIGRAPHE，将这些规则应用于标注文本以构建知识图谱。
AI.result: 在专家标注的真实肿瘤学文档上应用UNIGRAPHE，将5,299条标注重构为2,196个后协调表达式，表明关系结构是使临床叙事可被形式化查询的关键缺失环节。
AI.conclusion: 关系结构而非单纯的术语编码，是实现临床叙事形式化、可规模化查询的核心；该方法与UNIGRAPHE为基于自由文本的队列识别提供了可查询知识图谱途径。

title: XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 提出XFD框架，利用XAI归因图将可解释性转化为策略条件化的傅里叶域干预，在纯仿真条件下实现sim-to-real泛化。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的自动驾驶强化学习策略在仿真中训练后部署到真实世界常出现严重性能退化。现有sim-to-real方法主要有两类局限：图像迁移式域适应需要大量目标域真实数据且局限于特定部署域；策略无关的域随机化引入无引导扰动，难以反映真实的sim-to-real差异，导致迁移效果次优。
AI.method: XFD是一个XAI引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，面向纯仿真sim-to-real强化学习。其流程为：从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图；将归因转换为策略条件化的傅里叶域干预，通过扰动外观敏感的频谱分量、同时保留任务定义的空间结构，完全在仿真内构造增强鲁棒性的视觉域；再通过鲁棒策略优化引导策略关注任务关键特征、抑制对无关视觉信息的敏感性。
AI.result: 在仿真与零样本真实世界部署实验中，XFD在行驶距离和奖励指标上持续优于标准策略和随机域随机化基线，在背景杂乱的未见过地图上提升尤为明显；基于归因的分析进一步表明，该策略在仿真与真实观测间保持了更一致的任务相关视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: XAI引导的傅里叶域泛化可在无需真实目标域数据的情况下有效缓解sim-to-real差距，且归因驱动的方式比无引导域随机化更能保留任务相关的视觉证据，为纯仿真到真实的策略迁移提供了可行路径。

title: MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.

AI.tldr: MiMaAlign：分层微-宏对齐框架，将Neural ODE学到的连续动力学与VLM事件常识分别对齐到扩散模型的浅层与深层特征，提升文生视频物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V扩散模型生成视频常出现不连续动力学与不合理事件交互；既有表征对齐方法只迁移通用视频特征或短程运动线索，把物理合理性当作单层表征问题，缺乏分层、互补的先验注入。
AI.method: 提出层次化微-宏对齐框架，将互补的动力学与事件知识注入预训练视频扩散模型不同抽象深度的特征：微观层用Neural ODE学习的连续时间运动表征约束扩散特征；宏观层用指令提示的VLM提供物体交互与事件语义表征；以仅在训练时生效的辅助目标，将两个教师信号分别对齐到较浅层与较深层生成器特征。
AI.result: 在CogVideoX-2B上，VideoPhy基准的Physical Commonsense得分相对基线最高提升21.0%；在VideoPhy2亦获显著提升；VBench上保持通用视频质量，并获得盲测用户比较支持。
AI.conclusion: 分层对齐动力学与事件常识两类先验可有效增强T2V扩散模型的物理合理性，同时不损害通用生成质量，验证了微-宏分层表征对齐范式的有效性。

title: Communication, Vocalisation, and Language
comment: A written version of my argument with with Roger, with input from Bruce. 6 pages and one (Venn) diagram
summary: The contention is that the current batch of Large Language Models don't *understand* language, but they *do* it. Rather than LLMs forming some kind of ``distributed representation'' of symbols, the claim is that LLMs are capturing ``Cultural Intelligence'' and grounding symbols in what the sociologists call practices.

AI.tldr: 该文主张当前大语言模型并不真正"理解"语言，但却能在实践中"做"语言。LLM并非形成符号的"分布式表征"，而是捕获"文化智能"，并将符号根植于社会学意义上的"实践"之中。
AI.motivation: 针对"LLM是否真正理解语言"这一核心争论，作者试图跳出传统的"分布式表征"解释框架，为LLM的语言能力提供一种基于社会学的替代性解读。
AI.method: 概念性/理论论证：借用社会学的"实践"（practices）与"文化智能"（Cultural Intelligence）概念，重新诠释LLM处理符号的方式。
AI.result: 论证指出LLM并非在内部构建符号的分布式表征，而是通过捕获文化智能，使符号锚定于社会实践之中，从而"做出"语言行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM的关键不在于"理解"语言，而在于在社会实践层面"践行"语言；理解力的评判标准应由表征转向实践与文化智能。

title: Self-Verifier Capture in Unified Visual Generators: Diagnosing and Repairing Closed-Loop Self-Reward
summary: Image-space reward requires decoding and a separate judge; unified visual generators can instead reuse their understanding pathway for decode-free, self-supplied reward. Optimizing against this verifier closes the self-reward loop; shared trainable weights let one update move generation and scoring even with the reward gradient stopped. We call the resulting failure self-verifier capture: self-reward rises while independently measured quality falls. Matched semantic/denoising by shared/frozen cells on Scale-RAE isolate two routes: the policy exploits on-manifold blind spots of a frozen semantic judge, while shared updates additionally rewrite the judge. A frozen judge also becomes stale, and repeated self-refresh yields progressively weaker recoveries. The diagnosis yields a two-part repair: locking the warmed reward read blocks rewriting, while sparse, parameter-disjoint external anchors counter residual exploitation. Unanchored rollouts retain semantic reward across multiple latent noise levels, providing dense latent reward that terminal image-space judging cannot supply, while a drift-triggered controller allocates anchors to high-drift rollouts and propagates their calibration within each group. At matched budgets, the controller improves on fixed-dose anchoring, increasingly so as coverage tightens. Both the unanchored failure and the repair transfer to the higher-performing, architecturally distinct Show-o2. Across both bases, the complete method significantly outperforms a construct-matched every-rollout judge on GenEval and DPG-Bench while externally scoring only 1/16 of rollouts. At 1/32 coverage, it scores higher in all four comparisons and remains jointly non-inferior.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究统一视觉生成器的"自奖励"闭环中出现的自验证器俘获失效，并给出锁定奖励读取+稀疏外部锚点的两部分修复方案。
AI.motivation: 图像空间奖励需解码并依赖独立裁判，成本高；而统一视觉生成器可复用其理解通路，实现免解码、自给自足的奖励。但对该自验证器优化会形成自奖励闭环，导致奖励上升而独立评测质量下降。
AI.method: 在Scale-RAE上通过共享/冻结单元匹配语义与去噪，分离出两条失效路径：策略利用冻结语义裁判的流形内盲点，共享更新则额外改写裁判；并诊断出冻结裁判的陈旧性与反复自刷新导致的恢复能力递减。据此提出两部分修复：锁定已预热的奖励读取以阻止改写，并用稀疏、参数不相交的外部锚点抵消残余利用；采用漂移触发控制器按漂移度分配锚点并在组内传播标定。
AI.result: 无锚 rollout 在多个潜噪声水平上保留语义奖励，提供终端图像空间判定无法给出的密集潜奖励；匹配预算下该控制器优于固定剂量锚定，且覆盖越紧优势越明显。失效与修复均迁移到性能更高、架构不同的Show-o2。在GenEval与DPG-Bench上显著优于构造匹配的每次 rollout 裁判，且外部评分仅占1/16；覆盖率为1/32时四项比较全胜并保持联合非劣。
AI.conclusion: 自奖励统一生成器存在"自验证器俘获"这一系统性失效，根因在于裁判被策略利用或随共享权重被改写；通过锁定奖励读取并施加稀疏外部锚定，可在极低外部评分预算下实现稳健的自奖励优化，且方法跨架构可迁移。

title: KARAMEL: Knowledge-Aware Ranking for Multimodal Entity Linking in the Arts via Heterogeneous Graphs
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables, journal: Machine Learning
summary: Discovering and disambiguating entities from multimodal and heterogeneous data is a key challenge in discovery science, where relevant knowledge is often implicit and distributed across modalities. We present KARAMEL, a framework for multimodal entity linking (MEL) - the task of aligning visual and textual mentions to entities in a knowledge base - in the cultural heritage domain. Unlike prior vision-language models that primarily rely on surface-level multimodal alignment, our approach incorporates sociohistorical and contextual knowledge through a knowledge-aware architecture that fuses a vision-language encoder with a heterogeneous graph neural network. This design enables contextual reasoning over complex relational structures and supports robust entity disambiguation under ambiguous or underspecified evidence. To benchmark multimodal discovery in this setting, we introduce WikiMuSA (Wikidata-based Multimodal Semantic data for Art), a new dataset that links artworks to Wikidata entities via images, textual descriptions, and structured contextual knowledge. Experimental results show that KARAMEL surpasses strong baselines, particularly on implicit or abstract mentions, while ablation studies highlight the critical role of domain-specific, structured context in learning expressive representations. While instantiated in the cultural heritage domain, KARAMEL addresses a general knowledge discovery problem and applies to other scientific settings involving multimodal observations and heterogeneous background knowledge. Both the dataset and source code are made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出KARAMEL框架，用于文化遗产领域的多模态实体链接（MEL），通过融合视觉-语言编码器与异构图神经网络引入社会历史与上下文知识，并发布WikiMuSA数据集，实验证明其在隐式或抽象提及上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 从多模态和异构数据中发现并消歧实体是发现科学中的关键挑战，相关知识常是隐式且跨模态分布的。既有视觉-语言模型主要依赖表层的多模态对齐，缺乏对社会历史与上下文知识的利用，在证据模糊或不充分时难以稳健消歧。
AI.method: 提出知识感知架构KARAMEL，将视觉-语言编码器与异构图神经网络融合，建模复杂关系结构并支持上下文推理，从而在模糊或欠定证据下实现鲁棒实体消歧；同时构建WikiMuSA数据集，通过图像、文本描述和结构化上下文知识将艺术品链接到Wikidata实体。
AI.result: 实验表明KARAMEL优于强基线，尤其在隐式或抽象提及场景；消融研究证实领域特定的结构化上下文对学习表达性表征具有关键作用。
AI.conclusion: KARAMEL虽在文化遗产领域实例化，但解决的是通用知识发现问题，可迁移至其他涉及多模态观测与异构背景知识的科学场景；数据集与源代码已公开。

title: Intent-Triggered Anchoring for Multi-Token Format Units in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
summary: In parallel decoding, diffusion language models commit several tokens per forward pass, so co-committed tokens cannot see each other, breaking multi-token format units that parsers need. On ECHO, an open-weight one-step chest X-ray (CXR) report generator, 32.7-36.7% of evaluation reports lack a parseable Impression heading and score as empty. We propose intent-triggered anchoring, a training-free decoding rule that completes a format unit once the model commits its first token, inserting only units with a unique, content-free completion; fallbacks write the unit when the model stops or loops without starting it. On three CXR evaluation sets, the rule raises readable rates from 63.3-67.3% to 100.0% with no regressions and a 95th-percentile latency ratio of 0.68-1.28 against official decoding. Broken headings state findings absent from the reference; adding the heading at the end leaves them in 15.5-31.0% of reports, our rule in at most 0.6%. For math answer markers, the rule raises accuracy in the most parallel setting of five diffusion language models by 5.8-20.8 points on GSM8K and 5.1-17.1 on GSM-Symbolic, held out from tuning. With lenient answer extraction, gains are 3.3-12.5 and 2.7-6.3 points; the rule adds 1.4-8.6 points over a stop-only fallback for four of the five models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的"意图触发锚定"解码规则，在扩散语言模型并行解码时补全格式单元，使CXR报告可解析率从63.3-67.3%升至100%，并在多个数学推理基准上提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 并行解码中一次前向提交多个token，共同提交的token彼此不可见，导致解析器所需的多token格式单元（如标题、答案标记）被破坏。以一步CXR报告生成器ECHO为例，32.7-36.7%的评测报告缺少可解析的Impression标题而被判为空。
AI.method: 提出intent-triggered anchoring：一种免训练的解码规则。当模型提交某格式单元的首个token时即完成该单元，且仅插入具有唯一、无内容完成的单元；若模型停止或循环却未启动该单元，则由回退机制写出该单元。
AI.result: 三个CXR评测集上可读率由63.3-67.3%提升至100.0%，无退化，第95百分位延迟比为0.68-1.28。破损标题会陈述参考中不存在的发现：末尾补加标题仍有15.5-31.0%报告残留，本规则至多0.6%。数学答案标记方面，在五个扩散语言模型的最并行设置下，GSM8K准确率提升5.8-20.8分，GSM-Symbolic（调参外留出）提升5.1-17.1分；宽松答案抽取下增幅为3.3-12.5与2.7-6.3分；相比仅停止回退，五个模型中有四个额外提升1.4-8.6分。
AI.conclusion: 该解码规则无需训练即可有效修复并行解码造成的格式单元断裂，在医学报告生成与数学推理两类任务上同时提升可解析性与准确率，且延迟开销可控。

title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
summary: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience. Simulated users can be stochastic or inconsistent, while environments may contain unreliable tools, incomplete state coverage, and incorrect verifiers. Prior work mainly addresses the resulting instability through reward shaping or denser supervision, while treating these components as fixed. We instead introduce EAU, a meta-agent framework for environment--agent--user co-evolution. During training, EAU monitors trajectories, tool traces, rewards, and training statistics; diagnoses failures and uninformative interactions; and proposes targeted modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. Validated changes are hot-swapped into the ongoing run, allowing the training setup to evolve together with the policy. These adaptations also persist across runs, so later training can build on previously discovered improvements rather than restarting from a fixed setup. We enable this process through an editable symbolic representation of user and environment dynamics, while the agent remains a neural LLM optimized with RL. Across three interactive-agent benchmarks and two backbone models, EAU consistently outperforms prior RL methods, improving the overall score over the strongest baseline by 14.7--15.0% and increasing successful task completion on ColBench by up to 36.7%, showing that co-evolving the training system with the policy can substantially improve multi-turn RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EAU——一个面向环境-智能体-用户协同演化的元智能体框架，用于提升LLM智能体多轮交互训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互训练的学习信号同时受用户模拟器和环境的影响，二者共同塑造智能体的经验。模拟用户可能存在随机性或不一致性，环境则可能包含不可靠工具、状态覆盖不完整以及错误验证器。以往工作主要通过奖励塑形或更密集的监督来缓解由此产生的不稳定性，却将这些组件视为固定不变的。
AI.method: EAU在训练过程中监控轨迹、工具调用记录、奖励和训练统计信息，诊断失败和无信息交互，并针对用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计和RL配置提出有针对性的修改。经校验的修改会被热替换到正在进行的训练中，使训练设置随策略共同演化，并可跨运行持久化保存。实现上采用可编辑的符号化表示来描述用户和环境动态，而智能体仍为使用RL优化的神经LLM。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准和两个骨干模型上，EAU持续优于现有RL方法：相比最强基线整体得分提升14.7%–15.0%，在ColBench上的成功任务完成率最高提升36.7%。
AI.conclusion: 让训练系统与策略协同演化，能够显著改善多轮RL的表现。

title: Deep Learning-based Mechanical Characterization of Synthetically Generated Plant Fibers under Transverse Compression
summary: Plant fibers are increasingly used as sustainable reinforcements in composites, but the intrinsic variability of their microstructure causes substantial scatter in transverse mechanical behavior, complicating composite design. Characterizing this behavior relies on finite element (FE) simulations requiring several minutes of high-performance computing per fiber, making high-throughput characterization across realistic fiber populations impractical. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework replacing this FE bottleneck with a fast pipeline. It includes two coupled recursive U-Nets predicting the step-by-step evolution of fiber deformation and internal stress fields under transverse compression, followed by a regression CNN estimating the transverse Young's modulus from the final stress field. Unlike prior approaches predicting stress fields for fixed configurations or idealized geometries, our framework recursively resolves the full temporal stress evolution for synthetic fibers derived from real hemp cross-sections, with or without a lumen. Trained on 1,000 synthetic fiber geometries with FE ground truth, it reproduces the stress field sequence with a Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) of $0.9574 \pm 0.0074$ and a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of $0.0345 \pm 0.0079$. It estimates transverse Young's modulus with an $R^2$ of $0.938 \pm 0.024$, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of $24.31 \pm 1.23$ MPa, and a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of $5.25 \pm 0.91\%$. Inference requires under one second per fiber versus five minutes per FE simulation, drastically reducing computational cost. This offers a fast, reliable tool for mechanical characterization of synthetic plant fibers, with promising applications in designing natural fiber-reinforced composites.

AI.tldr: 提出深度学习框架替代有限元模拟，递归预测植物纤维横向压缩下的应力场演化并估算横向杨氏模量，推理时间由5分钟降至1秒内。
AI.motivation: 植物纤维微观结构固有的变异性导致其横向力学行为离散度大，难以用于复合材料设计。传统表征依赖有限元模拟，单根纤维需数分钟高性能计算，无法对真实纤维群体进行高通量表征。
AI.method: 构建深度学习流程：两个耦合的递归U-Net逐步预测纤维形变与内部应力场的时间演化，再由回归CNN从最终应力场估算横向杨氏模量。以1,000个合成纤维几何（源自真实大麻横截面，含或不含腔体）及对应有限元真值训练，可递归解析完整时序应力演化，突破以往仅针对固定构型或理想几何的局限。
AI.result: 应力场序列复现的SSIM为0.9574±0.0074，RMSE为0.0345±0.0079；横向杨氏模量估算R²为0.938±0.024，MAE为24.31±1.23 MPa，MAPE为5.25±0.91%。单根纤维推理时间不足1秒，而有限元模拟需5分钟，计算成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为合成植物纤维的力学表征提供了快速可靠的工具，在天然纤维增强复合材料设计中具有应用前景。

title: Support or Magnitude? Characterizing Neuron Relevance for Instruction Data Selection
summary: Model-internal signals, such as neuron activations and gradients, have been used for instruction data selection, yet how neuron relevance should be characterized remains underexplored. In particular, should selection prioritize the magnitude of relevance or how broadly it is distributed across neurons? To investigate this question, we construct sample-level relevance profiles using AttnLRP-guided attribution and introduce two complementary criteria: Effective Relevance Support (ERS), which measures the effective support of positive relevance, and Positive Relevance Magnitude (PRM), which captures its average strength. Our analyses reveal that these characterizations produce distinct sample rankings and selection preferences despite sharing the same underlying relevance profiles. On Qwen2 models, PRM exhibits stronger associations with activation-based selection, whereas ERS produces substantially different rankings. These differences extend to task composition, within-task sample preferences, and semantic selection patterns, with varying degrees of agreement across backbones. Experiments across three language models and five downstream benchmarks demonstrate the practical value of relevance-guided selection, with ERS achieving the best overall average performance rank among the evaluated methods. Our findings highlight that how neuron relevance is distributed and characterized, rather than its magnitude alone, matters for instruction data selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经元相关性应如何刻画以用于指令数据选择，提出基于AttnLRP的样本级相关性刻画，并设计ERS（有效相关性支撑）与PRM（正相关性强度）两个互补准则。实验表明，二者虽共享同一相关性剖面，却产生不同的样本排序与选择偏好，说明相关性的分布方式而非仅其强度对指令数据选择更重要，ERS在整体平均性能上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 模型内部信号（如神经元激活与梯度）已被用于指令数据选择，但神经元相关性应如何刻画仍缺乏深入探讨。核心问题在于：选择时应优先考虑相关性的强度，还是其在神经元上分布的广度，这一问题尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 基于AttnLRP引导的归因构建样本级相关性剖profile；据此提出两个互补准则：ERS（Effective Relevance Support，度量正相关性的有效支撑/分布广度）与PRM（Positive Relevance Magnitude，度量其平均强度）。在Qwen2等模型上分析二者产生的样本排序差异，并在三个语言模型和五个下游基准上进行选择实验验证。
AI.result: ERS与PRM虽基于同一相关性剖面，却产生不同的样本排序与选择偏好。在Qwen2上，PRM与基于激活的选择关联更强，而ERS给出显著不同的排序；差异进一步体现在任务构成、任务内样本偏好与语义选择模式上，且在不同骨干网络间一致性程度不同。在三个语言模型和五个下游基准的实验中，相关性引导的选择具有实用价值，ERS在所评估方法中取得最佳整体平均性能排名。
AI.conclusion: 神经元相关性的分布方式及其刻画方式，而非仅其强度，对指令数据选择至关重要。相关性剖面的不同刻画会产生实质不同的选择行为与下游表现，提示未来数据选择方法应同时关注相关性的支撑广度与强度。

title: Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Working in progress
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is reshaping how large language models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities, yet the optimizers used remain largely inherited from teacher-forcing training. This raises a fundamental question: does RLVR induce a distinct optimization geometry that calls for a different optimizer? We investigate this question through the spectral structure of LLM gradients and find that gradient energy progressively concentrates into a shrinking effective subspace, which is characteristic of RLVR, as it is absent under supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and is largely removed when the verifiable reward is replaced by a random one. Moreover, the rank required to capture a fixed fraction of gradient energy steadily decreases over training, revealing that the effective dimensionality of useful updates itself evolves with training. These findings motivate a new optimization principle: rather than prescribing the update rank externally, an optimizer should adapt its rank to the evolving spectral structure of the gradient. We introduce Ares (Adaptive Rank-Effective Spectral Optimization), which estimates the effective update rank from the gradient's spectral energy distribution, tracks its evolution, and confines the gradient signal driving each update to the resulting low-rank subspace. Across LLMs of different scales, Ares improves accuracy over widely used optimizers and generalizes across RLVR algorithms and tasks. Results suggest that effective optimization may require optimizers to be designed around the geometry and dynamics of the training process. We release the code and data at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Ares.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了RLVR梯度能量集中于收缩的低秩子空间这一独特谱结构，提出自适应秩有效谱优化器Ares，在多种LLM规模上优于现有优化器。
AI.motivation: RLVR正重塑LLM推理能力的获取方式，但其优化器仍沿用教师强制训练（teacher-forcing）的优化器。核心疑问是：RLVR是否诱导了独特的优化几何结构，从而需要不同的优化器？
AI.method: 通过分析LLM梯度的谱结构，发现RLVR下梯度能量逐步集中于收缩的有效子空间；据此提出优化原则——优化器应使更新秩自适应于梯度不断演化的谱结构。据此设计Ares（Adaptive Rank-Effective Spectral Optimization），从梯度谱能量分布估计有效更新秩，跟踪其演化，并将驱动每次更新的梯度信号限制在所得低秩子空间内。
AI.result: 梯度能量集中现象为RLVR所特有：SFT下不存在，将可验证奖励替换为随机奖励后基本消失。捕获固定比例梯度能量所需的秩随训练持续下降，说明有效更新维度本身随训练演化。在不同规模的LLM上，Ares相比广泛使用的优化器提升了准确率，并在多种RLVR算法与任务上具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 有效优化可能需要围绕训练过程的几何结构与动态特性来设计优化器，而非沿用教师强制训练的优化器。代码与数据已开源。

title: PatTransBench: an ipc-stratified, multi-dimensional benchmark for patent machine translation evaluation
summary: We present PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation (PatMT) benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol. The benchmark comprises 6,000 short-text (sentence/claim) and 6,000 long-text (paragraph) pairs, evenly split across three language pairs and both translation directions, built via IPC-section-stratified sampling and dualthreshold quality gating from upstream patent-family parallel corpora. The evaluation protocol spans literal n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE-L, chrF), cross-lingual semantic textual similarity (CLSTS), 38-probe-language consistency testing, and serving performance under concurrency. A case study on PatMT2-7B and its fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit variants reveals direction-dependent quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns across quantization schemes that are invisible to single-metric evaluation. We plan to release the benchmark, protocol, and case-study results upon publication to support reproducible PatMT evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出PatTransBench专利机器翻译基准，含12000条中英/日/韩语料与四维评测协议，并通过案例研究揭示量化效应。
AI.motivation: 现有专利机器翻译评测缺乏覆盖中英/日/韩多方向、兼具短文本与长文本、且融合翻译质量与serving性能的统一基准与协议，单指标评测易掩盖方向依赖性问题。
AI.method: 构建PatTransBench：对上游专利族平行语料采用IPC section分层采样与双阈值质量门控，生成6000条短文本与6000条长文本对，均匀覆盖三个语言对及双向翻译；设计四维评测协议，包括字面n-gram重叠（BLEU、ROUGE-L、chrF）、跨语言语义文本相似度（CLSTS）、38探针语言一致性测试与并发下的serving性能；对PatMT2-7B及其fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit变体开展案例研究。
AI.result: 案例研究显示量化效应具有方向依赖性且被聚合分数掩盖，不同量化方案间存在非单调的语言失效模式，此类问题在单指标评测下不可见。
AI.conclusion: PatTransBench为专利机器翻译提供可复现的多维评测基准与协议，呼吁从单一指标转向综合评测；基准、协议与案例结果将于论文发表后开源。

title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

AI.tldr: AlignCache：一种闭环特征缓存框架，通过相位自适应预算路由、闭环阈值校准和动量增强草稿合成，将去噪调度从静态风险累积器转变为反馈驱动的自校正控制器，在视频扩散模型上实现更优的加速-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型的无训练加速方法（特征缓存）存在三大缺陷：1）依赖与实际生成质量不匹配的启发式差异度量；2）使用单一全局阈值，忽略了去噪过程不同阶段的异质性动态；3）从不验证预算估计与真实近似误差的一致性，导致系统性偏差无法被纠正。
AI.method: 提出AlignCache，包含三个紧耦合组件：(1) 相位自适应预算路由：将去噪轨迹划分为结构上不同的阶段，每阶段由独立阈值和老化感知（staleness-aware）保护机制控制；(2) 闭环阈值校准：在无分类器引导（CFG）输出层面进行反事实误差测量，通过EMA反馈回路在线调整决策边界；(3) 动量增强草稿合成：结合方向-幅度门控残差外推与锚点引导的无条件校正。
AI.result: 在多个当前最先进的视频生成模型上，AlignCache均能持续取得优于基线的加速-质量权衡表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过将缓存调度建模为反馈驱动、自校正的闭环控制器，AlignCache有效解决了启发式度量失准、全局阈值失配和预算估计偏差累积的问题，为视频扩散模型的高效推理提供了新的范式。代码已开源。

title: Know Yourself and Know Your Neighbour: A Syntactically Informed Self-Supervised Compositional Sentence Representation Learning Framework using a Recursive Hypernetwork
summary: Sentence representation learning is still an open challenge in Natural Language Processing. In this work, we propose a new self-supervised framework for learning sentence representations, using a special type of neural network called a recursive hypernetwork. Our proposed model composes the representation of a sentence from representations of words by applying a recursive composition through the parse tree. We maintain a separate syntactic and semantic representation, and the semantic composition is guided by the information from the syntactic representation. To train this model, we introduce a novel set of six self-supervised tasks. By analysing the performance on 7 probing tasks, we validate that the generated sentence representation encodes richer linguistic information than both averaging baselines and state-of-the-art alternatives. Furthermore, we assess the impact of the six proposed self-supervised training tasks through ablation studies. We also demonstrate that the representations generated by our model are stable for sentences of varying length and that the semantic composition operators adapt to different syntactic categories\footnote{Code available: https://github.com/vasudev2020/codi/tree/main}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于递归超网络的自监督句子表示学习框架，将句法表示与语义表示分离、以句法信息引导语义组合，并设计六项自监督训练任务，在7个探测任务上验证了表示质量优于平均基线及现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 句子表示学习仍是NLP领域的开放挑战；现有方法往往未充分利用句法结构，且难以同时编码丰富的句法和语义信息。
AI.method: 采用递归超网络（recursive hypernetwork），按句法分析树递归地由词表示组合成句子表示；分别维护句法与语义两套表示，语义组合过程由句法表示信息引导；并引入六种新的自监督训练任务进行训练。
AI.result: 在7个探测任务上的分析表明，生成的句子表示编码的语言学信息多于平均基线及当前最优替代方法；通过消融实验评估了六项自监督任务各自的贡献；模型表示对不同长度句子保持稳定，且语义组合算子能适应不同句法范畴。
AI.conclusion: 递归超网络结合句法引导的语义组合与多任务自监督学习，可有效提升句子表示的语言学信息含量与稳定性。

title: NoduleFlow: Automatic 3D Lung Nodule Detection and Segmentation
summary: Low dose Computed Tomography (CT) is the standard imaging modality for lung cancer screening. On CT scans, lung cancer typically manifests as pulmonary nodules, whose manual identification is time-consuming and prone to observer variability, image quality limitations, and suboptimal reading conditions. Moreover, subtle temporal changes are often difficult to quantify reliably in CT scans from the same patient across follow-up examinations. Deep learning-based approaches for the automatic detection and segmentation of lung nodules have demonstrated improved accuracy and efficiency. However, most existing approaches provide only coarse region-of-interest localisation, rely on prior lesion annotations or human supervision, or treat detection and segmentation as separate tasks. In this work, we present NoduleFlow, a framework for lung nodule detection, classification, and segmentation directly from series of CT volumes. Our proposal consists of four interconnected modules and operates in an automated manner at inference time, without requiring prior lesion annotations, manual initialisation, or region-of-interest pre-selection. We further investigate whether nodule localization benefits from the propagation of candidate regions across follow-up scans through inter-scan registration fields, as opposed to conventional independent per-scan analysis. The generalisability of the framework is systematically evaluated across four independent datasets. The results underscore the potential of automated pipelines for lung nodule analysis in screening and diagnostic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoduleFlow框架，可直接从CT序列中自动完成肺结节检测、分类与分割，无需病灶标注、人工初始化或感兴趣区域预选，并探究跨随访扫描的候选区域传播是否有利于结节定位，在四个独立数据集上验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: 低剂量CT是肺癌筛查的标准手段，肺结节手动识别耗时且存在观察者差异、图像质量限制和阅片条件不理想等问题；同一患者随访CT中细微的时间变化难以可靠量化。现有深度学习方法大多仅提供粗略的感兴趣区域定位、依赖先验病灶标注或人工监督，或将检测与分割视为独立任务。
AI.method: 提出NoduleFlow框架，包含四个相互关联的模块，推理时全自动运行，无需先验病灶标注、人工初始化或感兴趣区域预选，直接从CT体序列完成肺结节检测、分类和分割；并研究通过扫描间配准场将候选区域跨随访扫描传播，对比传统的逐扫描独立分析，以考察其对结节定位的增益。
AI.result: 在四个独立数据集上系统评估了框架的泛化能力，结果表明自动化流程在肺癌筛查和诊断场景中具有应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: NoduleFlow实现了端到端、免标注的肺结节检测、分类与分割，并在多数据集上展现出良好泛化性，凸显了自动化流程在肺结节筛查与诊断中的价值。

title: VLA-GAUGE: Systematically Evaluating Generalization and Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have achieved high success rates on familiar manipulation tasks, yet it remains unclear whether such scores reflect genuine zero-shot generalization and perturbation robustness. Existing evaluation frameworks provide limited capability-level diagnosis and combinatorial perturbation coverage, often without connecting diagnosis to targeted model refinement. We introduce VLA-GAUGE, a diagnostic framework that unifies both evaluations under a shared executable task representation. It combines (1) paired in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks across six capability suites, (2) single-factor sensitivity analysis with combinatorial perturbation screening and evaluation, and (3) diagnosis-driven refinement through targeted data augmentation and model fine-tuning. We evaluate 12 VLAs spanning different model sizes and action-modeling paradigms under a unified protocol. We find that (1) The mean Zero-Shot Score on VLA-GAUGE is only 22.3%, with SimpleVLA-RL scoring 8.0% and ranking second to last among the evaluated models. (2) Under three representative combinatorial perturbation configurations, the mean R-Score is 9.3. (3) Diagnosis-driven fine-tuning improves $π_{0.5}$'s zero-shot generalization and robustness under a selected perturbation combination on held-out scenarios by 72.4 and 31.8 scoring points, respectively; the latter exceeds the 10.9-point gain from LIBERO-Plus single-factor fine-tuning despite fewer successful training trajectories. These results show that high reported success rates on familiar manipulation tasks do not guarantee strong zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks or robustness to combinatorial perturbations, while diagnostic evaluation provides actionable signals for targeted model improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断框架VLA-GAUGE，统一评测VLA的零样本泛化与组合扰动鲁棒性，并通过诊断驱动微调实现定向改进。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA在熟悉任务上成功率高，但是否代表真正的零样本泛化与扰动鲁棒性尚不明确；已有评测框架缺乏能力级诊断与组合扰动覆盖，且未将诊断与模型改进相连。
AI.method: VLA-GAUGE在共享可执行任务表示下统一两类评测：(1)六项能力套件的分布内/分布外配对任务；(2)单因素敏感性分析与组合扰动的筛选和评估；(3)通过定向数据增强与模型微调实现诊断驱动改进。在统一协议下评测12个不同规模与动作建模范式的VLA。
AI.result: 平均零样本得分仅22.3%，SimpleVLA-RL为8.0%且倒数第二；三种代表性组合扰动配置下平均R-Score为9.3；诊断驱动微调使π_{0.5}在留出场景上的零样本泛化与所选扰动组合鲁棒性分别提升72.4与31.8分，后者超过LIBERO-Plus单因素微调的10.9分增益，且训练成功轨迹更少。
AI.conclusion: 熟悉任务上的高成功率并不保证对未见任务的强零样本泛化或对组合扰动的鲁棒性，而诊断式评测可为模型定向改进提供可执行信号。

title: Dense Endoluminal Mapping and Localisation from Monocular Bronchoscopy
summary: Bronchoscopy inserts a camera through the airways to diagnose endoluminal disease. Locating the camera along the airway usually requires additional equipment, such as an electromagnetic tracker and a preoperative CT scan. In this paper, we investigate the use of the monocular camera stream to localise the bronchoscope without requiring additional sensing. We introduce a monocular SLAM system that localises the tip of a bronchoscope and reconstructs the airway surface around it from RGB video alone. A Depth Anything 3 backbone, fine-tuned on over a million photorealistic airway renderings, returns metric per-pixel depth and is the system's only source of scale. DINOv3 features routed through a custom cross-attention matcher supply sub-pixel correspondences on mucosa where classical descriptors fail. Both enter a factor graph alongside a dense constraint from projective iterative closest point (ICP) registration against the system's own running reconstruction, so surface evidence stabilises the directions the visual factors leave weakly observable. On six airways rendered from patient CT scans, the system reaches 26.1 mm mean absolute trajectory error and 77.5% mean surface F-score. Its mean surface accuracy exceeds that of five recent monocular SLAM and feed-forward baselines. MASt3R-SLAM, which fits a free scale to the ground truth, has a lower mean trajectory error (22.0 mm). ORB-SLAM3 completes only two of the six airways, whereas our system completes all six and also reconstructs two ex vivo specimens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单目SLAM系统，仅利用支气管镜RGB视频即可定位镜尖并重建气道表面，无需电磁追踪器或术前CT。系统以微调Depth Anything 3提供度量深度与尺度，DINOv3特征经交叉注意力匹配器提供亚像素对应，并结合投影ICP稠密约束构成因子图。在6条患者CT渲染气道上，平均绝对轨迹误差26.1 mm，平均表面F-score 77.5%，优于五个近期基线，且全部six条气道均能完成重建。
AI.motivation: 支气管镜定位通常依赖电磁追踪器和术前CT等额外设备，增加了临床复杂度与成本。作者希望仅用单目相机视频流完成支气管镜定位与气道表面重建，从而摆脱额外传感需求。
AI.method: 提出单目SLAM系统：以Depth Anything 3为主干，在超过一百万张真实感气道渲染图上微调，输出度量级逐像素深度并作为系统唯一尺度来源；DINOv3特征经定制交叉注意力匹配器，在经典描述子失效的黏膜上提供亚像素对应；二者与投影ICP配准系统自身运行重建所得的稠密约束共同进入因子图，用表面证据稳定视觉因子弱可观测方向。
AI.result: 在6条由患者CT渲染的气道上，系统平均绝对轨迹误差为26.1 mm，平均表面F-score为77.5%；平均表面精度优于五个近期单目SLAM与前馈基线。MASt3R-SLAM因对真值拟合自由尺度，轨迹误差更低（22.0 mm）。ORB-SLAM3仅完成6条气道中的2条，而本系统完成全部6条，并额外重建了两个离体标本。
AI.conclusion: 单目视频结合度量深度与语义特征匹配，可在不依赖额外传感的情况下实现支气管镜定位与气道表面重建，表面精度优于近期基线，鲁棒性高于ORB-SLAM3；但轨迹误差仍高于可自由拟合尺度的MASt3R-SLAM，提示尺度与轨迹精度仍有提升空间。

title: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes is an important path toward controllable video generation for filmmaking: these scenes provide modifiable, renderable visual proxies that enable explicit control over scene layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. To evaluate agents' ability to reconstruct editable dynamic 3D scenes from dynamic reference videos, we introduce CineRecon, a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips. The reference videos span film, real-world footage, and games. Given a complete video, an agent uses tools to construct, animate, render, and refine its reconstruction. We evaluate this task under three representation settings: Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed. These settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while retaining the same requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, and subject dynamics. This design tests whether agents can reproduce the events in a video when detailed appearance is unnecessary, and how performance changes as representation requirements increase. For evaluation, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames across 11 categories, grouped into camera, static, and dynamic consistency dimensions. We evaluate 12 models using their corresponding agent harnesses and find failures across all three dimensions. Subject motions and interactions remain difficult to reproduce even under the Proxy setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 CineRecon 基准，用 50 个参考视频与 360 个评测片段考察智能体从视频重建可编辑动态 3D 场景的能力，并在 Proxy、Simplified、Detailed 三种表示设置下，用带时间戳的对齐检查表和视觉语言裁判从相机、静态、动态三类一致性维度评估 12 个模型，发现三维度均存在失败。
AI.motivation: 将参考视频重建为可编辑动态 3D 场景是通向可控视频生成的重要路径，因为此类场景可作为可修改、可渲染的视觉代理，对场景布局、主体动作与相机行为提供显式控制；但此前缺乏面向“智能体从动态视频重建可编辑动态 3D 场景”的系统评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 CineRecon 基准，含 50 个参考视频与 360 个标注评测片段，视频覆盖电影、真实拍摄与游戏。给定完整视频，智能体借助工具完成构建、动画、渲染与精修。评测在 Proxy、Simplified、Detailed 三种表示设置下进行，几何与外观要求递增，而空间关系、相机行为与主体动态要求保持不变。评测采用检查表，将可观测属性与事件关联到具体实体和时间；由视觉语言裁判对时间戳对齐的参考帧与渲染帧在 11 个类别上比较，归为相机一致性、静态一致性、动态一致性三个维度。
AI.result: 使用各自智能体框架评测 12 个模型，在三个一致性维度上均发现失败；即使在 Proxy 设置下，主体运动与交互仍难以复现。
AI.conclusion: CineRecon 为视频驱动的可编辑动态 3D 场景重建提供了细粒度、可控表示要求的评测基准，表明当前智能体在相机、静态与动态一致性方面仍普遍不足，主体运动与交互是突出瓶颈。

title: Variational Filtering for Bayesian Last Layers with an Independent Binary Probit Surrogate
summary: Modern deep classifiers trained by gradient descent need many passes over the data to become accurate, and even then are not always well calibrated; post-hoc temperature scaling corrects calibration after training but cannot influence training-time accuracy or convergence. We propose a variational filtering algorithm for the last layer of deep classifiers, whose parameters are treated as the latent state of a linear-Gaussian state-space model. Each mini-batch is assimilated by an exact prediction step followed by a closed-form variational update, made conjugate by an independent binary probit (IBProbit) surrogate for the categorical likelihood. The filter's process noise stabilises the updates under feature drift and keeps the predictive distribution from collapsing to a point estimate, allowing the same procedure to be used for linear probing on a frozen backbone and for full-network fine-tuning. We evaluate on DINOv3 backbones against two baselines tuned under an identical protocol: AdamW with cross-entropy and post-hoc temperature scaling, and Variational Bayesian Last Layers (VBLL). As a linear probe on frozen features, IBProbit attains the best accuracy and negative log-likelihood on all five downstream tasks at the largest backbone, and on two of the five at the smallest. In out-of-distribution detection with CIFAR probes on the largest backbone, IBProbit reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% true-positive rate by a factor of 1.4 to 3.2 relative to the better of the two baselines, on all three dataset pairs. When the whole network is fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k, IBProbit reaches the final performance of the cross-entropy baseline in half the wall-clock time.

AI.tldr: 提出一种变分滤波算法IBProbit，将深度分类器最后一层参数视为线性高斯状态空间模型的隐状态，通过预测步和共轭变分更新处理每个mini-batch，兼顾训练收敛速度、准确率与校准。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降训练的深度分类器需多次遍历数据才准确，且校准不佳；事后温度缩放仅修正校准，无法影响训练期准确率与收敛。作者希望用一个统一的概率框架同时改善训练效率、精度与预测不确定性建模。
AI.method: 将最后一层参数建模为线性高斯状态空间模型的隐状态；每个mini-batch先做精确预测步，再做闭式变分更新；用独立二值probit（IBProbit）代理类别似然以保持共轭性；过程噪声在特征漂移下稳定更新并防止预测分布坍缩为点估计；该流程既可用于冻结backbone的线性探测，也可用于全网络微调。
AI.result: 在DINOv3 backbone上与AdamW+交叉熵+温度缩放、VBLL两个基线在同一协议下对比：最大backbone的五个下游任务线性探测中IBProbit精度与NLL均最优，最小backbone上两项任务最优；最大backbone的CIFAR OOD检测中，三对数据集上FPR@95TPR较更优基线降低1.4–3.2倍；ImageNet-1k全网络微调时以一半墙钟时间达到交叉熵基线最终性能。
AI.conclusion: IBProbit作为最后一层的变分滤波器，在精度、负对数似然、OOD检测与训练效率上一致优于或匹配基线，验证了将贝叶斯状态空间滤波与共轭变分更新结合用于深度分类器末端层的有效性。

title: Code-Interactive Visual Reasoning for Financial Candlestick Understanding
