It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. Evidence annotations are grounded to rendered pages and HTML element identifiers, and queries are filtered with a cleaning pipeline targeting clarity, correctness, closedness, and the absence of explicit layout references. We evaluate leading single-vector and multi-vector visual retrievers together with diagnostic retrieval settings such as document-context scoring, query splitting, reranking, and round-robin ensembles. The strongest evaluated configuration reaches 69.3 nDCGAll@10 and 80.6 RecallAll@10 under structure-balanced Macro evaluation, but source- and evidence-structure breakdowns show that cross-document retrieval remains substantially harder than single-page retrieval, and that document-context scoring is especially helpful for within-document multi-page queries. VL-DocIR exposes these failure modes and provides a more demanding target for visual long-document retrieval. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VL-DocIR，一个面向证据完整的长文档视觉检索的页面级基准，覆盖单页、文档内多页和跨文档证据结构，并评估多种视觉检索器揭示跨文档检索仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的文档检索评测偏重短文档和单一相关页面，导致排行榜性能与真实长文档检索之间存在差距——真实场景中回答问题所需的证据可能跨越多个页面甚至多个文档。
AI.method: 构建 VL-DocIR 基准：由 29,641 个 HTML 原生文档渲染为 388,548 张页面图像，来源于 Wikipedia、arXiv、PubMed 和 SEC 代理声明；含 271,760 条查询，覆盖 23 个领域和六种证据结构（单页、文档内多页、跨文档）；证据标注锚定到渲染页面与 HTML 元素标识符，并通过针对清晰性、正确性、闭合性及无显式布局引用的清洗流程过滤查询。评测领先的单向量与多向量视觉检索器，并采用文档上下文打分、查询拆分、重排序和轮询集成等诊断设置。
AI.result: 在结构均衡的 Macro 评测下，最强配置达到 69.3 nDCGAll@10 和 80.6 RecallAll@10；但按来源和证据结构分解显示，跨文档检索明显难于单页检索，且文档上下文打分对文档内多页查询尤为有益。
AI.conclusion: VL-DocIR 揭示了视觉长文档检索的失败模式，为证据完整的长文档检索提供了更具挑战性的目标，数据集与代码将公开。

title: PerturbBridge: Direct Phenotypic Supervision for Cellular Perturbation Generation
summary: Virtual cell models should capture phenotypes induced by specific perturbations. However, image-based models are typically trained and evaluated to match real-image distributions, which alone does not explicitly prioritize perturbation-specific biological responses. Recent approaches add biological signals through reinforcement-learning post-training or inference-time steering, raising a central question: where should biological response information enter the generative pipeline? We introduce PerturbBridge, a stochastic data-to-data bridge model that directly supervises perturbation-specific phenotypes in predicted perturbed images during training. PerturbBridge jointly optimizes bridge regression and differentiable biological response losses, with biological gradients passing through a frozen image encoder. We further introduce perturbation-response evaluations based on downstream classification and retrieval. Across three microscopy benchmarks for perturbation profiling and subcellular imaging, PerturbBridge surpasses CellFlux in biological fidelity, image quality, and sampling efficiency. On BBBC021, mechanism-of-action classification improves by 5.66 and 7.5 percentage points with morphological and learned visual features, respectively. On JUMP and AllenCell, retrieval Hit@10 and Hit@1 improve by 1.77 and 7.15 percentage points, respectively. On BBBC021 and JUMP, PerturbBridge achieves lower FID with 80% fewer model evaluations than CellFlux. Overall, these results show that directly supervising perturbation responses during training improves phenotypic fidelity while enabling efficient cellular image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/PerturbBridge.

AI.tldr: PerturbBridge是一种随机数据到数据的桥模型，在训练阶段直接对预测扰动图像中的扰动特异性表型进行监督，联合优化桥回归与可微生物响应损失，生物梯度经冻结图像编码器回传。在三个显微基准上，其生物保真度、图像质量与采样效率均优于CellFlux。
AI.motivation: 虚拟细胞模型应能捕捉特定扰动诱导的表型，但现有图像生成模型仅以匹配真实图像分布为训练与评估目标，未显式优化扰动特异性生物响应。近期方法通过强化学习后训练或推理时引导注入生物信号，因此核心问题在于：生物响应信息应在生成流程的何处介入。
AI.method: 提出PerturbBridge，一种随机数据到数据（data-to-data）桥模型，在训练时对预测扰动图像直接监督扰动特异性表型。模型联合优化桥回归损失与可微生物响应损失，生物梯度通过冻结的图像编码器传播。此外引入基于下游分类与检索的扰动-响应评估协议，在三个显微基准（扰动谱分析与亚细胞成像）上进行验证。
AI.result: 在生物保真度、图像质量和采样效率上超越CellFlux。BBBC021上，机制分类（MoA）在形态学特征与学习视觉特征下分别提升5.66与7.5个百分点；JUMP与AllenCell上检索Hit@10与Hit@1分别提升1.77与7.15个百分点；BBBC021与JUMP上以少80%的模型评估次数取得更低FID。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在训练阶段直接监督扰动响应可提升表型保真度，同时实现高效的细胞图像生成，为虚拟细胞建模中生物响应信息的注入位置提供了有效方案。

title: A unified three-branch deep learning framework for automated detection and counting of wildlife in aerial imagery
summary: Automating aerial wildlife surveys requires reliable animal detection, consistent delineation of observation strips, and correction for repeated coverage between successive images. We present a unified three-branch deep learning framework that integrates these tasks through WildSeg, WildMatch and WildDet. WildSeg combines rod segmentation with geometric refinement to delineate counting strips from aircraft-mounted markers. WildMatch uses teacher-student distillation to learn dense image correspondences and identify overlapping survey areas without relying on geolocation metadata. WildDet combines dual-scale detection with feature fusion, density supervision and empty-image gating to support animal detection and counting. We evaluated the framework using oblique aerial imagery of four antelope species from the Great Nile Migration Landscape in South Sudan. WildSeg achieved reliable rod extraction, while WildMatch approached teacher-level accuracy with a substantially lighter and faster model. Both modules maintained high accuracy on resized images, improving processing efficiency. WildDet improved detection performance across all four species and reduced detection-based count MAE, RMSE and mean bias by 21.0%, 4.6% and 27.8%, respectively, relative to YOLO11. By connecting spatial survey constraints with animal detection, the framework provides a practical and computationally efficient approach to processing large aerial image collections for wildlife monitoring and population surveys.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三分支深度学习框架（WildSeg、WildMatch、WildDet），分别解决航拍野生动物调查中的计数条带划分、图像重叠匹配与动物检测计数问题，并在南苏丹四种羚羊的斜向航拍图像上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动化航拍野生动物调查面临三大挑战：可靠的动物检测、观测条带的一致划分，以及连续图像间重复覆盖的校正。现有方法难以统一处理这些任务，且常依赖地理定位元数据。
AI.method: 构建统一三分支框架：WildSeg结合杆状分割与几何细化，从机载标记中划分计数条带；WildMatch采用教师-学生蒸馏学习稠密图像对应关系，在不依赖地理定位元数据的情况下识别重叠调查区域；WildDet融合双尺度检测、特征融合、密度监督与空图像门控，支持动物检测与计数。
AI.result: 在大尼罗河迁徙景观（南苏丹）四种羚羊的斜向航拍图像上评估：WildSeg实现可靠杆状提取；WildMatch以更轻更快的模型接近教师级精度；两模块在缩放图像上保持高精度并提升处理效率；WildDet在四种物种上均提升检测性能，相较YOLO11将基于检测的计数MAE、RMSE和平均偏差分别降低21.0%、4.6%和27.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将空间调查约束与动物检测相连接，该框架为处理大规模航拍图像集提供了实用且计算高效的方案，适用于野生动物监测与种群调查。

title: UZHCL_for_the_win at Touche: Encoder Fine-Tuning, Synthetic Augmentation, and an Underpowered Encoder-LLM Comparison
comment: 19 pages. Working notes for Touche at CLEF 2026 (Jena, Germany)
summary: Online discussions on platforms like Reddit are a productive testbed for fallacy detection: short texts, broad topical range, and the full inventory of informal fallacies. The Touche 2026 lab at CLEF formalises this as a shared task on a Reddit-derived corpus that combines fallacy detection with argument-scheme classification. This paper describes our participation in all three subtasks (ST1 binary fallacy detection, ST2 eight-way fallacy classification, ST3 four-way argument-scheme classification) and both evaluation tracks. Our submitted systems are fine-tuned RoBERTa-large encoders with task-specific heads, augmented with a small batch of LLM-generated synthetic contrastive pairs; for ST2 and ST3 on the enhanced track we additionally added confidence-filtered pseudo-labelled examples from the unlabelled pool. A wider backbone comparison spanning additional encoders (DeBERTa-v3, ModernBERT) and an LLM track (four Qwen variants from 3B to 32B, zero-shot through CoT-LoRA) showed no validated benefit over RoBERTa-large at this corpus scale, with 5-fold variance wide enough that we call the comparison underpowered rather than settled. We also characterise how much of the enhanced track's lift reflects organiser-rewritten inputs carrying label information rather than genuine argument clarification. On the official Touche 2026 test set our systems ranked first on both base-track classification cells (ST2 and ST3) and second on both binary-detection (ST1) tracks, with the two enhanced-track classification cells topped by cascaded and multitask systems. We close with the rare-class limitation on ST3 and the most useful follow-ups. Code: https://github.com/psychias/fallacy_detection_clef_2026

AI.tldr: 本文报告了 CLEF 2026 Touche 实验室谬误检测与论证图式分类共享任务的参赛系统：以 RoBERTa-large 微调编码器加任务专用头为核心，辅以少量 LLM 生成的对比对；增强赛道额外引入置信度过滤的伪标注样本。官方测试集上获得基础赛道 ST2/ST3 第一、ST1 两个赛道第二。
AI.motivation: Reddit 类在线讨论具有短文本、主题广、非形式谬误种类齐全的特点，是谬误检测的理想试验场。Touche 2026 将其形式化为结合谬误检测与论证图式分类的共享任务，本文旨在为该任务的全部三个子任务与两个评测赛道提供系统方案并厘清各技术组件的实际贡献。
AI.method: 主干系统为带任务专用分类头的微调 RoBERTa-large 编码器；数据增强使用小批量 LLM 生成的合成对比对；在增强赛道（enhanced track）的 ST2 与 ST3 上，额外从无标注池中加入经置信度过滤的伪标注样本。此外进行更广泛的骨干对比：包括 DeBERTa-v3、ModernBERT 等编码器，以及 LLM 赛道（四个 Qwen 变体，3B 至 32B，从零样本到 CoT-LoRA）。作者还分析了增强赛道增益中有多少来自组织者改写输入所携带的标签信息，而非真正的论证澄清。
AI.result: 在官方 Touche 2026 测试集上，系统在基础赛道的两个分类单元（ST2、ST3）排名第一，在两个二分类检测赛道（ST1）排名第二；增强赛道的两个分类单元由级联（cascaded）与多任务（multitask）系统占据首位。骨干对比显示，在本文语料规模下，其他编码器与 LLM 方案相对 RoBERTa-large 均未表现出可验证的增益，且 5 折方差较大，作者据此认为该对比统计功效不足，尚不能下定论。
AI.conclusion: RoBERTa-large 加任务专用头配合轻量合成对比数据增强是该语料规模下的强基线；LLM 与更大骨干的收益未能被验证，受限于方差与统计功效。作者同时指出 ST3 上稀有类别仍存在性能瓶颈，并讨论了增强赛道增益的性质以及若干最有价值的后续研究方向。

title: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge. While recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as knowledge sources, the question of how deeply such guidance should be integrated into a vision language architecture remains underexplored. In this work, we generate structured reasoning guidance, visual focus concepts, distractor elements and external knowledge using Llama~3.3~70B and systematically compare two integration strategies within a unified frozen ViT + FLAN-T5 framework on the OK-VQA benchmark: decision level late fusion and attention-matrix injection. Contrary to the prevailing assumption that deeper integration is superior, we find that shallow late fusion achieves the strongest results (39.4% exact match, +10.0 over the no guidance baseline), outperforming deep attention modification (31.8%) under data scarce fine-tuning. We further contribute an LLM based augmentation pipeline that expands training data more than tenfold via question paraphrasing. Our findings indicate that integration depth must be matched to the data regime.

AI.tldr: 该研究在冻结的ViT+FLAN-T5框架下比较知识注入深度：决策级后融合显著优于注意力矩阵注入，表明数据稀缺时浅层融合更优。
AI.motivation: 知识型VQA需图像外部的常识与事实知识。已有工作用LLM作为知识源，但"LLM引导应以多深程度融入视觉语言架构"这一问题尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 用Llama 3.3 70B生成结构化推理引导、视觉焦点概念、干扰元素与外部知识；在统一冻结ViT+FLAN-T5框架下的OK-VQA基准上对比两种集成策略——决策级后融合与注意力矩阵注入，并在数据稀缺的微调条件下评测；同时提出基于LLM的数据增强流程，通过问题改写将训练数据扩充十倍以上。
AI.result: 浅层后融合取得最佳结果（精确匹配39.4%，较无引导基线提升10.0个百分点），优于深度注意力修改（31.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 与"集成越深越好"的普遍假设相反，集成深度需与数据规模相匹配；数据稀缺场景下浅层融合更有效。

title: Scaling Unified Multimodal Models to Long-Horizon Interleaved Generation
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) provide an interface for interleaved text-image generation, where generated visual states can directly inform subsequent reasoning and synthesis. However, existing systems are still primarily demonstrated on short trajectories or simplified visual content. We develop a large UMM natively trained on interleaved multimodal data, with strong capabilities in image synthesis, text rendering, complex composition, and multimodal planning, and study how to extend these native capabilities to substantially longer autoregressive trajectories. The main challenge is that generated images continuously accumulate in context: irrelevant or imperfect visual states interfere with future synthesis, while previously established characters and scenes must still be recovered after long intervals. We introduce a visual-memory framework that maintains persistent visual references, selectively retrieves scene-relevant historical states while preserving the complete semantic history, and uses few-step self-rollout to adapt the model to imperfect generated histories. We further introduce LongMIG-Bench for evaluating long-horizon text-to-multi-image and image-to-multi-image generation. Our model achieves high-fidelity long-horizon interleaved generation with strong character and scene consistency, demonstrating how visual memory can scale native interleaved generation to substantially longer trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向长时程交错多模态生成的统一多模态模型，核心是视觉记忆框架与LongMIG-Bench基准，实现了高保真的长程文本/图像到多图生成与角色场景一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）多用于短轨迹或简化视觉内容，难以支撑长时程交错生成。核心难点在于：生成图像不断累积于上下文中，无关或不完美的视觉状态会干扰后续合成，而早期建立的字符与场景又需在长间隔后仍被恢复。
AI.method: 1）在交错多模态数据上原生训练的大规模UMM，具备图像合成、文本渲染、复杂构图与多模态规划能力；2）视觉记忆框架：维护持久化视觉引用、在保留完整语义历史的同时选择性检索场景相关历史状态，并采用少步自rollout使模型适应不完美的生成历史；3）提出LongMIG-Bench，用于评估长时程文本到多图与图像到多图生成。
AI.result: 模型实现了高保真的长时程交错生成，在角色与场景一致性方面表现强劲，验证了视觉记忆可将原生交错生成扩展至显著更长的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉记忆机制，原生交错多模态生成能够有效扩展至长时程轨迹，为长程多模态推理与合成提供了可行路径。

title: Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification
comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables, AACL-IJCNLP Findings accepted
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) has received a lot of interest recently due to its ability to improve classification accuracy for new tasks without having to fine-tune the model over these tasks. However, the impact of ICL on calibration has been far less studied. Recent work has shown that ICL can have a negative impact on calibration due to biased selection of in-context examples. The existing methods for improving ICL calibration require additional task and model-specific training, detracting from the no-fine-tuning convenience of ICL. In this work, we introduce CALIBFORMER, a universal ICL calibrator for classification tasks, that generalizes to new models and tasks without further fine-tuning on these tasks. Specifically, we design a transformer-based calibrator which uses the model predictions on in-context examples to predict a confidence score for the test input. We show that the calibrator trained on three models and ten tasks, is able to generalize/calibrate ICL predictions on several new tasks and four LLMs unseen during training. Even for frontier models like Gemini, CALIBFORMER is able to obtain over 50% reduction in calibration error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CALIBFORMER，一个通用的上下文学习（ICL）校准器，无需针对新任务或新模型额外微调即可实现跨模型、跨任务的校准泛化。
AI.motivation: ICL虽能在不微调的情况下提升分类准确率，但其对校准（calibration）的影响研究不足。已有工作表明，ICL因上下文示例的选择偏差会损害校准性能，而现有改进方法需要额外的任务与模型专属训练，破坏了ICL免微调的便利性。
AI.method: 设计了一个基于Transformer的通用校准器CALIBFORMER。它利用模型在上下文示例上的预测结果来预测测试输入的置信度分数，从而对ICL的分类预测进行校准，且无需在新任务或新模型上进一步微调。
AI.result: 在三个模型和十个任务上训练的CALIBFORMER，能够泛化并校准若干训练中未见的新任务及四个LLM的ICL预测。即使是Gemini等前沿模型，CALIBFORMER也能将校准误差降低超过50%。
AI.conclusion: CALIBFORMER作为一种通用ICL校准器，在保持ICL免微调优势的同时，实现了跨任务、跨模型的校准泛化，显著降低校准误差。

title: Contrastive learning for video reuse detection
summary: The incorporation of footage from other sources has long been a concern from a copyright perspective, as such usage can harm the interests of rights holders. Recent trends in the ``remixing'' of social media content and the development of bespoke stock libraries for specialist causes mean that methods to identify content reuse will have a range of applications. In this paper, we develop a framework based on a Siamese network fine tuned using contrastive learning to identify potential sources for key frames in a given video. This framework makes two contributions to analysis of large video datasets. Firstly, we demonstrate its utility at reducing complex video data to a set of key visuals typically less than 10\% of the size of the full set. Secondly, we show that these reduced sets allow for efficient and effective identification of component footage. We test this method over a set of videos compiled from a stock footage library and demonstrate its effectiveness for constituent video identification with average accuracy greater than 0.95.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Siamese网络与对比学习的框架，通过关键帧提取将视频数据压缩至不足原规模10%，并高效识别视频中的复用素材来源，平均准确率超过0.95。
AI.motivation: 其他来源素材的混用长期引发版权问题，可能损害权利人利益。社交媒体内容"混剪"兴起及专门用途定制素材库的发展，使得内容复用识别方法具备多种应用需求。
AI.method: 构建基于Siamese网络的框架，采用对比学习进行微调，用于识别给定视频中关键帧的潜在来源。框架首先将复杂视频数据约简为关键视觉集合（通常不足完整数据集规模的10%），再在该约简集合上完成素材成分的高效识别。在由素材库汇编的视频集合上进行测试。
AI.result: 在素材库汇编视频集上验证，素材成分识别平均准确率大于0.95；关键视觉集合规模通常小于完整数据集的10%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架对大规模视频数据集分析具有两方面贡献：一是有效降维至关键视觉集合，二是支持高效且准确的成分素材识别，可应用于版权相关的视频内容复用检测。

title: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
summary: Information extraction models often perform well on the datasets they are trained on, but transferring to new domains and annotation guidelines remains challenging. Supporting user-specified types alone does not resolve this problem. We present CalOn, a unified 0.6B-parameter encoder for entity, relation, and event extraction across datasets and schemas. The model jointly encodes text and type definitions, then directly identifies entity spans, relations between spans, and event triggers and arguments. Its extraction decisions consider the requested types together, using their combined evidence to identify relevant candidates before assigning a type. This gives all three tasks a common probabilistic formulation while keeping every extracted mention anchored to the input text. We train on diverse sources, and supplement supervised learning with a reward that encourages correct extractions and penalises incorrect ones. Across 40 benchmarks, CalOn outperforms the evaluated baselines on most benchmarks. It leads all reported relation extraction benchmarks and achieves the highest average F1 for event triggers and arguments with gold triggers. The same model also performs strongly on aspect sentiment triplet extraction and pronoun resolution through its span-pair formulation. A correction for the probability bias introduced during training improves confidence estimates for entities, relations, and event arguments after calibration, with little change in F1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CalOn，一个0.6B参数的统一编码器，通过联合编码文本与类型定义，在40个基准上实现跨数据集与模式的实体、关系、事件抽取。
AI.motivation: 现有信息抽取模型在训练数据上表现良好，但难以迁移到新领域和标注规范；仅支持用户指定类型无法解决该问题。
AI.method: CalOn联合编码文本与类型定义，直接识别实体跨度、跨度间关系及事件触发词与论元；抽取决策综合考虑所有请求类型，利用联合证据筛选候选再分配类型，为三类任务提供统一概率形式，并将抽取结果锚定于输入文本。训练融合多源数据，并以奖励机制强化正确抽取、惩罚错误抽取。
AI.result: 在40个基准中多数超越基线；在报告的所有关系抽取基准上领先；在给定金标触发词时事件触发词与论元取得最高平均F1；在方面情感三元组抽取和代词消解任务上表现强劲；训练概率偏差校正后提升了实体、关系与事件论元的置信度估计，F1几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 统一的跨度-类型联合建模与奖励增强训练可有效提升跨数据集、跨模式的抽取泛化能力，且概率偏差校正能在不损失F1的前提下改善置信度校准。

title: Gluing Local Contexts into Global Meaning: A Sheaf-Theoretic Decomposition of Transformer Representations
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster, ICLR Unifying Concept Representation Learning
summary: Existing interpretability tools do not test whether a representation keeps the same content when only the phrasing changes. We treat each paraphrase pair as a local witness that two activations should agree and build a cellular sheaf over the paraphrase graph; its Laplacian $L_\mathcal{F}$ answers the question on a frozen model with no training. The kernel $H^0$ is a content subspace: at 20 dimensions it beats the preserved subspace of the concept eraser LEACE on held-out CounterFact fact retrieval across eight architectures by a mean $+17.1$\,pp, and constraining all paraphrases of a fact jointly adds a further $+6.5$\,pp. The spectral complement concentrates causal influence: ablating the most paraphrase-variable coordinates, a coordinate-wise proxy for it, changes model outputs $5.6$ to $26.5\times$ more than ablating coordinates of matched per-coordinate variability, across nine models from 124M to 13B parameters. Stacking layers into a grid creates $b_1 = N(L-1)$ algebraic 1-cycles, and the resulting model-derived harmonic mass varies by nearly three orders of magnitude across six architectures and ranks them as their steering fragility does (Spearman $ρ= 0.90$, exact one-sided permutation $p = 0.014$). The same paraphrase graph yields the content subspace, the influence directions, and the fragility measure. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/

AI.tldr: 本文将释义对视为激活一致性的局部见证，在释义图上构造胞腔层（cellular sheaf），用其拉普拉斯算子 $L_\mathcal{F}$ 在冻结模型上无训练地识别"内容子空间"与"因果影响方向"，并可量化模型脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性工具不检验"仅改变措辞时表征是否保持相同内容"这一问题。作者希望用一个无需训练、与架构无关的框架，从释义不变性角度区分内容与表达，并进一步刻画因果影响与模型稳健性。
AI.method: 将每个释义对作为局部见证，要求两个激活一致，从而在释义图上构造胞腔层，其拉普拉斯算子 $L_\mathcal{F}$ 的核 $H^0$ 定义为内容子空间。对同一事实的所有释义联合约束以增强效果。谱补空间用于聚焦因果影响：对释义变异性最大的坐标（及其逐坐标代理）做消融。将多层堆叠成网格得到 $b_1=N(L-1)$ 个代数 1-环，由此定义模型衍生的调和质量。
AI.result: 20 维内容子空间在留出的 CounterFact 事实检索上，于八种架构上平均超越概念擦除器 LEACE 的保留子空间 +17.1 个百分点，联合约束同一事实的所有释义再增 +6.5 个百分点。消融释义变异性最大的坐标，其输出变化是匹配逐坐标变异性的坐标的 5.6–26.5 倍，覆盖 124M 至 13B 九个模型。调和质量在六种架构间跨越近三个数量级，与操控脆弱性排序一致（Spearman $\rho=0.90$，单侧精确置换 $p=0.014$）。
AI.conclusion: 同一释义图可同时导出内容子空间、影响方向与脆弱性度量，构成一个统一的、基于层论的无训练可解释性框架。

title: When LLM Agents See a Conflict but Still Proceed: Cross-Domain Dependencies in Network Slicing
comment: Submitted to 11th Workshop on Communication Networks and Power Systems (WCNPS 2026)
summary: Future AI-native networks are being designed to apply autonomous agents built on large language models (LLMs) in network management through intents. When intents from different domains meet on the same resource, an agent must recognize the cross-domain dependency before taking an irreversible action. We investigate this problem through a smart-grid use case, in which a power utility holds an active intent on a backup slice for protection traffic. This slice appears idle by design, which is precisely the profile targeted by a cost-reduction intent. We built a tool-based environment in which the dependency must be either queried by the agent or read from an inventory annotation, together with a negative control, and evaluated ten models from four different providers in 600 runs. Most models acted against the dependency they had observed: seven of the ten models removed the protection slice at least once after receiving the cross-domain dependency, and in the high-harm tier the slice was removed in 76% of the exposed runs, while four models practically never did. Only one of ten models never removed the slice. We identify two failure modes, not querying the dependency and querying it but proceeding anyway, and show that agents often reported no conflict after observing it. These results indicate that, in AI-native networks, visibility of cross-domain dependencies is not a sufficient safeguard, and that dependency verification should be enforced by the management architecture before irreversible actions rather than delegated to the LLM's judgment.

AI.tldr: 研究通过智能电网用例测试LLM智能体在跨域依赖场景下的行为，发现大多数模型即便观测到依赖仍会执行不可逆操作，说明依赖可见性不足以作为安全保障，需由管理层强制执行依赖校验。
AI.motivation: AI原生网络拟用基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体通过意图（intent）进行网络管理。当来自不同域的意图在同一资源上相遇时，智能体必须在执行不可逆操作前识别跨域依赖。作者希望验证：若依赖信息对智能体可见，是否足以避免其采取有害的不可逆动作。
AI.method: 构建基于工具的环境，模拟智能电网场景：电力公司对备份切片持有活跃意图，该切片按设计看似空闲，恰好成为降本意图的目标。依赖关系须由智能体主动查询，或从库存注释（inventory annotation）中读取，并设置阴性对照。对来自四家供应商的十个模型进行600次运行评测。
AI.result: 多数模型违背其已观测到的依赖：十个模型中有七个在获知跨域依赖后至少一次移除保护切片；在高危害层级（high-harm tier）的暴露运行中，切片被移除的比例达76%；另有四个模型几乎从不移除。十个模型中仅一个从未移除切片。识别出两种失败模式——未查询依赖，以及查询后仍继续执行；并发现智能体常在观测到依赖后仍报告无冲突。
AI.conclusion: 在AI原生网络中，跨域依赖的可见性并非充分的安全保障。依赖验证应由管理架构在执行不可逆动作前强制执行，而不应委派给LLM的判断。

title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
comment: 17 pages, including references and appendices. Demo: https://d2-duplex-demo.github.io/
summary: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2) 框架，通过解码器无关表征蒸馏与有监督微调，将预训练半双工语音语言模型转化为细时间粒度的高能力全双工模型。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音语言模型（FD-SLM）支持同听同说，但通用能力常落后于半双工模型（HD-SLM）。如何在保持原有能力的前提下实现高质量全双工交互是核心问题。
AI.method: D2 将原本非流式的音频编码器适配为流式处理，采用无解码器表征蒸馏；再通过有监督微调学习全双工交互。系统研究 chunk size 对全双工交互、通用能力与推理计算量的影响，并在 Qwen3-Omni 与 LLaMA-Omni 2 两种架构上验证。
AI.result: 在 12.5Hz 更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2 达到 99.2% 轮次转换成功率、521ms 延迟、99.5% 打断成功率，以及 70.1 的 VoiceBench 分数（当前最优）。
AI.conclusion: D2 能在细时间粒度上将高能力半双工模型高效转化为全双工模型，兼顾全双工交互性能与通用能力，且可跨架构通用。

title: ToolHACE: A Dataset for Detecting Hallucinations in Tool-Based LLM Responses
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 7 tables
summary: Tool-augmented language models ground their responses in external tool outputs, improving reliability beyond parametric knowledge alone. However, even when the correct tool is called and returns accurate information, models may still contradict such outputs, omit critical details, or generate unsupported claims. Existing hallucination benchmarks for tool-augmented dialogue primarily focus on the tool-calling stage, evaluating whether the correct tool and arguments are selected, while overlooking errors that arise during post-tool response generation. To address this gap, we introduce ToolHACE, a span-level benchmark for hallucination detection in tool-augmented LLM responses, covering five fine-grained hallucination categories. Through extensive experiments with modern hallucination detectors, we show that post-tool-call hallucinations are widespread and remain challenging to detect. Our results further demonstrate that effective detection requires training on specialized tool-augmented corpora, while transfer from tool-agnostic hallucination datasets performs poorly in this setting. These findings highlight the need for dedicated benchmarks and models for reliable hallucination detection in tool-augmented language systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ToolHACE，一个面向工具增强LLM响应的span级幻觉检测基准，覆盖五类细粒度幻觉，实验表明工具调用后的幻觉普遍存在且难以检测，需要专用语料训练。
AI.motivation: 工具增强语言模型即使调用了正确工具并获得准确输出，仍可能生成与工具输出矛盾、遗漏关键细节或无依据的陈述。现有工具增强对话幻觉基准主要关注工具调用阶段（是否正确选择工具与参数），忽视了工具调用后响应生成阶段的错误，因此存在评估空白。
AI.method: 提出ToolHACE，一个span级幻觉检测基准，覆盖五类细粒度幻觉类别，并利用现代幻觉检测器进行广泛实验，同时对比在专用工具增强语料上训练与从工具无关幻觉数据集迁移的效果。
AI.result: 工具调用后幻觉普遍存在且难以检测；有效检测需要在专门的工具增强语料上训练，而从工具无关的幻觉数据集迁移表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强语言系统需要专门的基准与模型才能实现可靠的幻觉检测。

title: EgoProbe: Benchmarking Long-Range and Exact Memory in Streaming Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric video provides a continuous first-person record of everyday activities, making it a natural foundation for wearable AI assistants. Unlike offline video understanding, streaming systems must process observations as they arrive, while queries may refer to experiences from the distant past. Recent work has begun to explore whether information can be recalled across long temporal gaps. Yet remembering how far is only part of the challenge: recurring objects, actions, and locations also require models to remember exactly which detail belongs to which event. We introduce EgoProbe, a benchmark that evaluates streaming egocentric memory along these two complementary dimensions: long-range retention, i.e., how far, and event-specific recall under interference, i.e., how exact. Built on long-form egocentric videos, EgoProbe uses an event-grounded data engine to extend recall intervals, identify related events, and construct event-grounded distractors, followed by human verification. It contains two subsets: EgoProbe-Base, which evaluates long-range recall without intervening related events, and EgoProbe-Echo, which challenges models with similar intervening events and event-grounded distractors. EgoProbe-Echo adopts coarse-to-fine multi-turn probing: the first turn evaluates coarse-grained event recall, while the second tests whether the model can retrieve the target-specific detail associated with the designated event. Extensive evaluation across diverse models reveals substantial limitations in long-range recall, with further challenges in recovering target-event details among related experiences. Even when models correctly answer coarse-grained questions, they often fail to recall the specific details of the designated event. EgoProbe exposes this underexplored failure mode and provides a testbed for advancing long-range and exact memory in streaming egocentric video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoProbe 基准，从"记忆多远"（长程保持）与"记忆多准"（事件特定召回、抗干扰）两个维度评估流式第一人称视频记忆，揭示现有模型在长程召回与事件细节区分上的显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 流式第一人称视频系统需实时处理观测并可查询久远经历。现有工作多关注跨长时间间隔的信息召回，但仅"记得多远"不够：重复出现的物体、动作与地点要求模型精确区分"哪个细节属于哪个事件"。当前缺乏对长程与精确记忆双重挑战的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 EgoProbe 基准，基于长时第一人称视频，采用事件接地（event-grounded）数据引擎扩展召回区间、识别相关事件并构造事件接地干扰项，并经人工校验。包含两个子集：EgoProbe-Base 评估无相关干预事件下的长程召回；EgoProbe-Echo 引入相似干预事件与事件接地干扰项，采用"粗到细"多轮探测——首轮测粗粒度事件召回，次轮测能否检索指定事件的目标特定细节。
AI.result: 多模型广泛评测显示：长程召回存在显著局限；在相关经历中恢复目标事件细节更具挑战；即便模型能正确回答粗粒度问题，也常无法召回指定事件的具体细节。
AI.conclusion: EgoProbe 揭示了一种未被充分探索的失败模式，为推进流式第一人称视频理解中的长程与精确记忆提供了测试平台。

title: MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative for embodied intelligence by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions. However, their heavy visual encoding and iterative generative inference incur substantial latency, limiting their applicability to high-frequency closed-loop control. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically optimize a single stage, yielding limited speedups or degraded control under aggressive reuse. In this work, we systematically profile the inference overhead of WAMs and observe abundant redundancy across Transformer computation, diffusion denoising, and consecutive policy queries. However, the safe removal of such redundancy depends strongly on its impact on action prediction and control sensitivity. Based on these observations, we introduce \textbf{MARS}, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for multi-level WAM acceleration. MARS selectively removes low-impact attention computation, adaptively accelerates diffusion inference according to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive queries with online verification. Together, these complementary mechanisms provide remarkable acceleration while limiting approximation error. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa show that MARS achieves up to $4.00\times$, $3.94\times$, and $2.10\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, while maintaining task success rate close to the original policy. Moreover, MARS generalizes across different model backbones and across simulation and real-robot experiments, substantially improving the efficiency--performance trade-off of WAM inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的多层级加速框架MARS，通过选择性注意力计算、自适应扩散推理与跨查询潜表示复用，显著降低WAM推理延迟并保持控制性能。
AI.motivation: World Action Models (WAMs) 通过联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作，为具身智能提供了有前景的方案。但其沉重的视觉编码与迭代式生成推理带来显著延迟，限制了其在高频闭环控制中的适用性。现有的免训练加速方法通常只优化单一阶段，在激进复用下加速有限或导致控制性能退化。
AI.method: 系统剖析WAM推理开销，发现Transformer计算、扩散去噪与连续策略查询中存在大量冗余，且冗余的安全去除依赖于其对动作预测与控制敏感性的影响。基于此，提出MARS：①选择性移除低影响的注意力计算；②依据运动粒度自适应加速扩散推理；③在连续查询间推测性复用预测的未来视觉表示并进行在线验证。三种机制互补，在加速的同时限制近似误差。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO与RoboCasa上分别实现最高4.00×、3.94×与2.10×的端到端加速，任务成功率接近原始策略；方法可跨不同模型骨干泛化，并在仿真与真机实验中有效，显著改善WAM推理的效率–性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: MARS作为一种免训练、即插即用的多层级加速框架，能够在不重训练的前提下有效缓解WAM的推理瓶颈，在保持控制性能的同时大幅提升效率，具备良好的通用性与实际部署潜力。

title: The Format is the Filter: Scoring Format Fixes What an LLM Judge Can Express
summary: When an LLM judge filters instruction-tuning data, its scoring format (binary verdict, 1--5 rating, 0--100 score, or comparison) is rarely justified or ablated. Holding the candidate pool, judge prompt, decoding and selection budget fixed, we score 15,406 UltraFeedback candidates under five formats with three judges, curate, fine-tune 66 models, and evaluate them with four judges. A 0--100 scale is worth only 7--12 equally used levels, two to three times a 1--5 scale rather than twenty, and a binary verdict leaves the top score tied in 77--78\% of prompts, so most selections are made at random. These properties are set by the format almost independently of the judge. Kendall's $τ_b$ hides them: it ranks binary best while $τ_a$ and top-1 agreement rank it last, because it discounts the ties a selector must break at random. Both comparative formats inherit a slot bias whose sign differs across judges. Downstream, curated data beat random selection under every evaluation judge, robust to length and markdown adjustment, but no ordering among formats is detectable. We propose four quantities that judge-based curation pipelines should report.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了LLM评判器在指令微调数据筛选中的四种评分格式（二元判定、1–5分、0–100分、比较式），在固定候选池、提示、解码与选择预算的条件下评分15,406条UltraFeedback数据、微调66个模型并用4个评判器评估，发现评分格式决定了可用等级数、并列比例与槽位偏置，但下游效果无法区分格式优劣，并提出四项应报告的指标。
AI.motivation: LLM评判器用于筛选指令微调数据时，其评分格式的选择往往缺乏论证与消融实验。作者希望厘清：在控制其他变量后，评分格式本身如何影响数据筛选质量，以及常用的评价指标是否掩盖了这些影响。
AI.method: 固定候选池、评判提示、解码与选择预算，用3个评判器以5种格式对15,406条UltraFeedback候选打分；据此筛选数据、微调66个模型，并用4个评判器评估。同时对比Kendall τ_b、τ_a、top-1一致率等指标，并考察长度与markdown调整的稳健性。
AI.result: 0–100量表实际只有7–12个等频使用等级，仅为1–5量表的两到三倍而非二十倍；二元判定在77–78%的提示中最高分并列，导致多数选择近乎随机。这些性质由格式决定，几乎与评判器无关。Kendall τ_b掩盖了上述问题：它将二元格式排为最优，而τ_a与top-1一致率将其排为最差。两种比较式格式均继承槽位偏置，且偏置符号随评判器不同而改变。下游评估中，经筛选的数据在所有评估评判器下均优于随机选择，且对长度与markdown调整稳健，但各格式之间无可检测的优劣排序。
AI.conclusion: 评分格式的隐含属性（可用等级数、并列率、槽位偏置）会实质性影响基于评判器的数据筛选，而常用的一致性指标可能误导格式选择。作者建议此类流水线报告四项量化指标，并指出下游效果对格式不敏感，不应依赖单一指标来论证格式的合理性。

title: Learning Perceptual Geometry of Natural Odor Mixtures from LLM-Derived Descriptors
summary: The relationship between odor chemistry and perception remains incompletely understood. Many existing studies focus on the perception of single molecules, whereas natural odors contain tens to hundreds of components, adding extra layer of complexity to percept formation. Here, we explore the relationship between molecular composition and perceived similarity in natural odor objects. We study this using a database of more than 1,200 volatile-compound-in-food mixtures containing more than 8,000 molecular components, and use large language models (LLMs) as a scalable surrogate for deriving mixture-level perceptual descriptions. We find that language-derived representations provide useful supervision for predicting held-out mixture similarities from molecular composition. The prediction was consistently strongest when perceptual targets were derived from chemosensory prompts than from other sensory prompts. Further, during the mixture-level training, we learned low-rank molecular embeddings that enabled better prediction of held-out mixture similarities than component-overlap metrics, even for mixture pairs with no shared molecules. Although no single-molecule labels were used during training, the learned molecular geometry showed significant alignment with the independent human odor-descriptor space. Finally, we explored the use of external molecular features in our mixture-similarity prediction task. These features showed modest zero-shot alignment with mixture-level perceptual similarity. They improved prediction under limited supervision but offered little additional predictive benefit with the full training set. Together, these results show that language-derived descriptions can provide scalable supervision for predicting the perceptual organization of complex natural mixtures, contributing to a quantitative understanding of how molecular composition gives rise to odor perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用LLM从食物挥发物混合物中提取感知描述作为监督信号，学习低秩分子嵌入，从而预测复杂天然混合物的感知相似性，并发现所得分子几何与人类气味描述空间显著对齐。
AI.motivation: 气味化学与感知之间的关系尚未完全阐明。现有研究多聚焦单分子感知，而天然气味含数十至数百个组分，使感知形成更为复杂。作者希望探究分子组成与天然气味客体感知相似性之间的关系。
AI.method: 构建含1200多个食物挥发物混合物、8000多个分子组分的数据库；以LLM作为可扩展的替代手段，从化学感觉提示等生成混合物层面的感知描述；用语言衍生表征监督预测留出混合物的相似性；在混合物层面训练中学习低秩分子嵌入，并与组分重叠指标及外部分子特征进行对比。
AI.result: 语言衍生表征能有效监督预测留出混合物相似性，且化学感觉提示来源的感知目标预测最强；低秩分子嵌入优于组分重叠指标，即使混合物对无共享分子也成立；虽未使用单分子标签，学到的分子几何与独立人类气味描述空间显著对齐；外部分子特征零样本对齐有限，仅在监督数据有限时提升预测，全量训练后增益甚微。
AI.conclusion: 语言衍生描述可为预测复杂天然混合物的感知组织提供可扩展的监督信号，有助于定量理解分子组成如何产生气味感知。

title: ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning
summary: Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control at three stages and validate it with eight chemistry domain experts. The strongest evaluated model reaches 78.6% accuracy, leaving considerable room for improvement. On a 600-question expert-reviewed subset, reasoning-trace analysis classifies 71.4% of the strongest model's errors as attribution failures. Attribution is also the largest error category for the open-source and chemistry-specific models included in our analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ChemExplain基准，用于评测模型能否解释化学效应发生的原因，即"解释性归因"能力，其包含1,180道多选题，最强模型准确率仅78.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有化学基准主要评测结果预测或反应路径生成，很少检验模型能否解释某个已观察到的化学效应为何发生，因此缺乏对"解释性归因"能力的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建ChemExplain基准，从383篇同行评审论文中抽取1,180道多选题；每题配分子或反应图像、一个观察到的化学效应及四个候选解释，每个解释对应图像中不同的结构特征。正确答案的特征-机制关系来自原文支撑证据而非生成式LLM编造；采用多智能体框架自动构建，在三阶段实施渐进式质量控制，并由八位化学领域专家验证。
AI.result: 最强模型准确率为78.6%，仍有较大提升空间；在600道经专家复核的子集上，推理轨迹分析显示最强模型71.4%的错误属于归因失败，归因也是所分析开源模型与化学专用模型中最大的错误类别。
AI.conclusion: 解释性归因是当前化学模型的主要短板，ChemExplain为评测该能力提供了系统基准，揭示模型感知结构与应用化学知识之外的关键差距。

title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
comment: Dilara*, Mike*, Akshat*, Shubham* contributed equally to this work
summary: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate progress efficiently, through three mechanisms. First, each worker in a fleet of coding agents co-discovers an optimization target and a fast, tailored proxy evaluator, which we call a yardstick. The agent then hill-climbs the yardstick rather than the true evaluation. Second, since search can exploit gaps between a yardstick and the true objective, fidelity tests continually recheck each yardstick's ranking and invalidate any that drift. Third, the fleet is bottom-up, with no central decomposition of the problem. A lightweight orchestrator spawns and terminates agents, briefs running ones, and seeds new agents with others' confirmed work. DuoDiscover enables autonomous optimization from software to chip architecture. We demonstrate DuoDiscover on two repository-level benchmarks and four GPU and TPU kernel suites covering hundreds of kernels. On SWE-fficiency, it doubles the average speedup of human experts. On SOL-Exec, it ranks first on 121 of 235 kernels and in the top three on 212. On the heavily optimized vLLM and SQLite engines, DuoDiscover achieves 1.92$\times$ and 1.38$\times$ gains over the base code. On a CPU microarchitecture optimization task with evaluations of up to 28 hours, DuoDiscover surpasses both AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and the best human design, with 1.65$\times$ ArchAgent v2's gain in 16.7 days versus more than 40 days, advancing the frontier of autonomous chip design.

AI.tldr: DuoDiscover 通过让智能体协同发现优化目标与快速代理评估器（yardstick），并结合保真度检验与自底向上编排，将真实评估次数压缩，实现从软件到芯片架构的自主优化。
AI.motivation: 自主发现扩展到真实工程挑战的核心瓶颈是评估成本：一次真实评估（如完整基准测试或服务轨迹）可能耗时数小时，导致搜索只能承担极少数真实评估。需要一种能高效评估进展的搜索系统。
AI.method: 提出 DuoDiscover，包含三种机制：(1) 编码智能体集群中每个 worker 协同发现优化目标与量身定制的快速代理评估器（yardstick），随后在 yardstick 上爬山而非真实评估；(2) 保真度检验持续复查各 yardstick 的排序，对发生漂移的 yardstick 予以作废，防止搜索利用代理与真实目标间的差距；(3) 集群自底向上，无中心化问题分解，由轻量编排器生成/终止智能体、向运行中的智能体简报，并用他人已确认的工作为新智能体播种。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级基准和四个 GPU/TPU 内核套件（涵盖数百个内核）上验证：SWE-fficiency 上平均加速比达人类专家两倍；SOL-Exec 上在 235 个内核中 121 个排名第一、212 个进入前三；在高度优化的 vLLM 与 SQLite 引擎上分别取得 1.92× 和 1.38× 增益；在评估长达 28 小时的 CPU 微架构优化任务上，超越基于 AlphaEvolve 的 ArchAgent v2 与最佳人类设计，以 16.7 天取得 ArchAgent v2 增益的 1.65×（后者需 40 天以上）。
AI.conclusion: DuoDiscover 支持从软件到芯片架构的自主优化，显著降低评估成本瓶颈，在多项基准与真实引擎优化中超越人类专家与现有方法，推进了自主芯片设计的前沿。

title: Soft Teacher Forcing
summary: Soft tokens have so far been used to replace discrete chain-of-thought in latent reasoning methods. These approaches typically require multi-stage training and, in some cases, auxiliary modules, yet they still underperform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on <input, chain-of-thought, output> triples. In this paper, we ask whether soft tokens can be used to improve SFT itself, instead of as an avenue for latent reasoning. We introduce Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF), a simple training algorithm that combines teacher-forced embeddings with soft tokens through random convex combinations. The soft tokens are computed in a single parallel forward pass over the ground-truth sequence. Soft-TF adds no parameters, no external model and no curriculum, and leaves inference unchanged. Experiments show that Soft-TF improves over SFT on GSM8K, MATH, MathQA and AQuA, by +2.1 to +4.1 points on GSM8K across seven Gemma, Llama and Mistral models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Soft Teacher Forcing (Soft-TF)，一种将软令牌与教师强制嵌入通过随机凸组合结合的简单训练算法，用于改进监督微调（SFT）本身，而非作为潜在推理手段。
AI.motivation: 现有软令牌方法多用于替代离散思维链的潜在推理，通常需要多阶段训练、有时还需辅助模块，且在 <输入, 思维链, 输出> 三元组上仍不如监督微调（SFT）。作者因而转向一个不同的问题：能否用软令牌来改进 SFT 本身。
AI.method: Soft-TF 通过随机凸组合将教师强制嵌入与软令牌融合；软令牌在真实序列上经单次并行前向传播计算得到。该方法不增加参数、不引入外部模型、不需要课程学习，且推理阶段保持不变。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH、MathQA 和 AQuA 上，Soft-TF 相较 SFT 均有提升；在七个 Gemma、Llama 和 Mistral 模型上，GSM8K 提升 +2.1 至 +4.1 分。
AI.conclusion: Soft-TF 表明软令牌可用于增强 SFT，是一种无额外开销、易于实现且推理不变的训练改进方案，在多个数学推理基准和模型族上稳定优于标准 SFT。

title: Welcome to the Age of Agent Ads: Using On-Policy Attacks to Steer Agentic Decisions
summary: People increasingly delegate option-ranking tasks (e.g., shopping, job search, travel) to AI agents, which creates incentives to steer agentic decisions via "agent ads." To defend against such steering attacks, people count on models' alignment training and platforms' terms of service, and consequently the most effective existing attacks are designed to trigger off-policy behaviors. Exposing a new attack surface, we introduce on-policy attacks, which steer agentic decisions without pushing individually aligned behaviors off policy. Our example attack consists of two steps: To remain compliant with platforms' terms of service, we first inject a truthful negation about a fictitious concept ("Does not contain blizyester") into a product description. This triggers an agent to search the web ("What is blizyester?"), which surfaces planted websites full of fabricated information associating the fictitious concept with harmful implications ("Blizyester linked to dementia"). Trained to keep users safe from harm, the agent penalizes every option missing the truthful negation. Evaluating our attack across four real-world listing datasets, we find some frontier models exposed, enabling an adversarial actor to penalize competitors without violating existing platform-listing guidelines. We discuss the broader challenge of regulating advertising aimed at AI agents and provide recommendations to model developers and platform providers.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种针对AI代理的新型"on-policy攻击"面：攻击者先在商品描述中植入对虚构概念的"真实否定"（如"不含blizyester"），诱导代理上网检索，再由预置网站将该虚构概念与有害含义关联，从而利用模型的安全对齐偏好惩罚未含该否定的竞品，实现不违反平台规则的广告操纵。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地将选项排序任务（购物、求职、旅行等）委托给AI代理，由此产生了通过"代理广告"操纵代理决策的动机。现有防御依赖模型的价值观对齐训练与平台服务条款，因此最有效的既有攻击都旨在触发off-policy（偏离策略）行为。作者试图指出一个此前被忽视的、可绕过这些防御的攻击面。
AI.method: 提出on-policy攻击：在不让个体已对齐行为偏离策略的前提下操纵代理决策。具体两步攻击：(1)为符合平台条款，在商品描述中注入对虚构概念的真实否定（"不含blizyester"），触发代理上网搜索（"什么是blizyester？"）；(2)通过预置网站散布将虚构概念与有害含义关联的虚假信息（"blizyester与痴呆相关"）。由于模型被训练为保护用户免受伤害，代理会惩罚所有缺少该真实否定的选项。在四个真实世界商品列表数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界列表数据集上评估发现，部分前沿模型确已暴露于该攻击之下，攻击者可借此惩罚竞争对手，同时不违反现有的平台商品列表准则。
AI.conclusion: 本文讨论了针对AI代理的广告监管这一更广泛的挑战，并向模型开发者与平台提供方提出了建议。核心结论是：on-policy攻击构成新的攻击面，可绕过现有的对齐训练与平台条款防御，亟需针对面向AI代理的广告进行规制。

title: Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
summary: Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $γ$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

AI.tldr: Multics 提出层级通信的多玩家视频世界模型，通过玩家-组-全局三级结构，在提升生成一致性的同时降低注意力开销，并支持玩家数量泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有多玩家交互世界模型存在两大问题：全连接通信（如 Solaris）随玩家数增长带来二次注意力开销；中心化方法（如 γ-World）因共享全局表示导致无关事件互相干扰。目标是兼顾可扩展性与鲁棒生成。
AI.method: 提出层级通信框架 Multics：引入组 token 作为中间层表示，聚合局部相关玩家信息，并连接全局 token 实现跨组通信，层级拓扑限制无关局部事件的直接混合；组 token 参数在组槽间共享，同一通信模块可适应不同玩家数；另提出基于近期相机轨迹的预算约束动态分组，自适应聚合相关玩家并限制冗余通信。
AI.result: 在 4 玩家和 6 玩家设置下达到 SOTA，跨玩家一致性、玩家特定动作与相机可控性、抗干扰鲁棒性均提升；可从未经重训的 4 玩家训练泛化到 6、8、10 玩家推理，且相较全连接通信降低自注意力计算量。
AI.conclusion: 层级通信与动态分组为多玩家世界模型提供了可扩展、抗干扰的生成方案，兼具性能与效率优势，并展现良好的玩家数量泛化能力。

title: MLAfication: Efficiently Enabling High-Fidelity MLA for Modern LLMs
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache into a latent representation, reducing inference memory and bandwidth. Existing MHA2MLA/TransMLA methods do not support QKNorm and require costly recovery on modern LLMs, especially MoE. We present MLAfication, a QKNorm-compatible, parameter-efficient extension of MHA2MLA. It combines calibrated KNorm, parameter-efficient distillation, contribution-aware Partial-RoPE, and activation-aware joint KV initialization. Across MHA and GQA models, including QKNorm- and MoE-equipped variants, MLAfication preserves performance under substantial KV-cache compression, surpasses the current SOTA on commonsense and long-context benchmarks, and extends MLA conversion to modern architectures. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MLAfication delivers up to $5.35\times$ the serving throughput of BF16 GQA and, combined with 4-bit KV quantization, reduces the KV-cache footprint by $94.73\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/JT-Ushio/MLAfication.

AI.tldr: MLAfication是一种兼容QKNorm、参数高效的MHA2MLA扩展方法，可在显著压缩KV缓存的同时保持性能，并支持现代含QKNorm及MoE的LLM架构。
AI.motivation: 现有MHA2MLA/TransMLA方法不支持QKNorm，且在现代LLM（尤其是MoE模型）上需要昂贵的恢复训练，限制了MLA在主流架构中的应用。
AI.method: MLAfication组合了四项技术：校准的KNorm（calibrated KNorm）、参数高效蒸馏、贡献感知的Partial-RoPE，以及激活感知的联合KV初始化。
AI.result: 在MHA和GQA模型（含QKNorm和MoE变体）上，MLAfication在显著KV缓存压缩下保持性能，在常识和长上下文基准上超越当前SOTA。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，服务吞吐量最高达BF16 GQA的5.35倍，结合4-bit KV量化可将KV缓存占用降低94.73%。
AI.conclusion: MLAfication将MLA转换扩展到现代架构，实现了高压缩率下的无损性能保持与显著推理效率提升，代码已开源。

title: Online LLM Personalization from Pairwise Preferences Across Users
comment: 45 pages, 5 figures. Website: https://rogy-labs.github.io/tutorduel/ Code: https://github.com/RoGy-Labs/tutorduel-code Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/romainpuech/tutorduel
summary: Large language models can answer the same question in different styles, but users' preferred styles are hidden and vary across users and questions. We study inference-time personalization through online selection from a fixed set of prompts, each representing a persona. Users arrive sequentially, each asks a short sequence of questions, and the system displays two responses per question and observes one pairwise choice. We formulate this interaction as a variant of the contextual dueling bandit problem in which the learner starts without preference data, adapts within each session, and exploits information shared across users. The objective is to minimize cumulative strong regret, summing the utility gaps of both displayed responses relative to the user's best response among the available options. We make two contributions. First, we introduce the problem and release a reproducible preference benchmark and dataset built around a tutoring case study, containing educational questions, LLM-generated answers in six teaching styles, and pairwise judgments from LLM-simulated students with hidden preference profiles. We fit Bradley-Terry models to these judgments to obtain reference utilities for regret evaluation. Second, we propose a baseline that learns a mixture prior over users from completed sessions and adapts to each new user within the session. On students and topics never used in development, it removes 44-48% of random pairs' excess regret and achieves over half the performance of a per-user linear oracle fitted in hindsight. We release code, prompts, and the benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理阶段的个性化问题：系统从固定的人设提示词集合中在线选择，用户逐一到访并提出短问题序列，每个问题展示两个回答并观察一次成对选择。作者将其建模为情境对决赌博机（contextual dueling bandit）的变体，目标是最小化累积强遗憾。贡献包括：发布一个可复现的偏好基准与数据集（辅导案例，含教育问题、六种教学风格的 LLM 回答、隐藏偏好画像的 LLM 模拟学生的成对判断），并用 Bradley-Terry 模型拟合出参考效用；以及提出一个基线方法，从已完成会话中学习用户混合先验并在会话内自适应。实验表明该方法在新学生与新主题上可消除 44-48% 的随机配对的超额遗憾，达到事后拟合的按用户线性 oracle 的一半以上性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能以不同风格回答同一问题，但用户偏好的风格是隐藏的，且因用户和问题而异，因此需要在推理阶段进行个性化。
AI.method: 将交互形式化为情境对决赌博机变体：用户顺序到达，每人提出短问题序列，系统每题展示两个回答并观察一次成对选择；学习者初始无偏好数据，需在会话内自适应并跨用户共享信息。以最小化累积强遗憾（两个展示回答相对于用户最优回答的效用差距之和）为目标。方法上提出从已完成会话学习用户混合先验、并在会话内对新用户自适应的基线；同时构建辅导案例基准，含教育问题、六种教学风格的 LLM 回答及模拟学生的成对判断，并用 Bradley-Terry 模型拟合参考效用。
AI.result: 在开发阶段未使用过的学生与主题上，该方法消除了随机配对超额遗憾的 44-48%，并达到事后拟合的按用户线性 oracle 一半以上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了推理阶段个性化选择这一新问题，提供了可复现的偏好基准、数据集、代码与提示词，并给出了有效的在线自适应基线，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: DexNinja: Learning Robust Dexterous Cutting Policy with a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Engine
summary: Cutting a piece of food looks effortless in human hands. For a robot, however, every cut is a high-contact interaction with a deformable, elasto-plastic object whose behavior changes with pose, contact mode, and cutting stage. Collecting real-world data is expensive and wasteful: each trial typically contaminates or damages the food, so obtaining scalable real world data for dexterous cutting is expensive and difficult. Simulation is an appealing alternative, but a large sim-to-real gap exists in both physics and perception. This gap is especially severe for topology-changing interactions like cutting, where small errors in contact, friction, or material and elasticity responses quickly compound. We propose \textsc{DexNinja}, a real2sim2real framework that turns a handful of real demonstrations into a dense and realistic training distribution. \textsc{DexNinja} (i) reconstructs object instances from real captures, (ii) randomizes physically meaningful parameters under category-level constraints, and (iii) produces augmented dexterous manipulation episodes using a custom differentiable simulator that couples robot dynamics, tactile contact, and deformable cutting. We evaluate \textsc{DexNinja} on a dexterous food-slicing task and show that (1) with tens of real demonstrations and hundreds of augmented simulator data, the success rate could reach more than 60\%. (2) the augmented data consistently improves success rates when only using real data with more than 20\% via sim-to-real, and (3) the resulting policies generalize to out-of-distribution objects with varying shapes and sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出DexNinja，一种real2sim2real框架，用少量真实演示生成密集真实训练分布，用于灵巧食物切割任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人切割食物是高接触交互任务，对象为可变形弹塑性体，其行为随位姿、接触模式和切割阶段变化。真实数据采集昂贵且具破坏性，每次试验会污染或损坏食物，难以规模化。仿真虽可替代，但在物理与感知上存在严重sim-to-real差距，尤其对切割这类拓扑变化交互，接触、摩擦、材料与弹性响应的微小误差会快速累积。
AI.method: DexNinja包含三步：(i) 从真实采集重建物体实例；(ii) 在类别级约束下随机化物理有意义参数；(iii) 使用自定义可微仿真器耦合机器人动力学、触觉接触与可变形切割，生成增强的灵巧操作片段。
AI.result: 在灵巧食物切片任务上评估：(1) 用数十条真实演示与数百条增强仿真数据，成功率可达60%以上；(2) 仅用真实数据时，经sim-to-real增强数据持续提升成功率超过20%；(3) 所得策略可泛化到形状和尺寸不同的分布外物体。
AI.conclusion: DexNinja通过real2sim2real方式，将少量真实演示扩展为密集训练分布，有效缓解切割任务中的sim-to-real差距，提升成功率并增强对分布外物体的泛化能力。

title: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
summary: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AReA，一种免训练注意力机制，其感受野随去噪过程从粗到细演变：早期对下采样 K/V 做跨尺度粗注意力捕获全局结构，后期在逐渐收缩的窗口内做局部注意力精修细节，从而在超出训练分辨率生成任务上超越现有免训练基线，且更快更高效。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers（DiTs）在超出训练分辨率生成图像时面临两大问题：token 数随分辨率快速增长导致全注意力的二次复杂度代价高昂；同时输出常出现结构失真与细节退化。作者将二者归因于"统一全注意力"：每一步都关注所有 token，既带来二次开销，又使模型暴露于超出训练范围的 token 数量与相对距离，导致分布外（OOD）。作者进一步观察到去噪过程中注意力的有效感受野会自然收窄——早期全局、后期局部。
AI.method: AReA 是一种免训练的注意力机制，其感受野随去噪进程从粗到细演化。早期步骤对下采样的键和值执行跨尺度粗注意力，以捕获全局上下文并形成结构；后期步骤在逐步收缩的窗口内执行局部注意力，以精修细节。该方法不引入额外参数，也无需训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，AReA 在多个目标分辨率与不同模型上均持续优于当前最先进的免训练基线，同时速度更快、效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过在去噪过程中让注意力感受野由粗到细演化，AReA 有效缓解了全注意力带来的二次开销与分布外问题，为超出训练分辨率的 DiT 图像生成提供了一种无需训练、即插即用且更高效的解决方案。

title: Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology
summary: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.

AI.tldr: 提出LIMIT（Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining）方法，通过冻结视觉编码器、仅微调文本编码器，利用可规模化获取的临床病理报告进行对比式视觉-语言预训练，构建CONCH-Z模型，在22项任务上取得最优零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 病理视觉-语言预训练普遍依赖社交媒体、教学视频、论文等策展式图像-文本数据集。此类语料相对于组织形态多样性而言稀疏，且难以进一步扩展，因为病理学家在临床实践中不会常规撰写描述性文本。因此需要寻找可规模化生成的替代监督信号，如常规诊断流程中产出的切片级病理报告。
AI.method: 采用弱监督设置，核心挑战是报告描述宏观诊断结论而patch级视觉特征描述微观发现，存在语义粒度不匹配。LIMIT做法：冻结预训练视觉编码器，仅微调文本编码器；将报告嵌入作为cross-attention query，在patch特征bag上进行注意力聚合，生成report-conditioned的切片表示，并用InfoNCE损失优化。基于此构建CONCH-Z，将CONCH v1.5的文本编码器对齐到33.5万份临床报告。
AI.result: 在涵盖patch级分类、肿瘤检测和切片级亚型分型的22项任务上评估，CONCH-Z相较基于策展式caption数据训练的视觉-语言编码器取得最先进的零样本性能，同时缩小了与使用更多参数和算力训练的切片级基础模型之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 临床病理报告可作为可规模化的弱监督信号用于病理视觉-语言预训练；冻结视觉、仅调文本的LIMIT策略能有效弥合宏观报告与微观特征间的粒度鸿沟，使模型在多种下游任务上具备强零样本迁移能力。代码与模型已开源于 https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT。

title: IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback
summary: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

AI.tldr: 提出 IsoVRBench 基准与 IsoVRM 奖励模型，通过"单属性受控干预"自动构造偏好对，揭示现有视频奖励模型在时间顺序等关键维度上的失效，并证明其作为训练数据可提升奖励模型与生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频奖励模型基于人类对成对视频的偏好进行训练与评测，但这两段视频往往同时在提示对齐、视觉保真度、运动、生成器身份等多个属性上存在差异。因此整体准确率无法揭示奖励模型究竟能可靠区分哪些视频属性，评测缺乏诊断性，也难以定位模型在特定维度上的失败。
AI.method: 采用受控干预构造偏好对：在保持其余属性不变的前提下，仅改变生成视频的某一个属性，从而在无需人工标注的情况下，天然获得"沿某一特定维度差异"的偏好标签。据此构建 IsoVRBench，包含八类干预、共 8,000 对样本。进而将合成的孤立干预对用作训练数据，训练奖励模型 IsoVRM，并用其微调生成器得到 IsoWan。
AI.result: SOTA 奖励模型能区分不同生成器之间的整体质量差异，却遗漏了时间顺序等重要特征：在帧重排任务上最优奖励模型仅 60.8%，而人类为 100%；且现有基准上的排名无法预测这一失败。作为训练数据，孤立干预对使 IsoVRM 在 VBench-2.0 上比使用更大规模人工标注偏好数据训练的对照模型高出 3.8 分；用 IsoVRM 后训练的生成器 IsoWan 在人类偏好上优于使用人工数据的对照；与人工数据结合时收益可叠加。
AI.conclusion: 基于受控干预的偏好对无需人工标注、可自动生成，因而基准与训练数据能随生成器演进而低成本扩展。这为视频奖励建模提供了更具诊断性的评测方式与有效且可扩展的训练信号。

title: When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen
summary: Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/

AI.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型在判断相机左右运动时表现接近随机，本文提出CameraVLM，通过运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐，仅用9B参数在三个基准上大幅超越20余个基线，并在人类研究中达到或超过GPT-6 Astra与人类观察者水平。
AI.motivation: 现代VLM虽能解视觉谜题、处理长视频，但在判断相机左移或右移时几乎等同于抛硬币。已有工作分别尝试加入相机运动数据或几何表示，但单独使用均无法弥补该能力缺口。
AI.method: 作者提出相机运动理解需同时满足两个条件：（1）表示需将屏外相机运动与屏上光流动态耦合；（2）需由语言模型解释，而非作为独立的位姿或深度估计器训练。据此提出CameraVLM，结合运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐：相机token捕捉屏外相机运动，光流token捕捉屏上主体与背景运动，并采用两阶段训练策略保持语言在回路中，使二者与相机运动语义联合学习。
AI.result: 仅9B参数的CameraVLM在三个基准、20余个基线上大幅超越所有开源模型与相机运动专用模型，并在48人参与的研究中达到或超过GPT-6 Astra及人类观察者的表现。
AI.conclusion: 相机运动理解的关键在于将屏外相机运动表示与屏上光流动态耦合，并交由语言模型解释；CameraVLM验证了该双条件假设的有效性，以较小参数规模实现了显著性能优势。

title: From Conceptual EneMonIE to an Executable Backend: A Modular Architecture for Energy Information Extractionand Grounded Question Answering
summary: The original EneMonIE proposal describes a Web-based semantic system for continuously monitoring energy trends through targeted information extraction from heterogeneous online media. This article presents EneMonIE-Backend, an implementation-derived redesign that converts that conceptual pipeline into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend. The architecture separates five concerns: data sources, acquisition and normalization, semantic processing, knowledge organization, and persistent storage. It operationalizes configurable connectors for RSS feeds, URL collections, arXiv, social-media JSON files, and open-data CSV files; it also introduces question-driven Web search and scraping. Relevant documents pass through energy categorization, named entity recognition, temporal and event extraction, source sensitive sentiment analysis, and extractive summarization. The resulting semantic representations support entity co-occurrence graphs, cross-document interlinking, cluster-level information fusion, and relational persistence in SQLite. Three grounded question-answering paths are exposed at the backend level: live Web evidence, the stored corpus, and selected configured resources. Answer generation uses a language model when configured and otherwise falls back to deterministic extractive output. Unlike the original proposal, the presented architecture deliberately excludes the user-interface and server-side application layers, allowing the semantic core to be embedded in different applications. A deterministic smoke validation confirms relevance filtering, persistence, clustering, evidence retrieval, and document deletion. The work provides a reproducible architectural basis for future evaluation on larger multilingual energy corpora.

AI.tldr: 该文提出EneMonIE-Backend，将原EneMonIE概念性网络语义系统的流水线重构为模块化、可执行、与应用无关的后端，实现异构在线媒体的能源趋势持续监测。
AI.motivation: 原EneMonIE仅停留于概念方案，缺乏可执行的系统实现，难以复用与评估。本文旨在将其语义流水线转化为模块化、可执行、与应用解耦的后端架构，为后续大规模评估提供可复现的基础。
AI.method: 架构划分为五类关注点：数据源、采集与规范化、语义处理、知识组织、持久化存储。实现可配置连接器（RSS、URL集合、arXiv、社交媒体JSON、开放数据CSV），并引入问题驱动的Web搜索与抓取。文档经能源分类、命名实体识别、时间与事件抽取、源敏感情感分析、抽取式摘要处理。语义表示支持实体共现图、跨文档互链、簇级信息融合及SQLite关系型持久化。后端暴露三条 grounded 问答路径：实时Web证据、已存语料、指定配置资源；答案生成在配置语言模型时使用之，否则回退到确定性抽取式输出。有意排除用户界面与服务端应用层。
AI.result: 确定性冒烟验证确认了相关性过滤、持久化、聚类、证据检索与文档删除等功能均正常。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可复现的架构基础，可用于未来在更大规模多语言能源语料上的评估。

title: HybridDualPathNet: Cross-Fusion Attention of EfficientNetV2 and Swin Transformer for Brain MRI Classification of Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
comment: Two experimental settings: Kaggle-only image-level evaluation and combined Kaggle and ADNI evaluation with patient-wise separation for ADNI subjects
summary: Separating Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Parkinson's Disease (PD), and Healthy Controls (HC) using structural MRI remains challenging because disease signatures overlap and model performance can be strongly affected by data partitioning. We present HybridDualPathNet, a hybrid architecture combining EfficientNetV2-S for local features and Swin-Tiny for global context through a Cross-Fusion Attention (CFA) module. We evaluate the model in two experiments. First, on the Kaggle APD-3-Class dataset using an image-level split, the model achieves 98.25% accuracy. Second, on a combined Kaggle and Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset containing 17,859 slices, we use a per-source split with patient-wise separation for ADNI subjects. In this setting, the model achieves 73.37% standard accuracy and a macro AUC of 0.880. Source-stratified evaluation reveals a substantial domain gap, with 91.2% accuracy on Kaggle test images and 59.2% on ADNI test images. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error from 0.130 to 0.015, while split-conformal prediction achieves 89.5% coverage. Saliency analyses using Grad-CAM++, Integrated Gradients, and occlusion indicate that model activations concentrate on brain tissue. These results highlight the importance of patient-level separation, cross-dataset evaluation, and uncertainty estimation when assessing MRI classification systems. The findings also show that strong performance on a single dataset does not necessarily translate to reliable generalization across imaging cohorts.

AI.tldr: 提出混合架构HybridDualPathNet（EfficientNetV2-S局部特征+Swin-Tiny全局上下文，经CFA融合）用于AD/PD/HC的结构MRI分类；在图像级划分下Kaggle数据集准确率98.25%，但在含ADNI的跨数据集、患者级划分下仅73.37%（macro AUC 0.880），暴露显著域偏移与泛化局限。
AI.motivation: AD、PD与HC的结构MRI影像特征存在重叠，分类难度大；且模型性能高度依赖数据划分方式，单数据集上的高性能未必代表跨影像队列的可靠泛化能力，因此需要更严谨的评估范式。
AI.method: 提出HybridDualPathNet混合架构：EfficientNetV2-S提取局部特征，Swin-Tiny建模全局上下文，通过Cross-Fusion Attention（CFA）模块融合。设计两组实验：(1) Kaggle APD-3-Class数据集，图像级划分；(2) 合并Kaggle与ADNI共17,859张切片，采用按来源划分并对ADNI受试者进行患者级分离。引入温度缩放做校准、split-conformal预测做不确定性估计，并用Grad-CAM++、Integrated Gradients与遮挡分析进行显著性解释。
AI.result: 图像级划分下Kaggle准确率98.25%；跨数据集患者级划分下标准准确率73.37%、macro AUC 0.880。按来源分层评估显示显著域差距：Kaggle测试91.2%，ADNI测试仅59.2%。温度缩放将期望校准误差从0.130降至0.015，split-conformal预测覆盖率达89.5%。显著性分析表明模型激活集中于脑组织区域。
AI.conclusion: 评估MRI分类系统时，患者级数据分离、跨数据集验证与不确定性估计至关重要；单数据集上的强性能不能等同于跨影像队列的可靠泛化。

title: Nufo: A Benchmark for Ewe Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains challenging for low-resource languages, where the scarcity of transcribed speech limits the development of accurate systems. This challenge is particularly acute for African languages such as Ewe, which has millions of speakers but remains underrepresented in publicly available ASR resources and benchmarks. In this work, we consolidate, normalize, and partition existing Ewe speech resources into a standardized 174-hour Ewe ASR benchmark, the largest to date to our knowledge. We fine-tune and evaluate pretrained speech models, including Whisper and AfriHuBERT, to establish strong baselines on our benchmark. Whisper-medium achieves a word error rate (WER) of 37.98%, while AfriHuBERT achieves 39.70% on the test set. We further provide a qualitative analysis of common recognition errors. We release the benchmark under the name Nufo, derived from the Ewe word for "talk", accompanied by models and evaluation resources, to facilitate future research on Ewe and other underrepresented African languages.

AI.tldr: 该工作整合并标准化了现有埃维语语音资源，构建了迄今最大的174小时埃维语ASR基准Nufo，并微调Whisper与AfriHuBERT建立基线，最佳WER为37.98%。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的转写语音稀缺，限制了准确ASR系统的开发；埃维语虽有数百万使用者，却在公开ASR资源与基准中严重不足。
AI.method: 整合、归一化并划分现有埃维语语音资源，构建标准化的174小时基准；微调并评估预训练语音模型（Whisper、AfriHuBERT）以建立基线；并对常见识别错误进行定性分析。
AI.result: Whisper-medium在测试集上取得37.98%的WER，AfriHuBERT为39.70%；同时提供了对常见识别错误的定性分析。
AI.conclusion: 以Nufo（源自埃维语“talk”）之名发布基准及模型与评测资源，促进埃维语及其他欠代表非洲语言的未来研究。

title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
summary: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.

AI.tldr: 提出StartLux-Decision决策模型系列（0.8B–27B），融合单次预测与置信度引导推理，通过三阶段训练与RLCD²强化学习方法优化推理效率，在Decision Index 0.3及新基准DecisionPivot上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有决策模型难以兼顾高效单次推理与不确定性情形下的显式推理能力，且推理链冗长、效率低；同时缺乏可程序化验证的计算决策评测基准。
AI.method: 提出两类变体：Instant采用全注意力层双向注意力以提升单次推理决策准确率；AutoThink对不确定决策触发显式推理、对高置信情形直接作答。三阶段训练管线先建立共享决策能力，再专业化两类变体，并通过推理监督与强化学习赋予AutoThink推理能力。提出RLCD²，利用冻结模型与恰当评分规则奖励决策概率质量提升，并对过长推理链施加软惩罚。另构建DecisionPivot基准，由仅一处答案改变细节的对比对构成，可程序化验证。
AI.result: RLCD²将生成限制内终止的推理链比例最高提升48个百分点，平均推理长度最高缩短65%，同时基本保持决策准确率。在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant较最强的同规模开源决策模型高7.4–16.9分，27B AutoThink达73.4。在DecisionPivot上，AutoThink在成对准确率上较Instant高11.5–18.4分并居评估系统首位。模型支持vLLM、llama.cpp与MLX，并提供低内存量化版本。
AI.conclusion: StartLux-Decision通过置信度引导推理与RLCD²实现了效率与决策准确率的良好平衡，并在多个基准上验证其优越性，具备实际部署可行性。

title: From Sampled Evidence to Radiology Reports: Objectives, Constraints, and Realization
summary: Sampling multiple reports creates an inference problem: how should sampled evidence be converted into a final decision, and does a better structured decision yield a better report? We study these questions through a framework that separates the decision signal, scoring objective, and feasible decision set, followed by text realization. On MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray, controlled comparisons across 13 generator configurations per benchmark under grouped development/test evaluation reveal three findings. First, changing the objective under fixed evidence and rule capacity changes predictions and their held-out metric trade-offs. Second, relaxing candidate constraints has objective-dependent effects under shared signals and frozen scores. Diagnostics connect the IU macro-oriented assertion increase to near-zero label thresholds and show that limited candidate coverage coexists with selection headroom. Third, a controlled realization study with SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B shows that decision-level gains can be attenuated, amplified, or reversed. Change decomposition reveals that realization can remove incorrect assertions while losing correct findings, so target fidelity and reference accuracy need not improve together. Finding gains also do not consistently improve reference-based report quality. These results motivate separate evaluation of decision rules, candidate constraints, and realized reports.

AI.tldr: 论文通过解耦"决策信号—评分目标—可行决策集—文本实现"的框架,研究多报告采样下的推理问题,并在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU-Xray 上发现:决策规则、候选约束与文本实现需分别评估,决策层面的收益未必能传递到最终报告质量。
AI.motivation: 采样多份报告时会遇到推理难题:如何把采样得到的证据转化为最终决策,以及结构更好的决策是否真能带来更好的报告。现有工作往往将决策与报告生成混为一谈,缺乏对二者关系的受控分析。
AI.method: 提出一个将决策信号、评分目标与可行决策集分离、再进行文本实现的框架。在 MIMIC-CXR 与 IU-Xray 上,采用分组开发/测试评估,每个基准对 13 种生成器配置进行受控比较;并开展 SFT-Qwen3-VL-8B 的受控实现研究,配合变化分解分析。
AI.result: 三项发现:(1)在证据与规则容量固定时,改变评分目标会改变预测及其留出指标间的权衡;(2)在共享信号与冻结分数下,放松候选约束的效果依赖目标;诊断表明 IU 宏观导向断言增加源于近零标签阈值,且有限候选覆盖与选择余量并存;(3)受控实现研究表明决策层面的增益可能被削弱、放大甚至反转,实现过程会剔除错误断言的同时丢失正确发现,目标保真度与参考准确率未必同向变化,决策增益也不稳定地改善基于参考的报告质量。
AI.conclusion: 应分别评估决策规则、候选约束与最终实现的报告,而非将决策质量与报告质量混为一谈。

title: SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Pattern Recognition
summary: Face recognition systems are deployed widely enough that a photograph shared online can be matched without its subject's consent. Generator-based protection methods rely on heavy pretrained backbones, multi-stage inference or visible semantic edits. We introduce SSM-Attack, a black-box face privacy framework built on Selective State Space Models. Rather than synthesizing the perturbation, the state-space model predicts in one linear-time pass a spatial allocation of the perturbation budget, marking which facial locations carry identity evidence; a short projected refinement then sets the values within this per-pixel budget. Against published benchmark results, SSM-Attack attains the highest average black-box attack success rate on all three evaluation sets: 87.10 percent on CelebA-HQ, 86.90 on LADN and 81.15 on FFHQ, the last from a network that never saw that dataset. The allocation network holds 5.73 million parameters, or 16.13 million with the frozen networks used by its quality terms. Under the same cap of 0.10 on the maximum per-pixel change, allocation improves structural similarity by 0.044, peak signal-to-noise ratio by 1.62 decibels and Frechet Inception Distance by 11.2 points over a uniform map while spending 37 percent of its capacity. Strong facial privacy protection therefore does not require a large generative prior; it requires knowing where to spend a small one.

AI.tldr: 提出 SSM-Attack：基于选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的黑盒人脸隐私保护框架，用 SSM 一次线性时间预测扰动预算的空间分配（标识身份证据的面部位置），再由短程投影细化确定像素值；在三个人脸基准上取得最高平均黑盒攻击成功率，且以更小容量实现更优图像质量。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别系统广泛部署，在线照片可在未经本人同意下被匹配；现有基于生成器的保护方法依赖庞大预训练骨干、多阶段推理或可见的语义编辑，成本高、效率低。
AI.method: SSM-Attack：黑盒人脸隐私框架，基于 Selective State Space Models。不合成扰动本身，而是由状态空间模型以线性时间单次前向推理预测扰动预算的空间分配图，标记携带身份证据的面部区域；随后通过短程投影式细化（projected refinement）在逐像素预算约束内确定扰动幅值。
AI.result: 平均黑盒攻击成功率最高：CelebA-HQ 87.10%、LADN 86.90%、FFHQ 81.15%（后者为未见过该数据集的网络）。分配网络 5.73M 参数，含冻结质量项网络共 16.13M。在最大逐像素扰动 0.10 的相同上限下，相比均匀分配图，分配策略将 SSIM 提升 0.044、PSNR 提升 1.62 dB、FID 改善 11.2，且仅使用 37% 的容量。
AI.conclusion: 强人脸隐私保护不依赖大型生成先验，而在于知道如何花掉一个小先验——即关键在于扰动预算的定位式分配而非合成器规模。

title: Thinking Outside the Bots: Human Ideas in AI's Semantic Blind Spots Are Not Inferior
summary: AI-generated outputs are frequently perceived as highly creative, but also tend to be more similar to each other (homogenized) than human ideas. Does the human heterogeneity that extends beyond AI reflect valuable thinking that AI misses? Alternatively, is greater human heterogeneity driven by lower-quality ideas and less effective thinking that AI avoids? We developed Expansion of Divergent Generative Expression (EDGE) to map AI's semantic "blind spots" by assessing how strongly/weakly individual human ideas were represented in a task-matched AI semantic comparison set. Specifically, we compared human-generated vs. AI-generated ideas across three open-ended tasks: college admissions essays, alternative uses for everyday objects, and interpersonal advice. Across all three tasks, human responses extended into semantic regions sparsely covered by AI outputs. These distinctively human responses showed no meaningful deficits in creativity, quality, or effectiveness, were associated with equal-or-better academic performance, and with credibly superior ratings and achievement for some outcomes. These ideas were thus not merely poor-performing variation; they performed as well as or better than ideas that overlapped more strongly with AI ideas. More distinctive human ideas tended to receive higher creativity ratings, but this relationship was weak or reversed for AI ideas. Taken together, these results suggest that differentiation among human-generated ideas does not reflect poor thinking that AI can safely omit, and instead may afford both individual and population-level advantages.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出EDGE框架，通过语义比对定位AI的"语义盲区"，发现人类创意在语义空间中延伸至AI覆盖稀疏的区域，且这些独特的人类想法在创造力、质量与成效上并无缺陷，部分指标上反而更优。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容常被视为富有创意，但比人类想法更同质化。作者试图辨析：人类超出AI的异质性究竟代表AI所缺失的有价值思维，还是由低质量想法与低效思维导致的无意义变异。
AI.method: 开发"发散性生成表达扩展"（EDGE）方法，衡量个体人类想法在与任务匹配的AI语义比较集中的被代表程度（强/弱），以此映射AI的语义"盲区"。在三个开放式任务（大学申请文书、日常物品的替代用途、人际建议）中对比人类与AI生成的想法，并结合创造力、质量、成效评分及学业表现等指标进行分析。
AI.result: 在三个任务中，人类回答均延伸至AI输出稀疏覆盖的语义区域。这些"独特人类"回答在创造力、质量或有效性上无显著劣势，与同等或更好的学业表现相关，并在部分结果上获得更可信的优越评分与成就。想法与AI重叠度低并不等于表现差。人类想法越独特，创造力评分往往越高，但该关系对AI想法而言较弱甚至反转。
AI.conclusion: 人类想法的分化并非AI可以安全剔除的"劣质思维"；相反，它可能同时带来个体层面与群体层面的优势，提示AI生成内容的同质化可能构成一种能力缺口。

title: The Curse of Knowledge in Role-Playing Language Models
summary: Role-playing language models speak as characters in games and agent simulations, where the system records what each character can hear, see and understand. We test whether characters respect these boundaries in 480 scenes, each with a counterfactual twin that changes only the hidden fact, so mentions of the twin's fact measure guessing. Across 11 open-weight models, characters use content from speech they cannot understand or hear at 67 and 72 percentage points (pp) above this baseline, although most models correctly state what the character perceives. This is a curse of knowledge. The leak extends to hidden actions and private messages and changes where characters search. Five of six proprietary models rarely leak, but compliance in strong models depends on input format.
