Changing only the scene layout or character description raises the rate in two otherwise compliant open-weight models from under 10 to over 60 pp, and combined changes raise two proprietary models from near zero to 13 and 21~pp. Writing the line as the scene's author leaks nearly as much as role-play, and thinking rarely helps. Giving models only what the character observes stops the leak without hiding what it may report.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究角色扮演语言模型是否会泄露角色感知边界之外的信息（即“知识诅咒”），构建480个场景及仅改变隐藏事实的反事实对照，发现多数开源权重模型严重泄露不可听/不可理解内容，且泄露受输入格式、场景布局与角色描述等影响；仅提供角色可观察信息可消除泄露。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演语言模型需扮演游戏或智能体模拟中的角色，系统会记录每个角色能听到、看到和理解的内容。理想情况下，角色应遵守这些感知边界。论文旨在检验模型是否会在角色扮演中违背这些边界，泄露角色本不应获知的隐藏信息。
AI.method: 设计480个场景，每个场景配有一个反事实孪生场景，仅改变隐藏事实；通过角色提及孪生事实来衡量“猜测”基线。测试11个开源权重模型。将泄露测试扩展到隐藏动作和私密消息，并观察其对角色搜索位置的影响。同时测试6个专有模型、改变输入格式、场景布局、角色描述、以作者身份写作以及加入思考过程等条件。最后尝试只给模型角色可观察信息。
AI.result: 11个开源权重模型中，角色使用听不见或听不懂的语音内容的比例分别比基线高67和72个百分点，尽管多数模型能正确陈述角色感知。泄露也延伸到隐藏动作、私密消息并改变角色搜索位置。6个专有模型中5个很少泄露，但强模型的合规性依赖输入格式。仅改变场景布局或角色描述，可使两个原本合规的开源权重模型泄露率从不足10个百分点升至超过60个百分点；组合改变可使两个专有模型从接近零升至13和21个百分点。以场景作者身份写作几乎与角色扮演泄露相当，思考过程很少有帮助。仅提供角色可观察信息可阻止泄露，同时不隐藏其可报告内容。
AI.conclusion: 角色扮演模型存在“知识诅咒”，会泄露角色感知边界外的隐藏信息，且泄露受多种输入与提示设计影响。仅向模型提供角色可观察信息是消除泄露的有效方法。

title: HairFlow: Modeling 3D Hair Strands with Multi-Modal Conditioned Diffusion
summary: Modeling 3D hair strands is challenging due to complex hairstyle geometry, scarce high-quality training data, and incomplete or noisy input observations. Foundation models offer broader hairstyle priors, but their outputs are not directly usable for strand-based rendering and simulation. Existing approaches require costly per-instance optimization to fit hair priors to meshes from foundation models and 2D orientations from specialized predictors trained on limited hair data, restricting efficiency and generalization. We present HairFlow, a multimodal conditioned diffusion framework for efficient and controllable hair strands modeling. HairFlow conditions strand generation on two complementary representations: a coarse mesh that constrains global shape and multi-view sketches that specify local strand flow. HairFlow combines an Orientation VAE with a conditioned diffusion transformer to generate volumetric fields that are traced into explicit strands. To overcome the lack of paired sketch-strand training data, we introduce an automatic synthesis pipeline that generates geometrically aligned multi-view sketches with diverse styles representative of inference-time inputs. Experiments show that HairFlow generates plausible 3D strands that faithfully follow the input conditions across diverse hairstyles, substantially reduces inference time, and supports flexible multimodal control.

AI.tldr: HairFlow：一种多模态条件扩散框架，利用粗网格与多视角草图条件，高效可控地生成3D发丝。
AI.motivation: 3D发丝建模受复杂发型几何、高质量训练数据稀缺、输入观测不完整或含噪等限制。基础模型虽提供更强发型先验，但其输出无法直接用于基于发丝的渲染与仿真；现有方法需逐实例昂贵优化以拟合先验，且依赖在有限头发数据上训练的专用预测器，效率与泛化性受限。
AI.method: HairFlow以两种互补表示为条件：约束全局形状的粗网格，以及指定局部发丝流向的多视角草图。框架将Orientation VAE与条件扩散Transformer结合，生成体场并追踪为显式发丝。为解决配对草图-发丝数据缺失，提出自动合成管线，生成几何对齐、风格多样且贴合推理输入的素描数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，HairFlow能跨多样发型生成合理且忠实跟随输入条件的3D发丝，显著缩短推理时间，并支持灵活的多模态控制。
AI.conclusion: HairFlow通过多模态条件扩散与自动草图合成，实现了高效、可控、泛化性强的3D发丝建模，规避了逐实例优化与专用预测器依赖。

title: MID: Mask-Image Distributional Divergence for Evaluating Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Current evaluation protocols for medical image segmentation remain largely anchored in sample-wise comparisons, e.g., Dice and Hausdorff distance, which require each prediction to be paired with a ground-truth mask. Yet two limitations arise in practice: they are inapplicable when predictions are made on unlabeled data; and even when annotations are available, they cannot assess whether a collection of predictions matches the distributional structure of the ground-truth population. We introduce MID (Mask-Image Distributional Divergence), a distribution-level evaluation metric for medical image segmentation. MID builds upon the observation that segmentation quality is a property of the joint image-mask distribution: a mask may be anatomically plausible in isolation yet incorrect for the image it accompanies. MID compares the joint distribution of images and masks between a reference set and a set of predictions, without requiring sample-wise correspondence. This captures both mask realism and image-mask consistency. We evaluate MID across 13 publicly available datasets spanning CT, MRI, and MRA. Under anatomically realistic corruptions across 56 organ groups, MID tracks mean Dice and Hausdorff distance without per-sample ground-truth pairing. MID also detects distributional shifts across modalities and anatomies, identifies image-mask misalignment through controlled shuffling experiments, and produces reliable model rankings across real segmentation models. Official implementation available at github.com/erc-caravel/pytorch-mid

AI.tldr: 提出分布级分割评价指标 MID，在无需样本配对的情况下比较图像-掩膜联合分布，可追踪 Dice、检测分布偏移与图文错位。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割评价依赖 Dice、Hausdorff 等样本级指标，需逐样本真值配对，无法用于无标注数据，也无法评估预测集合与真值群体的分布结构一致性。
AI.method: 基于"分割质量是图像-掩膜联合分布属性"的观察，提出 MID（Mask-Image Distributional Divergence），在参考集与预测集之间比较图像与掩膜的联合分布，无需样本级对应，同时刻画掩膜真实性与图像-掩膜一致性。
AI.result: 在覆盖 CT、MRI、MRA 的 13 个公开数据集上，MID 在 56 个器官组的解剖学真实扰动下无需配对真值即可追踪平均 Dice 与 Hausdorff 距离；可检测跨模态与解剖结构的分布偏移，通过受控打乱实验识别图像-掩膜错位，并在真实分割模型上给出可靠排序。
AI.conclusion: MID 是一种无需样本配对的分布级医学图像分割评价指标，能同时衡量掩膜真实性与图像-掩膜一致性，适用于无标注评估、分布偏移检测与模型排序。

title: WIRE: Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding of Frozen Video LLMs
summary: Video language models represent a video as a long sequence of visual embeddings in a decoder's input. Every visual embedding is processed by every decoder layer during prefill, stored in the key value cache, and attended by every generated token, so a long video raises prefill, memory, and generation cost at once. We present WIRE (Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding), which reduces this recurring cost by moving part of the video conditioned computation of a frozen video language model from its input activations into a temporary low rank update of its weights. WIRE keeps a short explicit visual context, so the update acts as a correction rather than a replacement of the video. WIRE first compresses the full resolution embeddings of each frame into a small set of carrier tokens using a question conditioned bidirectional selective scan, and physically contracts the decoder input so every decoder layer, cache entry, and decoding step operates on the shorter sequence. Hypernetworks at selected decoder layers read the compressed forward pass together with a readout of the full resolution features removed by contraction and generate LoRA updates to the attention and feedforward projections. The updates are merged after prefill, so autoregressive decoding runs the unmodified frozen backbone. On Qwen3-VL-8B, WIRE with 16 carrier tokens per frame contracts the visual stream by $3.5\times$, reduces decoder prefill time by $3.35\times$ at 256 frames and $4.14\times$ at 1024 frames, shrinks the key value cache proportionally, and keeps per token decoding latency approximately constant. Across nine benchmark settings at 256 frames, it obtains the highest average accuracy among efficient video language models we evaluate under a common 256 frame budget.

AI.tldr: WIRE将视频语言模型的视频条件计算从输入激活转移到冻结权重的临时低秩更新中，通过压缩视觉embeddings为少量载体token并生成LoRA更新，显著降低预填充时间与KV缓存开销，同时保持准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型将视频表示为长序列视觉embeddings，每个embedding在预填充时被每层解码器处理、存入KV缓存并被每个生成token关注，导致长视频的预填充、内存和生成成本同时升高。
AI.method: WIRE保留短显式视觉上下文，将视频条件计算部分移入冻结权重的临时低秩更新。首先用问题条件双向选择性扫描将每帧全分辨率embeddings压缩为少量载体token，物理收缩解码器输入；选定解码器层中的超网络读取压缩前向传播及被移除的全分辨率特征读出，生成注意力与前馈投影的LoRA更新；预填充后合并更新，自回归解码运行未修改的冻结主干。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B上，每帧16个载体token使视觉流收缩3.5倍，256帧预填充时间降低3.35倍，1024帧降低4.14倍，KV缓存成比例缩小，每token解码延迟基本不变；在256帧的九个基准设置中，于统一256帧预算下取得所评估高效视频语言模型中的最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: WIRE通过将视频条件计算从输入激活转移到临时低秩权重更新，在保持短视觉上下文的前提下有效缓解长视频带来的预填充、内存与生成成本，并在效率与准确率间取得良好平衡。

title: Brain2Face: A Study on the Relation of EEG Signals and Spatio-temporal Head Avatars
summary: Driving digital head avatars is classically done by hand-crafted artist design or by image-based facial performance capture. In this work, we ask whether spatio-temporal tracking of the humans's head geometry and appearance can be performed solely from brain signals, i.e., Electroencephalography (EEG). Since prior work mostly focused on activity and emotion recognition, this task is relatively unexplored without even having publicly available high-quality datasets and benchmarks. Thus, we contribute a dataset featuring paired EEG and human head geometry as well as appearance annotations. We synchronize 64-channel EEG with per-frame expression latent codes of a personalized Gaussian head avatar. Second, we introduce a baseline to the task of expression recovery of a head avatar from EEG signals. To this end, we propose a dedicated EEG-to-expression model that takes a temporal sequence of EEG signals as input and regresses the latent expression parameters of the 3D Gaussian head avatar. Lastly, we validate our capture and algorithmic design choices through a benchmark protocol that we introduce to this task. We believe this work paves the way towards better understanding of the relation between EEG signals and facial surface as well as appearance changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅凭脑电信号（EEG）驱动3D高斯头部化身的新任务，贡献了64通道EEG与个性化高斯头部化身逐帧表情潜码同步的数据集，并提出EEG-to-expression基线模型及基准协议。
AI.motivation: 传统数字头部化身驱动依赖手工设计或基于图像的面部表演捕捉。作者探索是否能仅从脑信号（EEG）实现头部几何与外观的时空追踪。由于先前工作多聚焦于活动与情绪识别，该任务几乎未被探索，且缺乏公开的高质量数据集与基准。
AI.method: 1）构建数据集：将64通道EEG与个性化高斯头部化身的逐帧表情潜码进行同步。2）提出基线方法：设计专用的EEG-to-expression模型，以时序EEG信号为输入，回归3D高斯头部化身的表情潜变量参数。3）引入基准协议验证捕捉与算法设计选择。
AI.result: 通过所提出的基准协议验证了数据捕捉与算法设计的有效性，证明了从EEG信号恢复头部化身表情的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解EEG信号与面部表面及外观变化之间的关系奠定了基础，推动了仅凭脑信号驱动数字头部化身的研究方向。

title: claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness
summary: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规格形式化问题，构建了覆盖Dafny、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq四种形式语言的3,234行端到端基准，并推出claimcheck工具：先让模型在不看需求的情况下把形式工件回译成自然语言，再由独立判官模型判断其与原需求是否语义一致。
AI.motivation: 形式验证只能证明程序满足规格，却无法判断规格是否符合作者本意。随着LLM同时编写代码与规格，自然语言需求与形式化规格之间的语义鸿沟成为现实风险：一个比需求更窄的证明虽有机器检查通过，实际毫无价值。因此需要度量并弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1）策划面向规格形式化的端到端基准：涵盖Dafny契约、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq定理陈述四种形式语言，共3,234行，每行将自然语言需求与形式工件配对，并附由执行、证明或来源基准确立的标签；其中三分之一为保持标签的语义保持改写，使判官无法靠检测"被编辑过"来打分。2）提出claimcheck：由一个从未见过原需求的模型将形式工件回译成英文，再由独立的判官模型判断该自然语言表述与需求是否表达同一保证。
AI.result: 在四种语言上，claimcheck相比"单次调用同时看需求与工件"的macro recall提升8.2–9.8分，相比给同一调用提供语义保持改写列表提升4.2–6.0分；让判官也看形式工件会损失1.4–4.5分。在四个同时可见工件的判官中，判官越强增益越小，最强判官仅比"知情单次调用"高出不到1分。
AI.conclusion: 回译—判官式的解耦评估能有效检测错误形式化，显著优于直接让模型比对需求与工件；但增益随判官能力增强而收窄，且额外提供形式工件会削弱该优势。该基准与工具为规格形式化问题的量化评估提供了可复现的基础。

title: UMCR: Universal Medical Concept Recognition through Guideline Integration and Agentic Linking
summary: Medical Concept Recognition is the task of extracting and grounding spans in medical text to entries in a standard ontology. Current methods are generally developed towards a single ontology and source text type (clinical notes, drug labels, etc.) The central challenge is therefore to build methods that adapt to any target ontology without requiring ontology-specific retraining. More recent approaches like REAL and AutoPCR make direct use of Large Language Models and can theoretically adapt to any ontology choice but suffer from a lack of generalization. We propose UMCR, a pipeline that allows extraction and linking to any target ontology using any source text variety, utilizing direct guideline integration and an agentic linking module. We evaluate our method on the recent MedPath benchmark, covering a wide variety of medical text types and vocabularies, and show that our method achieves strong performance across these tasks. This ability unlocks interoperability in the healthcare domain, allowing for extraction and alignment between different medical standards. Our method also reduces dependence on parametric LLM memory, thanks to improved interaction with the target ontology compared to other proposed approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出UMCR，一种可适配任意目标本体与来源文本类型的医学概念识别流水线，结合直接指南整合与智能体链接模块，在MedPath基准上取得较强性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学概念识别方法通常针对单一本体和单一来源文本类型（如临床笔记、药品说明书）开发，核心挑战在于构建无需本体特定重训练即可适配任意目标本体的方法。REAL、AutoPCR等基于大语言模型的新方法理论上可适配任意本体，但泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出UMCR流水线，支持用任意来源文本类型抽取并链接到任意目标本体，采用直接指南整合（direct guideline integration）与智能体链接模块（agentic linking module）。
AI.result: 在近期MedPath基准上评估，覆盖多种医学文本类型与词汇表，方法在这些任务上均取得较强性能。
AI.conclusion: UMCR解锁了医疗领域的互操作性，支持不同医学标准间的抽取与对齐；相比其他方法，其与目标本体的交互更优，从而降低了对参数化LLM记忆的依赖。

title: PIG: Parallel Inconsistency Guidance for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by decoding multiple masked positions per forward pass. However, accuracy is known to drop when parallel decoding trajectories deviate from their sequential counterparts, which are slow and expensive "oracles" that adhere to the joint distribution of language. In this paper, we propose Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG), a new paradigm that uses a trained auxiliary model to directly estimate the inconsistency between parallel and sequential generation from a single model forward pass. During inference, masked positions are traversed by decreasing confidence, and tokens are added to the parallel decode set one-at-a-time until the total estimated inconsistency between the parallel and sequential generation exceeds a threshold. Surprisingly, it suffices to train a lightweight ~2M parameter auxiliary model on a small mixture drawn from OpenCoder, GSM8K-train, MATH-train, and MBPP-train. For LLaDA-8B Instruct and NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct, PIG extends the accuracy-TPF frontier on GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, HumanEval, and MMLU, when compared to the industry standard Fast-dLLM and measures favorably on LLaDA-8B Instruct against DAPD, KLASS, EB-sampler, and other learned unmasking policies.

AI.tldr: 提出Parallel Inconsistency Guidance (PIG)，用一个约2M参数的轻量辅助模型单次前向估计并行解码与顺序生成之间的不一致度，据此逐token扩增并行解码集，从而在扩散语言模型上扩展准确率-TPF前沿。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过一次前向解码多个掩码位置来加速生成，但并行解码轨迹一旦偏离顺序解码（遵循语言联合分布的慢速“oracle”），准确率就会下降。因此需要一种机制，在保持并行加速的同时控制这种偏差。
AI.method: 提出PIG范式：训练一个辅助模型，仅用单次前向即可直接估计并行生成与顺序生成之间的不一致度。推理时按置信度降序遍历掩码位置，逐个将token加入并行解码集，直到估计的不一致度总和超过阈值为止。辅助模型规模很小（约2M参数），仅在来自OpenCoder、GSM8K-train、MATH-train和MBPP-train的小型混合数据上训练。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B Instruct与NemotronDiffusion-3B Instruct上，PIG在GSM8K、MATH500、MBPP、HumanEval和MMLU上相比工业标准Fast-dLLM扩展了准确率-TPF前沿；在LLaDA-8B Instruct上与DAPD、KLASS、EB-sampler及其他学习式反掩码策略相比也表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 用极小辅助模型估计并行-顺序不一致度，可作为扩散语言模型解码的通用引导信号，在多种推理与代码基准上以更优的准确率-TPF权衡超越Fast-dLLM及多种既有反掩码策略。

title: What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs
summary: A shared latent space is often assumed to make representations from different schemas directly interchangeable, yet sharing parameters, dimensionality, or a prior does not determine how corresponding instances are expressed in latent coordinates. We show that this assumption conflates recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse. In a controlled multi-schema motion VAE on HumanML3D, even identical inputs yield only $5.9$--$17.7\%$ raw Recall@1 and $0.221$--$0.484$ paired-token cosine, despite correspondence being almost perfectly recoverable after linear calibration. Cycle consistency strengthens recoverability but still leaves direct retrieval and token agreement near zero. In contrast, only $64$ paired clips raise raw Recall@1 to $88.4$--$90.3\%$ and token cosine to approximately $0.82$, making most post-hoc alignment unnecessary, although crossed decoding remains substantially worse than native reconstruction. We further find that reducing measured marginal discrepancy does not imply schema invariance. These results show that a shared backbone or prior does not ensure directly compatible latent coordinates, while limited paired correspondence can substantially improve direct compatibility in the tested setting.

AI.tldr: 共享潜在空间常被假设为可直接互换，但本研究表明共享参数、维度或先验并不决定对应实例的潜在坐标表达；对应关系可恢复、直接兼容与解码器复用是三个不同概念。
AI.motivation: 领域内普遍假设：只要不同schema（如不同动作表示或多模态schema）共享潜在空间，其表征即可直接互换。本文将检验该假设，区分"可恢复的对应关系""直接兼容性"与"解码器复用"三个被混淆的概念。
AI.method: 在HumanML3D上构建受控的多schema运动VAE，比较不同schema表示在共享潜在空间下的对齐表现。测量原始Recall@1、配对token余弦相似度、线性校准后的可恢复性、循环一致性影响，以及少量paired clips（64对）下的表现；同时检验边际分布差异缩小是否等价于schema不变性。
AI.result: 即使输入相同，原始Recall@1仅5.9%–17.7%，配对token余弦仅0.221–0.484，而线性校准后对应关系几乎完美可恢复。循环一致性提升可恢复性，但直接检索与token一致性仍接近零。加入仅64对paired clips后，原始Recall@1升至88.4%–90.3%，token余弦约0.82，使多数事后对齐变得不必要，但交叉解码仍显著劣于原生重建。此外，缩小测得的边际分布差异并不意味着实现schema不变性。
AI.conclusion: 共享骨干或先验并不保证潜在坐标可直接兼容；可恢复对应关系不等于直接兼容。少量配对对应关系即可在测试设定下显著提升直接兼容性，并减少对事后对齐的依赖，但交叉解码与原生重建仍有差距。

title: EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
summary: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics, and the generator produces new heuristics with this insight. These improvements join the preference pairs for direct preference optimization (DPO). Since DPO only teaches the generator to rank these improvements, a reflective self-distillation (RSD) term makes it more likely to generate them on its own, and the gains accumulate over the long horizon of the search. Across COPs and open-source LLM backbones, EPOCH's heuristic ensembles outperform inference-only and fine-tuned baselines and generalize across problem scales.

AI.tldr: EPOCH将实例覆盖作为进化搜索目标，并通过经验偏好优化与反思自蒸馏微调LLM生成器，从而返回互补的启发式集合，在多个组合优化问题上优于基线且可跨问题规模泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动启发式设计（AHD）框架要么冻结生成器，要么仅用标量适应度微调，掩盖了各启发式覆盖哪些实例；基于反思的框架虽用自然语言反馈改进启发式，但反馈仅停留在提示中，未进入生成器权重。因此需要一种让覆盖成为搜索目标、并把反思内化到生成器参数中的方法。
AI.method: 提出EPOCH：以实例覆盖为进化搜索目标，父代选择、算子分配与停滞恢复均优化启发式对训练实例的联合覆盖，从而得到互补的启发式集合；生成器通过经验偏好优化从自身搜索中学习——教师LLM对生成的启发式给出自然语言洞见，生成器据此生成新启发式，改进结果与原始结果构成偏好对用于直接偏好优化（DPO）；针对DPO只教会排序而非自主生成的问题，引入反思自蒸馏（RSD）项，提高独立生成这些改进的概率，使收益在长时程搜索中累积。
AI.result: 在多种组合优化问题与开源LLM骨干上，EPOCH的启发式集合优于仅推理和微调基线，并能跨问题规模泛化。
AI.conclusion: 将实例覆盖显式作为搜索目标并结合反思内化的偏好优化与自蒸馏，可有效提升LLM自动启发式设计的性能与泛化能力。

title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Corpus, model outputs and analysis code available at https://github.com/sakhadib/llm-temporal-interval-reasoning
summary: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文让5个LLM对360篇英文叙事重建Allen的13种区间关系全集，预注册协议评估发现：最佳模型超越简单基线，但在严格解析下不及"永远回答before"的退化基线；该差距主要是格式化解析伪影，修正后覆盖率从0.60升至0.84并弥合差距；模型能恢复先后与包含关系但难以识别重叠，闪回场景失败最多；逻辑一致性对与金标准一致性预测力弱。
AI.motivation: 既有LLM时间推理评测多局限于孤立事件对或粗粒度标签，无法评估对整个叙事中事件相对时间结构的完整理解。作者希望检验LLM能否重建叙事中所有事件两两之间的Allen区间关系网络，并考察此类能力在真实相对时间设定下的表现与局限。
AI.method: 对360篇英文叙事（事件以相对关系而非日期定位），令5个LLM重建完整的Allen 13种区间关系网络；在预注册协议下评估与金标注的一致性、逆关系一致性和逻辑可满足性；主指标为macro-F1，并与"永远回答before"等平凡基线比较；此外对比严格的预注册解析器与事后解析器（可恢复畸形矩阵行中被确定的单元）对覆盖率的影响。
AI.result: 端到端最佳模型在macro-F1上明显优于平凡基线；但在预注册解析器下无一模型能达到"永远回答before"的准确率（该基线因标签偏斜而被抬高）。该差距主要是解析伪影：大矩阵格式错误导致整行丢失，事后解析器将覆盖率从0.60提升到0.84，并使最佳模型相对基线弥合差距。在模型作答的单元上，模型能恢复先后（precedence）与包含（containment）关系，但极少识别重叠（overlap），且在闪回（flashback）场景中失败最多——此时叙述与事件列表都先呈现较晚事件。逻辑一致性差异很大，但对与金标注的一致性解释力有限：强制一致主要靠填补空单元提高准确率，而"猜多数标签"这一平凡控制在同处表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的结构化输出与对相对时间的稳健处理，是进行整篇叙事时间推理的前提；当前LLM在完整区间关系网络重建上仍存在明显缺口，尤其在重叠关系与闪回处理方面，且逻辑一致性与金标准一致性关联较弱。

title: Bottlenecked semantic compression by representation reconstruction
summary: Vision Transformers incur high computational costs when processing long visual token sequences. Existing reduction methods typically rank tokens independently and discard those deemed unimportant or redundant. We propose a reconstruction-guided framework for visual token condensation (ReConV), which summarizes the complete visual sequence with a compact Summary Bank (SMB) and retains tokens whose information is not adequately captured by the SMB, as indicated by their reconstruction residuals. At each compression layer, a lightweight position-conditioned decoder reconstructs the current tokens, leaving shared information compressed in the SMB while explicitly preserving poorly reconstructed details. Experiments on image classification and multimodal understanding demonstrate favorable performance-efficiency trade-offs: ReConV surpasses the uncompressed baseline with 48\% fewer GMACs on ImageNet and enables reusable image-level representations for efficient multi-turn inference. Code is available at TokenDrop.

AI.tldr: ReConV 提出一种重建引导的视觉 token 压缩框架：用紧凑的 Summary Bank 汇总完整视觉序列，并保留重建残差较大的 token，从而在图像分类与多模态理解任务上实现更优的性能-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer 处理长视觉 token 序列时计算开销巨大；现有压缩方法通常独立地对 token 进行排序并丢弃被认为不重要或冗余的 token，忽略了 token 之间的信息互补性，可能误删关键信息。
AI.method: 提出重建引导的视觉 token 压缩框架 ReConV。其核心是引入紧凑的 Summary Bank（SMB）来汇总完整视觉序列；在每个压缩层使用轻量级位置条件解码器（position-conditioned decoder）重建当前 token，将共享信息压缩进 SMB，同时依据重建残差显式保留未被充分重建的细节 token。
AI.result: 在图像分类与多模态理解任务上展现出良好的性能-效率权衡：在 ImageNet 上以减少 48% GMACs 的情况下超越未压缩基线，并支持可复用的图像级表示以实现高效的多轮推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过重建残差引导 token 保留、以 SMB 承载共享信息，ReConV 有效缓解了独立打分剪枝的信息损失问题，实现了显著的压缩收益与实用性（代码已开源）。

title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

AI.tldr: World-T3是一种带相机控制的视频世界模型，通过测试时训练（TTT）记忆将历史观测固化到模型参数中，实现长时程一致生成并在单卡上达到实时性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归视频世界模型在长时程生成中依赖生成模型自身隐式保留历史信息，一旦超出有效上下文，空间记忆便迅速衰减，导致场景一致性丧失。因此需要一种显式、可扩展的记忆机制来维持长期视觉一致性。
AI.method: 提出World-T3：(1) 将过去观测通过测试时训练整合进专用模型参数，形成"快权重"记忆；(2) 采用递归最小二乘（RLS）更新规则，以相机位姿为键进行在线记忆更新，稳健吸收新视觉特征；(3) 记忆按相机位姿读出已观测场景特征，存储与单步计算量与推演长度无关；(4) 通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器，实现实时交互生成。
AI.result: 在长时程重访基准上，重访PSNR从13.52提升至18.31 dB，绝对旋转误差从3.344降至1.075，两项指标均优于最强基线；在单张NVIDIA B200 GPU上以1280×704分辨率维持20.6 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 显式且位姿键控的TTT记忆可有效缓解长时程空间记忆衰减，配合少步蒸馏可在保证生成质量的同时实现实时交互式视频世界建模。

title: Know-Thy-Not: Training-Free Targeted Negation in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
summary: Dual-encoder vision-language models systematically fail at negation, scoring ''a cat without a dog'' nearly identically to ''a cat with a dog.'' We show that this failure is inherent to the single-embedding framework. Under contrastive training, single-embedding methods can at best ignore the negated concept (dilution) but never penalize its presence (rejection). We propose Know-Thy-Not (KTN), a training-free method that introduces an image-side rejection dimension to penalize the negated concept directly in the visual representation. We also introduce COCO-Confusion, the first benchmark requiring genuine rejection to succeed. Across 9 backbones, KTN improves COCO-Confusion mAP by up to +25.6 over vanilla VLMs and +9.6 over the strongest existing method.

AI.tldr: 双编码器视觉语言模型在否定语义上系统性失效，其根源在于单一嵌入框架在对比训练下只能"稀释"而非"排斥"被否定概念。作者提出免训练的Know-Thy-Not（KTN），在图像侧引入排斥维度直接惩罚被否定概念，并构建了首个要求真正排斥能力的COCO-Confusion基准。在9个骨干网络上，KTN使COCO-Confusion的mAP较原始VLM最高提升+25.6，较最强现有方法提升+9.6。
AI.motivation: 双编码器视觉语言模型对否定不敏感，例如"a cat without a dog"与"a cat with a dog"的得分几乎相同。作者认为该失败并非工程缺陷而是框架固有属性，需要从单嵌入表征的局限性角度加以解释，并构建能真正检验否定排斥能力的评测基准。
AI.method: 首先从理论上论证：在对比训练目标下，单嵌入方法对被否定概念最多只能忽略（dilution），无法对其出现进行惩罚（rejection）。据此提出Know-Thy-Not（KTN），一种免训练方法，在图像侧引入一个"排斥维度"，使被否定概念在视觉表示中被直接惩罚。同时构建COCO-Confusion基准，这是首个以"真正排斥"为成功条件的评测集。
AI.result: 在9个骨干网络上进行评测，KTN在COCO-Confusion上的mAP相比原始VLM最高提升+25.6，相比现有最强方法提升+9.6。
AI.conclusion: 否定失效源于单嵌入对比学习框架的表达能力上限，而非单纯的数据或训练问题；通过在图像表示中显式引入排斥维度，可在不重新训练的前提下显著缓解该问题，COCO-Confusion为后续否定理解研究提供了更严格的评测标准。

title: The belief-action gap in language model agents
summary: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型（LM）智能体在文本网格世界推理中的状态信念、动作价值与动作偏好之间的交互，发现任务相关信息常常被可靠地表征，却未被一致地转化为行动，即存在"信息可用性"与"信念-行动一致性"之间的差距。
AI.motivation: LM智能体失败的原因各异，需要不同的解释与干预手段。作者希望厘清智能体在推理与决策承诺过程中，状态信念、动作价值与动作偏好三者如何相互作用，从而区分失败源于"缺失任务相关信息"还是源于"信息向行动的转化方式"。
AI.method: 在文本渲染的网格世界中，采用基于自我报告（report-based）和基于内部表征（representation-based）的探针来估计任务相关的状态信念，并用逆向强化学习（inverse reinforcement learning）估计动作价值；同时在整个推理过程中追踪动作偏好，并尝试通过强制动作（forced actions）移植推理前缀以及推理窗口激活编辑（reasoning-window activation edits）来考察对动作的控制。
AI.result: 任务相关的状态与价值信息往往比其在行为中的体现更为可靠；动作偏好在"承诺点"（commitment point）附近急剧收敛，报告的不确定性也随之下降，但单个信念变化并不能一致地解释动作偏好的转变；移植其他决策的推理前缀会影响强制动作，而所测试的推理窗口激活编辑对动作的控制有限。
AI.conclusion: 部分失败并非源于缺失任务相关信息，而是源于如何将已有信息转化为行动；该研究从测量上将"信息可用性"与"信念-行动一致性"加以区分，但本身并不直接判定每一次失败的具体成因。

title: TableVision: Recovering Verified Structure from Historical Tables
summary: Gaps, skips, and mistakes are the normal state of a historical register: rows go missing, tables cross page breaks, columns slip under wrong names, and column sums disagree with the corresponding row entries. Readers read digits correctly but lose the table structure. On seven clean panels of election returns, the best open-source reader reproduces 99.0\% of the digits but files only 83.7\% of the figures in the correct cells and gets 11 of 30 columns correct. TableVision treats table structure recovery as the problem. On three degraded 1888 pages, Amazon Textract files only 1 of 1494 figures correctly; TableVision correctly files 99.2\%, and all 51 columns its exact-total check releases are correct. A dynamic program cuts a volume into blocks by how many columns sum to their last line; witnesses read the cells; the gate classifies each column as exactly reconciling, flagged as faithful to a page whose arithmetic is wrong, or withheld. A theory of the sum check says which errors it cannot see and why its optimal block is about $θ^{-1/2}$ rows at defect rate $θ$. On 2201 columns of Wisconsin electoral data, the gate accepts 2042, flags 118, and withholds 41; failure rises with column length $R$ as $1-(1-θ)^R$ at 1.1 defects per 1000 cells in general elections; official returns confirm 933 of 934 testable accepted sums and all 35 testable flagged totals; and the deployment added 491\,359 gated precinct rows to a 9.3-million-row dataset. One implication is that the design of the verification block is critical.

AI.tldr: TableVision将历史统计表的结构恢复作为核心问题，通过动态规划分块、单元格识别与列级求和校验门控，将表格结构恢复转化为可验证的算术问题，在退化页面上显著优于通用OCR阅读器。
AI.motivation: 历史登记册普遍存在行缺失、表格跨页、列名错位、列求和与行项不符等问题。读者能正确识别数字却丢失表格结构，现有开源阅读器虽数字准确率高，但单元格归属与列结构恢复很差（如正确单元格仅83.7%、列正确11/30；退化页面上Textract仅1/1494正确），因此需要专门解决表格结构恢复而非单纯字符识别。
AI.method: TableVision把表格结构恢复当作问题本身：用动态规划按“多少列能与其末行求和一致”将卷册切分为块；由witnesses读取单元格；再用门控将每列分类为精确对账、标记为忠实于算术本身有误的页面、或扣留。作者还建立了求和校验理论，说明其无法察觉的错误类型，并证明在缺陷率θ下最优块大小约为θ^{-1/2}行。
AI.result: 在7个干净选举面板上，最佳开源阅读器复现99.0%数字，但仅83.7%数字归入正确单元格，30列中仅11列正确；TableVision在3个退化的1888年页面上，Amazon Textract仅正确归位1/1494个数字，而TableVision正确率99.2%，且其精确总和校验放行的51列全部正确。在2201列威斯康星选举数据上，门控接受2042列、标记118列、扣留41列；一般选举中每1000单元格1.1个缺陷时，失败率随列长R以1−(1−θ)^R上升；官方数据确认934个可测接受总和中的933个及全部35个可测标记总和；部署向930万行数据集新增491,359行受门控的选区记录。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将表格结构恢复作为核心问题并引入基于求和校验的列级门控，可大幅提升历史表格数据的结构正确性与可信度。一个关键启示是：验证块的设计至关重要。

title: Compositional RL: Evaluating and Training LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning
summary: Language models are often evaluated alone but increasingly deployed together, routed between, made to debate, ensembled, or collaboratively trained. For a model inside a system, what matters most is not how well it performs on its own, but how much the system gains from its presence. We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"组合强度"(compositional strength)概念，用Shapley值及其leave-one-out代理衡量模型在协作系统中的边际贡献，发现单独能力与组合贡献基本不相关；进而提出组合强化学习(C-RL)，直接在多模型系统中训练策略并奖励系统整体结果，在24个设置中的21个产生最强协作者，平均提升协作性能+4.0至+5.4分。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被组合部署（路由、辩论、集成、协同训练），但现有评估仍以单体性能为主。对系统中的模型而言，真正重要的是其加入能给系统带来多少增益，而非自身独立表现。因此需要形式化"组合强度"并研究单体能力能否作为系统内价值的代理。
AI.method: 1) 将模型池上的协作建模为合作博弈，用Shapley值定义模型的"组合强度"；2) 采用对全联盟的leave-one-out贡献作为可计算代理，将系统评估成本从2^n降至n+1；3) 在5个模型池、12种协作方法与12个数据集上对比单体强度与组合强度；4) 提出组合强化学习(C-RL)，在真实多模型系统中训练策略，奖励系统整体产出；由于Shapley中leave-one-out基线在组策略梯度下相消，无需额外rollout成本，也无需运行缺少该策略的联盟。
AI.result: 单体强度与组合强度总体不相关：在15个(pool, method-family)设置中有12个未发现单体能力转化为组合优势，且在通用模型上耦合最弱。C-RL在3种协作协议、覆盖推理/编码/科学发现的8个任务中，于24个设置里的21个产生最强协作者，平均提升协作性能+4.0至+5.4分（约为基线的3倍），最高提升+13.1分。
AI.conclusion: 独立的基准测试往往不能作为模型在协作系统中价值的良好代理；评估与优化应转向以系统整体产出的边际贡献为核心。C-RL提供了一种无需额外联盟评估成本、直接优化组合强度的可行训练范式。

title: Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions
summary: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将文本语言模型知识蒸馏应用于语音到语音（speech-to-speech）模型，提出一种在保留纯语音输入输出的同时构建内部文本接口的语音预训练方法，实现跨模态知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 文本LM经大规模预训练具备广泛的语言与事实能力，而纯语音模型难以习得同等能力。已有蒸馏方法主要集中在“语音输入-文本输出”模型，尚未探索语音到语音模型的知识蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出语音到语音预训练方法：模型先接收无转录的语音上下文，切换到文本预测，再用预测出的文本逐词引导后续语音生成，从而在保持纯语音输入输出的同时形成内部文本接口。该内部文本预测可直接从基础文本LM蒸馏，实现知识迁移。
AI.result: 在匹配训练条件下，所提序列构造相比纯语音模型和语音-文本交错模型显著改善了口语续写的生成困惑度（perplexity），接近使用外部ASR提示转录的文本驱动内心独白模型性能；蒸馏在文本和语音评测下均提升事实性表现，表明更好地保留了基础文本LM的知识。
AI.conclusion: 这是文本LM蒸馏在语音到语音LM上的首次应用，验证了内部文本接口作为知识蒸馏桥梁的有效性，可同时提升生成质量与事实知识保留能力。

title: Efficient Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment for Latent Generative Models
summary: Fréchet Distributional (FD) objectives provide an effective distribution-level signal for post-training generative models. For latent generative models, however, existing FD-based post-training methods optimize only the latent generator while keeping the decoder frozen: the decoder is trained on reconstruction latents obtained from real images but deployed on generator-produced latents at generation time. When these latent distributions differ, this \textbf{decoder train-generation mismatch} means that the decoder is deployed on inputs drawn from a distribution it was not directly trained on. We introduce \textbf{Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment (FDDA)}, an efficient post-training method that freezes the latent generator and directly optimizes the decoder on generation-time latents using an FD objective. A single epoch of FDDA consistently improves gFID and gFDr$^6$ across diverse flow-based and autoregressive latent generative models. Across all 11 evaluated models, FDDA reduces gFDr$^6$ by 34.0-59.6\% from the original pretrained models and provides a further 10.2-57.2\% reduction after generator-side FD post-training. FDDA also reduces total wall-clock time by factors of $3.6\times$-$328.7\times$ relative to generator-side FD post-training across these models. These results show that generator-side post-training alone does not exhaust the benefits of FD optimization, and that further gains can be obtained by adapting the decoder at substantially lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FDDA，一种冻结潜在生成器、直接用Fréchet分布目标优化解码器的后训练方法，以解决解码器训练-生成不匹配问题，在11个模型上显著降低gFID/gFDr⁶并大幅节省时间。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Fréchet分布（FD）目标的潜在生成模型后训练方法仅优化潜在生成器而冻结解码器。解码器在真实图像的重建潜变量上训练，却在生成时接收生成器产生的潜变量；当两者分布不一致时，解码器被部署在其未直接训练过的输入分布上，形成"解码器训练-生成不匹配"，限制了FD优化收益的充分释放。
AI.method: 提出Fréchet分布解码器对齐（FDDA）：冻结潜在生成器，直接用FD目标在生成时潜变量上优化解码器，仅需一个epoch即可完成高效后训练。方法适用于基于流（flow-based）与自回归的多种潜在生成模型。
AI.result: 在全部11个评估模型上，FDDA使gFDr⁶相对原始预训练模型降低34.0–59.6%；在生成器侧FD后训练之后再进一步降低10.2–57.2%。同时总墙钟时间相对生成器侧FD后训练减少3.6×–328.7×。
AI.conclusion: 仅做生成器侧后训练并不能穷尽FD优化的收益；通过以更低成本对解码器进行适配，可以获取额外且可观的性能提升，表明解码器侧对齐是FD后训练中一个被忽视但高效的增益来源。

title: Scaling Inference-Time Compute with Teams of Coding Agents
summary: Multi-agent systems promise a new axis for scaling inference: rather than having one agent think longer or sample more attempts, a task is split across many agents that work in parallel and coordinate. However, in practice, more agents can easily produce duplicate work, coordination failures, and higher costs. We therefore formulate team design as a compute allocation problem: starting from a solo agent, where should additional inference compute go to reach the reward-cost Pareto frontier? We build a minimal multi-agent harness from the ground up and trace this frontier by varying, one at a time, the workflow stage at which a lead delegates to its workers (planning, implementation, or verification), the models that form the team, and the number of workers. On ProgramBench, teams outperform solo agents but cost three to seven times as much. With the right compute allocation, however, a heterogeneous 17-agent team comes within 1.4 points of a strong homogeneous 5-agent team at 70% lower cost. This efficiency stems from three findings. First, planning is the most valuable use of workers: in a homogeneous team whose lead decides how many workers to spawn, a lead that delegates only planning to its workers, and then implements and verifies the code itself, matches the reward of a lead that delegates to workers throughout planning, implementation, and verification, at half the cost. Second, cheap models pay off as planners but not as implementers: a strong lead with cheap planners recovers 47.5% of the reward gain of an all-strong team for only 13.9% of its additional cost, whereas cheap implementers lower reward. Third, planners keep improving reward as the team grows, whereas implementers and verifiers plateau beyond four workers. Together, our results offer a guide to spending an agent budget where it counts, given the task, cost, and latency constraints a user has.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多智能体团队设计形式化为"算力分配问题"，通过构建最小化多智能体harness并沿奖励-成本帕累托前沿做单变量消融（委派阶段、模型组成、worker数量），揭示了规划阶段委派最有价值、廉价模型适合当规划者而非实施者、规划者随团队扩大持续增益等三条规律。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统被视为扩展推理的新维度：将任务拆分给多个并行协作的智能体，而非让单个智能体思考更久或采样更多。但实践中增加智能体易导致重复劳动、协调失败和成本上升，因此需要明确"额外算力该投向何处"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 将团队设计形式化为算力分配问题，从单体智能体出发，沿奖励-成本帕累托前沿进行单变量实验：逐一改变lead向worker委派的工作流阶段（规划/实施/验证）、构成团队的模型、以及worker数量。基于ProgramBench构建极简多智能体harness。
AI.result: 在ProgramBench上，团队优于单体但成本高3-7倍；合理算力分配下，异构17智能体团队以低70%成本接近同构5智能体强队（差距1.4分）。三条发现：(1)规划是最有价值的委派环节，仅委派规划可在一半成本下达到全程委派的奖励；(2)廉价模型作规划者有效（强lead+廉价规划者以13.9%额外成本获47.5%奖励增益），但作实施者会降低奖励；(3)规划者随团队扩大持续提升奖励，实施者与验证者在超过4个worker后趋于平台。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在给定任务、成本与延迟约束下如何将智能体预算花在刀刃上提供了指导原则：优先在规划阶段投入算力，规划者可用廉价模型且可扩展规模，实施与验证环节则应控制worker数量。

title: A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models
summary: In humans, proprioception corresponds to the sense of self-movement or position, e.g. understanding the position of one's arm. This sense is often less well-understood and in popular understanding sometimes conflated with introspection. But, notably, proprioception is a separate sense, with dedicated receptors and verifiable outcomes. On the other hand though, language models cannot observe their own internal states during training (and for example answer the question which experts activated in a certain layer of an MoE) and so cannot accurately report on them. Yet, such information is, by virtue of being internal to the model, both accessible, and readily constructed into verifiable signals. We argue that this provides the basis for a digital analog of proprioception. As such, we train models through SFT and on-policy training to equip them with this ability. We show that modern models can be trained to understand a range of subtypes of proprioception, such as routing decision awareness, token entropy, decision depth or logit lens information, without affecting model capabilities. We then run these models through a broad evaluation of situational awareness, legibility, and epiphenomenality, to evaluate in what ways access to proprioception changes model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言模型"数字本体感觉"概念：模型可访问自身内部状态（如 MoE 路由、token 熵、决策深度、logit lens 信息），并通过 SFT 与 on-policy 训练赋予其报告这些内部状态的能力，且不损害原有能力。
AI.motivation: 人类本体感觉是对自身运动与位置的感知，独立于内省，有专门受体和可验证结果。语言模型在训练中无法观察自身内部状态，因而不能准确报告，但这些信息是模型内部的、可访问且可构造为可验证信号，这为"数字本体感觉"提供了基础。
AI.method: 通过监督微调（SFT）与 on-policy 训练，使模型学会理解多种本体感觉子类型：路由决策感知、token 熵、决策深度、logit lens 信息；随后在情境意识、可读性（legibility）与副现象性（epiphenomenality）三个维度进行广泛评估。
AI.result: 现代模型可被训练以理解多种本体感觉子类型，且这一训练不影响模型原有能力；通过情境意识、可读性与副现象性评估，考察了获得本体感觉如何改变模型行为。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可获得一种数字本体感觉，使其能准确报告内部状态，为模型可解释性与情境意识研究提供了新途径，并揭示了此类能力对模型行为的影响。
